AI.title_translation: 基于半球形射线投射分析的铣削配置分类与可加工性评估
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种GPU加速的几何分析方法，通过半球形射线投射和方向变异性分析，从CAD文件直接评估CNC可加工性和设置要求，实现设计阶段的交互式制造性反馈。
AI.motivation: 在早期阶段评估可制造性可以减少设计迭代和昂贵的下游变更。
AI.method: 该方法采用GPU加速的几何分析，包含一个多阶段流程：首先使用半球形射线投射量化表面可达性；接着进行方向变异性分析以提取主导加工轴；通过基于阈值的分类确定是3轴还是多轴加工。对于3轴零件，采用正交射线投射和可达性优化来计算最小设置次数并明确标记不可达表面。
AI.result: 验证案例显示计算时间足够短，可以支持交互式CAD工作流程，从而在设计阶段提供定量的可制造性反馈，且无需制造专业知识。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过在设计阶段提供快速、定量的可制造性反馈，有效减少设计迭代和下游成本，且无需制造专业知识。
AI.translation: 早期阶段的可制造性评估可减少设计迭代和昂贵的下游变更。本文提出了一种GPU加速的几何分析方法，可直接从CAD文件评估CNC可加工性和设置要求。一个多阶段的流程利用半球形射线投射来量化表面可达性，然后通过方向变异性分析提取主导加工轴。基于阈值的分类确定是3轴还是多轴加工。对于3轴零件，正交射线投射和可达性优化计算最小设置次数并明确标记不可达表面。验证案例显示计算时间足够短，足以支持交互式CAD工作流程，从而在设计阶段实现定量的可制造性反馈，而无需制造专业知识。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用GPU加速的半球形射线投射几何分析方法，用于从CAD文件直接评估CNC铣削的可加工性配置和设置需求。该方法通过多阶段流程量化表面可达性、识别主导加工轴，并分类3轴或多轴加工。对于3轴零件，进一步优化设置并标记不可达区域。实验证明，该方法计算效率高，能为设计师在早期阶段提供交互式、定量的制造性反馈，无需专业制造知识。
AI.keywords: 半球形射线投射, 可加工性评估, 铣削配置, CAD, GPU加速
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的、实用的方法，将制造性评估前移到设计阶段，显著减少了设计返工和成本。其结合GPU加速和射线投射技术，实现了实时或近实时的反馈，对于CAD/CAM集成具有重要意义。该方法的优点在于其自动化和无需专业制造知识的特点，使得设计师可以更早地发现并解决潜在的制造问题。未来的工作可能包括扩展到更复杂的加工类型或材料特性。

title: CaseWeaver: A Multi-Agent Framework for Multimodal Virtual Clinical Case Generation
summary: Clinical diagnosis relies on consistent multimodal data collected from the same patient throughout the disease course, yet such data are difficult to acquire at scale because of collection costs, missing modalities, fragmented systems, and longitudinal follow-ups. Existing synthetic-data approaches largely focus on individual modalities or vision-language dual modalities at report-level generation. Little work has been done to construct synthetic data with consistent patient backgrounds, coherent disease trajectories, and interrelated modality-specific evidence at a complete clinical case level. We introduce CaseWeaver, a multi-agent framework built around a timeline-anchored Latent Clinical Case Graph (LCCG). The LCCG organizes patient context, latent disease states, clinical events, and expected observations in a shared patient-level representation. Modality-agents use scoped observation subgraphs and clinical protocols to generate evidence including clinical records, laboratory results, physiological signals, and medical images. We evaluate clinical inferability using a calibrated AgentClinic protocol and case diversity using Virtual Case Diversity (VCD) score. CaseWeaver outperformed general-model and agentic-workflow baselines on both metrics, producing more diverse and coherent multimodal virtual clinical cases.

AI.title_translation: CaseWeaver：一个用于多模态虚拟临床病例生成的多智能体框架
AI.tldr: CaseWeaver是一个多智能体框架，通过时间线锚定的潜在临床病例图谱和模态智能体，生成具有患者背景、疾病轨迹和多模态证据的一致的虚拟临床病例，优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 临床诊断依赖于一致的多模态数据，但这些数据难以大规模获取，因为采集成本高、模态缺失、系统碎片化和长期随访。现有合成数据方法主要关注单一模态或视觉-语言双模态，缺乏构建具有一致患者背景、连贯疾病轨迹和相互关联模态特定证据的完整临床病例级合成数据的工作。
AI.method: 本文引入了CaseWeaver，一个多智能体框架，围绕时间线锚定的潜在临床病例图谱（LCCG）构建。LCCG以共享的患者层面表示组织患者背景、潜在疾病状态、临床事件和预期观察。模态智能体使用限定范围的观察子图和临床协议来生成证据，包括临床记录、实验室结果、生理信号和医学图像。
AI.result: CaseWeaver在校准的AgentClinic协议的临床可推断性评估和虚拟病例多样性（VCD）分数评估的病例多样性方面，均优于通用模型和智能体工作流基线，生成了更多样化和连贯的多模态虚拟临床病例。
AI.conclusion: CaseWeaver通过其多智能体框架和LCCG方法，成功解决了大规模获取一致多模态临床数据的问题，为生成高质量、多样化且连贯的虚拟临床病例提供了有效途径。
AI.translation: 临床诊断依赖于在疾病过程中从同一患者收集的一致的多模态数据，然而，由于采集成本、模态缺失、系统碎片化和长期随访，此类数据难以大规模获取。现有的合成数据方法主要侧重于报告层面的单一模态或视觉-语言双模态生成。在构建具有一致患者背景、连贯疾病轨迹和相互关联模态特定证据的完整临床病例级合成数据方面，鲜有工作。我们引入了CaseWeaver，一个围绕时间线锚定的潜在临床病例图谱（LCCG）构建的多智能体框架。LCCG以共享的患者层面表示组织患者背景、潜在疾病状态、临床事件和预期观察。模态智能体使用限定范围的观察子图和临床协议来生成证据，包括临床记录、实验室结果、生理信号和医学图像。我们使用校准的AgentClinic协议评估临床可推断性，并使用虚拟病例多样性（VCD）分数评估病例多样性。CaseWeaver在这两项指标上均优于通用模型和智能体工作流基线，生成了更多样化和连贯的多模态虚拟临床病例。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了CaseWeaver，一个多智能体框架，旨在解决大规模获取一致多模态临床数据进行诊断的难题。该框架通过一个时间线锚定的潜在临床病例图谱（LCCG）来表示患者背景、疾病状态和临床事件，并利用模态智能体生成包括临床记录、实验室结果和医学图像在内的多模态证据。实验结果表明，CaseWeaver在临床可推断性和病例多样性方面均优于现有基线，能够生成更丰富、更连贯的虚拟临床病例。
AI.keywords: 虚拟临床病例, 多智能体框架, 多模态数据, 潜在临床病例图谱, 合成数据
AI.comments: CaseWeaver的创新之处在于其将多智能体框架与时间线锚定的潜在临床病例图谱（LCCG）相结合，有效地解决了生成具有一致性、连贯性和多模态关联性的完整虚拟临床病例的挑战。这对于弥补真实临床数据稀缺性、推动临床AI发展具有重要意义。

title: RAPID: Reliability-Aware Pair Importance Distillation
summary: Inter example relational distillation transfers a teacher's representation geometry by matching relations among examples within a mini batch. Computing all pairs has quadratic complexity in the batch size, whereas uniform subsampling may use a limited relation budget inefficiently. We introduce Reliability Aware Pair Importance Distillation, or RAPID, which separates a reliability gated relational target from a full support adaptive pair proposal. Reliability determines which teacher relations are emphasized, while calibrated teacher entropy and detached student-teacher residuals determine which relations are evaluated. Exact inverse proposal correction makes the loss and gradient estimators conditionally unbiased with respect to the gated mini batch target. We evaluate RAPID in two text classification settings: AG News with BERT-to-DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 256, and SST-2 with DistilBERT to DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 64. Reliability gated relational distillation achieves the highest observed mean student accuracy on both datasets: 94.285 plus or minus 0.054 percent on AG News and 88.800 plus or minus 0.532 percent on SST-2. RAPID ranks second, achieving 94.241 plus or minus 0.025 percent and 88.685 plus or minus 0.462 percent, respectively, compared with 94.154 plus or minus 0.124 percent and 87.271 plus or minus 0.162 percent for the cross entropy baseline. Pilot evaluations are counted toward the same total budget as the main relation evaluations. Across both settings, the gated target yields the highest mean accuracy, while the adaptive proposal remains within seed-level variation. These results support the modular view that target reliability and evaluation priority are separable design dimensions.

AI.title_translation: RAPID：可靠性感知对重要性蒸馏
AI.tldr: RAPID通过可靠性感知对选择改进了示例间关系蒸馏，从而在文本分类中提高了学生模型的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的示例间关系蒸馏方法存在二次复杂度问题，或在有限的关系预算下，均匀子采样效率低下。
AI.method: RAPID引入了可靠性感知对重要性蒸馏，它将可靠性门控的关系目标与完全支持的自适应对提议分开。可靠性决定了哪些教师关系被强调，而校准的教师熵和分离的学生-教师残差决定了哪些关系被评估。精确的逆提议校正使得损失和梯度估计器在门控小批量目标下是条件无偏的。
AI.result: 在AG News数据集上，RAPID实现了94.241 ± 0.025%的平均学生准确率，在SST-2数据集上实现了88.685 ± 0.462%的平均学生准确率，均优于交叉熵基线（94.154 ± 0.124%和87.271 ± 0.162%）。可靠性门控关系蒸馏达到了最高的平均学生准确率（AG News：94.285 ± 0.054%，SST-2：88.800 ± 0.532%）。结果表明，门控目标产生了最高的平均准确率，而自适应提议保持在种子级别的变化范围内。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持了目标可靠性和评估优先级是可分离的设计维度这一模块化观点。
AI.translation: 示例间关系蒸馏通过匹配小批量内示例之间的关系来转移教师的表示几何。计算所有对的复杂度与批量大小的平方成正比，而均匀子采样可能会低效地使用有限的关系预算。我们引入了可靠性感知对重要性蒸馏（RAPID），它将可靠性门控的关系目标与完全支持的自适应对提议分开。可靠性决定了哪些教师关系被强调，而校准的教师熵和分离的学生-教师残差决定了哪些关系被评估。精确的逆提议校正使得损失和梯度估计器在门控小批量目标下是条件无偏的。我们在两种文本分类设置中评估了RAPID：使用三个配对种子和256个关系预算的BERT到DistilBERT蒸馏在AG News上，以及使用三个配对种子和64个关系预算的DistilBERT到DistilBERT蒸馏在SST-2上。可靠性门控关系蒸馏在两个数据集上都达到了最高的平均学生准确率：AG News上为94.285 ± 0.054%，SST-2上为88.800 ± 0.532%。RAPID排名第二，分别达到了94.241 ± 0.025%和88.685 ± 0.462%，而交叉熵基线分别为94.154 ± 0.124%和87.271 ± 0.162%。初步评估计入与主要关系评估相同的总预算。在这两种设置中，门控目标产生了最高的平均准确率，而自适应提议保持在种子级别的变化范围内。这些结果支持了目标可靠性和评估优先级是可分离的设计维度这一模块化观点。
AI.summary: RAPID（可靠性感知对重要性蒸馏）旨在解决示例间关系蒸馏中存在的计算复杂度和关系预算低效利用问题。它通过引入可靠性门控的关系目标和自适应对提议机制，并结合精确的逆提议校正，确保了损失和梯度估计器的无偏性。实验结果表明，RAPID在文本分类任务中显著提高了学生模型的准确性，尤其是在AG News和SST-2数据集上表现优异，验证了目标可靠性和评估优先级作为可分离设计维度的有效性。
AI.keywords: 关系蒸馏, 可靠性感知, 对重要性, 知识蒸馏, 文本分类
AI.comments: RAPID提供了一种智能且高效的方法来优化知识蒸馏中的关系匹配，通过对对重要性进行可靠性感知选择，解决了传统方法中的效率和性能瓶颈。其将目标可靠性和评估优先级分离的模块化设计理念具有创新性，为未来的知识蒸馏研究提供了新的思路。

title: Architectural and Regularization Components in Deep Learning Medical Image Registration: Systematic Ablation Study
summary: Deep learning registration methods routinely stack two kinds of enhancement on a base network: architectural additions such as affine pre-alignment stages, and training-objective additions such as regularization losses. Papers tend to adopt both at once, so it is unclear which is doing the work. I ran a controlled ablation to separate them. Using the OASIS brain MRI dataset (394 training subjects, 20 test subjects), I trained four variants of the same registration pipeline: a baseline 3D U-Net with basic similarity losses, the same U-Net with a full regularization suite, an affine-plus-deformable architecture with basic losses, and the affine architecture with the full suite. I evaluated registration accuracy (MSE, NCC, SSIM), deformation quality (Jacobian determinant preservation, displacement statistics, an anatomical plausibility score), and computational cost. Regularization alone accounted for most of the gain: a 21.3% relative gain on the MSE-improvement metric (1.78% to 2.16%, P<.001) and a 21.8% relative gain in NCC improvement, while cutting maximum deformation from 53.1 to 0.51 units, a 99.0% reduction, at essentially no computational cost (-0.06% inference time). The combined model produced the largest accuracy gain, 25.8% (1.78% to 2.24%), and raised anatomical plausibility from 0.596 to 0.930, at a moderate +9.8% inference-time cost. Gradient correlation rose from 0.742 at baseline to 0.980 for the fully enhanced model. All enhanced variants reached sub-voxel accuracy under plausible deformation constraints. Regularization losses are the primary driver in this setting, delivering the accuracy gains and almost all of the deformation control for free at inference time, while the affine architecture adds a smaller complementary benefit at acceptable cost. The 99% reduction in unrealistic deformations addresses a known barrier to clinical deployment.

AI.title_translation: 深度学习医学图像配准中的架构和正则化组件：系统消融研究
AI.tldr: 在深度学习医学图像配准中，正则化损失是提高精度和控制形变的主要驱动因素，而架构改进则提供较小的补充效益。
AI.motivation: 深度学习配准方法通常同时采用架构增强和训练目标增强（如正则化损失），这使得人们不清楚哪种增强真正起作用。本研究旨在通过受控消融实验来分离并评估它们各自的贡献。
AI.method: 在OASIS脑部MRI数据集（394个训练对象，20个测试对象）上进行了一项受控消融研究。训练了同一配准管线的四种变体：具有基本相似性损失的基线3D U-Net；具有完整正则化套件的相同U-Net；具有基本损失的仿射加可变形架构；以及具有完整套件的仿射架构。评估指标包括配准精度（MSE、NCC、SSIM）、形变质量（雅可比行列式保持、位移统计、解剖学合理性评分）和计算成本。
AI.result: 仅正则化就带来了大部分增益：MSE改进指标相对增益21.3%（从1.78%到2.16%，P<.001），NCC改进相对增益21.8%，同时将最大形变从53.1单位减少到0.51单位，减少了99.0%，且几乎没有计算成本（推断时间-0.06%）。组合模型产生了最大的精度增益，达到25.8%（从1.78%到2.24%），并将解剖学合理性从0.596提高到0.930，推断时间成本适中（+9.8%）。梯度相关性从基线的0.742上升到完全增强模型的0.980。所有增强变体都在合理的形变约束下达到了亚体素精度。
AI.conclusion: 在此设置下，正则化损失是主要的驱动因素，它提供了精度增益和几乎所有的形变控制，且在推断时没有额外计算成本。仿射架构则以可接受的成本提供了较小的补充效益。将不切实际的形变减少99%解决了临床部署中的一个已知障碍。
AI.translation: 深度学习配准方法通常在基础网络上堆叠两种增强：架构上的增加，例如仿射预对齐阶段；以及训练目标上的增加，例如正则化损失。论文倾向于同时采用这两种方法，因此不清楚是哪种方法在起作用。我进行了一项受控消融研究来分离它们。使用OASIS脑部MRI数据集（394个训练对象，20个测试对象），我训练了同一配准管线的四种变体：具有基本相似性损失的基线3D U-Net；具有完整正则化套件的相同U-Net；具有基本损失的仿射加可变形架构；以及具有完整套件的仿射架构。我评估了配准精度（MSE、NCC、SSIM）、形变质量（雅可比行列式保持、位移统计、解剖学合理性评分）和计算成本。仅正则化就带来了大部分增益：MSE改进指标相对增益21.3%（从1.78%到2.16%，P<.001），NCC改进相对增益21.8%，同时将最大形变从53.1单位减少到0.51单位，减少了99.0%，且几乎没有计算成本（推断时间-0.06%）。组合模型产生了最大的精度增益，达到25.8%（从1.78%到2.24%），并将解剖学合理性从0.596提高到0.930，推断时间成本适中（+9.8%）。梯度相关性从基线的0.742上升到完全增强模型的0.980。所有增强变体都在合理的形变约束下达到了亚体素精度。在此设置下，正则化损失是主要的驱动因素，它提供了精度增益和几乎所有的形变控制，且在推断时没有额外计算成本，而仿射架构则以可接受的成本提供了较小的补充效益。将不切实际的形变减少99%解决了临床部署中的一个已知障碍。
AI.summary: 本文通过一项系统的消融研究，旨在区分深度学习医学图像配准中架构增强和正则化损失的各自贡献。研究使用OASIS脑部MRI数据集，在3D U-Net基础上测试了四种变体。结果表明，正则化损失是提高配准精度和有效控制形变的主要因素，显著减少了不切实际的形变，且几乎不增加计算成本。而仿射预对齐等架构改进则提供了较小的补充效益。这项工作澄清了这些组件的独立作用，并强调了正则化对于生成临床上可接受形变的重要性。
AI.keywords: 深度学习, 医学图像配准, 消融研究, 正则化, 架构组件
AI.comments: 这篇论文对深度学习医学图像配准中常用的两种增强策略进行了清晰而系统的分析。其主要创新在于严谨地分离并量化了架构组件与正则化损失的各自贡献。发现正则化是精度和形变合理性的主要驱动因素，这一点对于指导未来的研究和临床部署至关重要，因为不切实际的形变是临床应用中的一个已知障碍。受控消融研究的设计方法论非常扎实。

title: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN: Prior-Guided Joint Probabilistic Forecasting of Clinical Trajectories
summary: Clinical deterioration unfolds through coupled, partially observed trajectories, not a single diagnostic label. We introduce PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN, a trajectory-first framework for joint probabilistic forecasting of multivariate physiology. It combines missingness-aware temporal encoders, a soft organ-system prior, patient-specific relations, nonlinear Kolmogorov-Arnold messages, and a low-rank multivariate Student-t head. We evaluate 24-hour histories and six-hour forecasts on a frozen MIMIC-IV-derived cohort of 6,882 patients and 54,694 windows. Across five seeds and 13 models, PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN obtains the second-lowest normalized MAE (0.37727 +/- 0.00029) and the lowest RMSE (0.52656 +/- 0.00034). It reduces MAE by 0.52% relative to deterministic TimeKAN. For probabilistic forecasting, it reaches a marginal NLL of 0.66380 and a CRPS of 0.27301. Empirical coverage is 0.533, 0.831, and 0.958 for nominal 50%, 80%, and 95% intervals. Removing relational structure causes the largest ablation loss. Increasing covariance rank improves joint likelihood but has little effect on point accuracy. A trajectory-derived risk score remains weaker than a dedicated GRU-D classifier (AUROC 0.603 versus 0.650), which limits the present clinical claim. Joint trajectory forecasting therefore provides an inspectable intermediate task, but accurate physiology forecasts alone do not ensure a calibrated event detector.

AI.title_translation: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN：先验引导的临床轨迹联合概率预测
AI.tldr: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN是一个新的框架，用于联合概率预测多变量生理学，通过结合先验知识和患者特异性关系，在临床轨迹预测方面表现出色，但其风险评分在事件检测方面仍有局限。
AI.motivation: 临床恶化通过耦合的、部分观测的轨迹而非单一诊断标签展开，需要一个轨迹优先的框架来联合概率预测多变量生理学。
AI.method: 引入PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN框架，它结合了缺失感知时间编码器、软器官系统先验、患者特异性关系、非线性Kolmogorov-Arnold消息和一个低秩多变量Student-t头部。该模型在包含6,882名患者和54,694个窗口的MIMIC-IV队列上，评估24小时历史和6小时预测。
AI.result: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN获得了第二低的归一化MAE (0.37727 +/- 0.00029) 和最低的RMSE (0.52656 +/- 0.00034)，相对于确定性TimeKAN，MAE降低0.52%。概率预测达到边际NLL 0.66380和CRPS 0.27301。经验覆盖率对于标称50%、80%和95%区间分别为0.533、0.831和0.958。移除关系结构导致最大的消融损失。轨迹导出的风险评分不如专用GRU-D分类器 (AUROC 0.603 对 0.650)。
AI.conclusion: 联合轨迹预测提供了一个可检查的中间任务，但仅凭准确的生理预测不能确保校准的事件检测器。
AI.translation: 临床恶化通过耦合的、部分观测的轨迹而非单一诊断标签展开。我们引入了PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN，这是一个轨迹优先的框架，用于多变量生理学的联合概率预测。它结合了缺失感知时间编码器、软器官系统先验、患者特异性关系、非线性Kolmogorov-Arnold消息和一个低秩多变量Student-t头部。我们在一个冻结的、源自MIMIC-IV的队列上评估了24小时历史和6小时预测，该队列包含6,882名患者和54,694个窗口。在五个随机种子和13个模型中，PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN获得了第二低的归一化MAE (0.37727 +/- 0.00029) 和最低的RMSE (0.52656 +/- 0.00034)。相对于确定性TimeKAN，它将MAE降低了0.52%。对于概率预测，它达到了0.66380的边际NLL和0.27301的CRPS。对于标称50%、80%和95%的区间，经验覆盖率分别为0.533、0.831和0.958。移除关系结构导致最大的消融损失。增加协方差秩改善了联合似然，但对点精度影响不大。轨迹导出的风险评分仍然弱于专门的GRU-D分类器 (AUROC 0.603 对 0.650)，这限制了当前的临床主张。因此，联合轨迹预测提供了一个可检查的中间任务，但仅凭准确的生理预测不能确保校准的事件检测器。
AI.summary: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN是一个新颖的框架，旨在对临床恶化中的多变量生理轨迹进行联合概率预测。它结合了先进的建模组件，如缺失感知编码器、器官系统先验和患者特异性关系。在MIMIC-IV数据集上的评估显示，该模型在点预测精度（MAE和RMSE）方面表现优异，并在概率预测方面取得了良好的NLL和CRPS。尽管其预测能力强，但直接从轨迹导出的风险评分在事件检测方面仍有局限，表明准确的生理预测本身不足以完全替代校准的事件检测器。
AI.keywords: 临床轨迹预测, 概率预测, PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN, 生理学, MIMIC-IV
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN框架，在临床轨迹的联合概率预测方面取得了显著进展，特别是在处理多变量生理数据和结合先验知识方面。其创新之处在于整合了多种先进技术，以捕捉临床恶化的复杂动态。然而，论文也坦诚地指出了一个重要限制：尽管生理预测准确，但直接用于事件检测的风险评分仍有不足。这表明从连续预测到离散事件判断之间仍存在挑战，为未来的研究指明了方向。

title: Truth Revelation, Information Hiding, or Misinformation: Characterization of Equilibrium Outcomes in Signaling Games
summary: In signaling games where a sender and a receiver have misaligned criteria, equilibrium behavior may lead to fully revealing, quantized, or randomized policies. Notably, the first arises in statistical decision theory and classical communication theoretic problems involving a fully aligned sensor and receiver, the second arises in Nash theoretic simultaneous signaling games, and the last may appear in Stackelberg type (leader-follower) Bayesian signaling games. In this paper, we investigate the Bayesian persuasion problem involving a receiver that tries to estimate the source. We show that for certain payoff structures, the equilibrium solution is such that a source observation is mapped to distinct messages with nonzero probabilities. More specifically, we completely characterize conditions under which the sender requires randomization for the Bayesian persuasion problem involving general sources with finite cardinality. In particular, regardless of whether the equilibrium solution under a deterministic policy restriction is fully revealing, quantized or noninformative, there exists a randomized sender policy that improves the sender's payoff under certain conditions characterized in the paper. Moreover, we provide an algorithmic procedure to obtain the Bayesian persuasion solution, where the algorithm compares the payoffs with finitely many posterior probability combinations. We also consider fully aligned and completely misaligned payoff structures, where the solutions respectively involve a fully revealing sender and a noninformative sender. Then, we unify these results by proving that if the sender's expected payoff with respect to posterior distributions is continuous, then the equilibrium solution involves either a fully revealing sender or a noninformative sender.

AI.title_translation: 真相揭示、信息隐藏或误导：信号博弈中均衡结果的特征化
AI.tldr: 本文研究了贝叶斯劝说问题，其中接收者试图估计信源。我们表征了发送者需要随机化策略的条件，并提供了一种获取贝叶斯劝说解的算法。研究还统一了在发送者预期收益连续的情况下，均衡解涉及完全揭示或非信息发送者的结果。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在研究贝叶斯劝说问题，特别是当发送者和接收者标准不一致时，均衡行为可能导致完全揭示、量化或随机化策略。研究的动机是完全表征发送者需要随机化策略的条件，以改进发送者的收益，并提供一种求解贝叶斯劝说问题的算法。
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析方法，研究了发送者和接收者标准不一致的信号博弈中的贝叶斯劝说问题。具体方法包括：1) 表征了在特定收益结构下，源观察映射到具有非零概率的不同消息的条件。2) 完全表征了在有限基数的一般信源下，发送者需要随机化策略的条件。3) 提出了一种通过比较有限多个后验概率组合的收益来获得贝叶斯劝说解的算法程序。4) 考虑了完全一致和完全不一致的收益结构，并证明了如果发送者的预期收益关于后验分布是连续的，则均衡解涉及完全揭示或非信息发送者。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，在某些收益结构下，均衡解是将源观察映射到具有非零概率的不同消息。论文完全表征了在有限基数的一般信源下，发送者需要随机化策略的条件。特别地，无论在确定性策略限制下均衡解是完全揭示、量化还是非信息，在本文表征的某些条件下，存在一种随机发送者策略可以提高发送者的收益。此外，研究提供了一种获取贝叶斯劝说解的算法程序。最后，研究证明了如果发送者的预期收益关于后验分布是连续的，则均衡解涉及完全揭示或非信息发送者。
AI.conclusion: 本文的结论是，在发送者和接收者标准不一致的信号博弈中，贝叶斯劝说问题的均衡解可能涉及随机化策略，并且存在一种算法程序来获得这些解。最终，如果发送者的预期收益关于后验分布是连续的，则均衡解将统一地表现为完全揭示或非信息发送者。

AI.summary: 本文研究了发送者和接收者标准不一致的信号博弈中的贝叶斯劝说问题。研究发现，均衡行为可能导致完全揭示、量化或随机化策略。论文深入探讨了发送者需要随机化策略的条件，并证明了在特定条件下，随机化策略能提高发送者的收益。文章还提出了一种计算贝叶斯劝说解的算法。此外，研究统一了在发送者预期收益连续的假设下，均衡解将是完全揭示或非信息发送者的结果。

title: Optimizing Train Driving to Minimize the Electricity Cost of an Entire Railway Traffic Mesh using Evolutionary Algorithms
comments: Will be published in a journal
summary: This paper presents a procedure to optimize the way trains are driven, which pursues, in addition to fulfilling operational constraints such as admissible speeds or journey durations, the minimization of the cost related to supplying electrical energy to the trains, including the cost of the energy consumption and the cost of the power capacity utilization. This procedure combines: (i) a traffic model that merges the energy and power footprint of each rail service part of the traffic mesh, and (ii) an evolutionary computation framework that enables searching for the optimal way to drive the trains to achieve an optimal traffic mesh. This procedure is applied to a 450 km long section of the high-speed line from Madrid to Barcelona (Spain).

AI.title_translation: 使用进化算法优化列车驾驶以最小化整个铁路交通网的电力成本

AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种用于优化列车驾驶以最小化整个铁路交通网电力成本的程序。

title: Verification, Sensitivity, and Operating Limits of a GPU-Accelerated Planar WCSPH Model for Hydrodynamic Ram
summary: Hydrodynamic ram (HRAM) loading remains a persistent challenge in impact mechanics, less due to exotic physics than to the difficulty of achieving convincing quantitative agreement in reduced-order representations. Prevailing studies typically employ a single mesh and boundary treatment validated against one experimental dataset, leaving unresolved whether agreement reflects genuine fidelity or compensating discretization errors. This work presents a planar 2D, GPU-accelerated WCSPH solver employing an Adami-type ghost-particle boundary condition, extended for the first time to a moving, decelerating disk penetrating a confined liquid channel at ballistic velocity. The boundary condition is examined against a purpose-derived potential-flow added-mass solution and the analytical acoustic reflection coefficient at the steel-water interface; this exploration reveals that the stiff equation of state and cavitation cutoff impose identifiable delineation of the solver's operating regime on quantitative agreement. A three-point resolution convergence study reveals a non-monotone near-probe pressure peak, attributed to a bounded ghost-fluid density inconsistency. A comprehensive coefficient sweep, conservation diagnostics, and O(N) GPU throughput scaling enable exhaustive characterization impractical in 3D. Qualitative comparison against literature evidence at 900 and 600m/s clarifies load bearing versus approximate elements. Notably, energy diagnostics reveal a modest total energy growth over the simulated window, with the fluid absorbing disproportionately more energy than the projectile relinquishes - an instructive signature of prescribed, non-back-reacting projectile kinematics that helps map the formulation's operating envelope. The resulting solver, while confined to planar geometry, delivers verified, convergence-checked performance well suited for rapid parametric design exploration.

AI.title_translation: GPU加速平面WCSPH模型在流体动力冲击中的验证、敏感性与操作限制
AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个GPU加速的平面2D WCSPH求解器，用于模拟弹道速度下穿透受限液体的减速盘，揭示了其操作限制和误差来源，并证明其适用于快速参数化设计探索。
AI.motivation: 流体动力冲击（HRAM）加载是冲击力学中的一个持续挑战，现有研究难以在简化模型中获得令人信服的定量一致性，且未解决这种一致性是真实保真度还是离散化误差补偿的问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个平面2D、GPU加速的WCSPH求解器，采用Adami型幽灵粒子边界条件，并首次将其扩展到弹道速度下穿透受限液体通道的移动减速盘。该边界条件通过势流附加质量解和钢水界面的分析声反射系数进行了检验。进行了三点分辨率收敛性研究、全面的系数扫描、守恒诊断和O(N) GPU吞吐量缩放，并与900和600m/s下的文献证据进行了定性比较。
AI.result: 研究发现，刚性状态方程和空化截止对求解器在定量一致性方面的操作范围施加了可识别的界限。三点分辨率收敛性研究揭示了非单调的近探针压力峰值，归因于有界幽灵流体密度不一致性。全面的表征在3D中是不切实际的，但通过本文方法得以实现。与文献的定性比较澄清了承载与近似元素。能量诊断显示模拟窗口内总能量适度增长，流体吸收的能量远超弹丸释放的能量，这有助于绘制公式的操作范围。
AI.conclusion: 所开发的求解器，虽然局限于平面几何，但其经过验证和收敛性检查的性能，非常适合用于快速参数化设计探索。
AI.translation: 流体动力冲击（HRAM）加载在冲击力学中仍然是一个持续的挑战，这并非由于奇特的物理现象，而是因为在简化表示中难以获得令人信服的定量一致性。现有的研究通常采用单一网格和边界处理，并针对一个实验数据集进行验证，这使得一致性究竟反映了真实的保真度还是补偿性的离散化误差仍未解决。本工作提出了一个平面2D、GPU加速的WCSPH求解器，该求解器采用Adami型幽灵粒子边界条件，并首次将其扩展到以弹道速度穿透受限液体通道的移动减速盘。该边界条件通过专门导出的势流附加质量解和钢水界面的分析声反射系数进行检验；这项探索揭示了刚性状态方程和空化截止对求解器在定量一致性方面的操作范围施加了可识别的界限。一项三点分辨率收敛性研究揭示了非单调的近探针压力峰值，这归因于有界幽灵流体密度不一致性。全面的系数扫描、守恒诊断和O(N) GPU吞吐量缩放使得在3D中不切实际的详尽表征成为可能。与900和600m/s下文献证据的定性比较阐明了承载元素与近似元素。值得注意的是，能量诊断显示在模拟窗口内总能量适度增长，其中流体吸收的能量远超弹丸释放的能量——这是规定非反作用弹丸运动学的一个有益特征，有助于绘制公式的操作范围。由此产生的求解器，虽然局限于平面几何，但其经过验证和收敛性检查的性能，非常适合用于快速参数化设计探索。
AI.summary: 本文针对流体动力冲击（HRAM）加载在冲击力学中定量一致性难以实现的问题，开发并验证了一个GPU加速的平面2D WCSPH求解器。该求解器首次将Adami型幽灵粒子边界条件应用于弹道速度下穿透受限液体的移动减速盘模拟。研究通过多项验证和收敛性分析，揭示了刚性状态方程、空化截止以及幽灵流体密度不一致性对求解器操作范围和压力峰值的影响。尽管该模型限于平面几何，但其经过验证的性能和O(N) GPU吞吐量缩放使其成为HRAM快速参数化设计探索的有效工具。
AI.keywords: 流体动力冲击, WCSPH, GPU加速, 边界条件, 收敛性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于首次将GPU加速的WCSPH模型与Adami型幽灵粒子边界条件应用于流体动力冲击（HRAM）问题，并扩展到移动减速盘的模拟。其重要性在于通过详尽的验证和敏感性分析，明确了求解器的操作限制和误差来源，这对于提高数值模拟的可靠性和解释性至关重要。尽管模型局限于平面几何，但其快速参数化设计探索的能力，为未来更复杂的3D模拟奠定了基础。局限性在于未能解决3D复杂场景下的挑战。

title: Observability Analysis of Joint Steering and Extrinsic Calibration
summary: This technical report studies the local weak observability of a planar bicycle-model vehicle when vehicle pose, planar LiDAR extrinsic calibration, and steering-angle bias are estimated jointly. A Lie-derivative-based nonlinear observability analysis is used to examine stationary, straight-line, constant-curvature, and combined straight-plus-arc motion. The resulting observability matrices and nullspaces describe how pose, LiDAR translation and yaw offsets, and steering bias become coupled under different motion primitives. Stationary motion and individual motion primitives retain unobservable directions, whereas the combination of straight and curved motion removes the identified degeneracies and yields full local weak observability of the seven-state system. The analysis provides a theoretical basis for selecting calibration trajectories that sufficiently excite both steering and sensor-extrinsic parameters.

AI.title_translation: 联合转向和外参校准的可观测性分析
AI.tldr: 本报告研究了平面自行车模型车辆在联合估计车辆位姿、平面激光雷达外参校准和转向角偏差时的局部弱可观测性。分析表明，通过结合直线和曲线运动可以实现系统的完全可观测性。
AI.motivation: 研究联合估计车辆位姿、平面激光雷达外参校准和转向角偏差时系统的可观测性，并为选择能充分激发转向和传感器外参的校准轨迹提供理论基础。
AI.method: 采用基于李导数的非线性可观测性分析方法，研究了静止、直线、恒定曲率以及直线加弧线组合运动下的可观测性。
AI.result: 静止运动和单独的运动基元保留了不可观测的方向，而直线和曲线运动的结合消除了已识别的退化，并使七状态系统实现了完全的局部弱可观测性。位姿、激光雷达平移和偏航偏移以及转向偏差在不同运动基元下如何耦合。
AI.conclusion: 结合直线和曲线运动可以消除不可观测性，并实现七状态系统的完全局部弱可观测性，这为选择有效的校准轨迹提供了理论依据。
AI.translation: 本技术报告研究了当车辆位姿、平面激光雷达外参校准和转向角偏差联合估计时，平面自行车模型车辆的局部弱可观测性。采用基于李导数的非线性可观测性分析方法，研究了静止、直线、恒定曲率以及直线加弧线组合运动。由此产生的可观测性矩阵和零空间描述了位姿、激光雷达平移和偏航偏移以及转向偏差在不同运动基元下如何耦合。静止运动和单独的运动基元保留了不可观测的方向，而直线和曲线运动的结合消除了已识别的退化，并使七状态系统实现了完全的局部弱可观测性。该分析为选择能够充分激发转向和传感器外参的校准轨迹提供了理论基础。
AI.summary: 本报告对平面自行车模型车辆在联合估计位姿、激光雷达外参和转向角偏差时的局部弱可观测性进行了研究。通过基于李导数的非线性分析，发现单一运动模式存在不可观测性，但直线和曲线运动的组合能够实现七状态系统的完全局部弱可观测性。这项分析为选择有效的校准轨迹提供了理论支持。
AI.keywords: 可观测性分析, 联合校准, 转向偏差, 激光雷达外参, 自行车模型
AI.comments: 这项研究通过严谨的非线性可观测性分析，明确了在联合估计多参数系统中的关键运动模式。其创新之处在于揭示了特定运动组合（直线加曲线）对于消除不可观测方向的重要性，为自动驾驶和机器人领域中传感器校准和状态估计的轨迹设计提供了坚实的理论基础和实用指导。

title: A 1.283 Price-of-Anarchy Bound for the Repeated Virtual First-Price Auction
summary:
We study the repeated allocation of a single indivisible resource among $n$ strategic players. Each player $i$ has a privately known value distribution $D_i$, and values are drawn independently across players and periods. The goal is to find fair and efficient mechanisms.
  We apply the repeated first-price auction with equal initial endowments of virtual money. We show that each player can asymptotically secure the same fair-floor guarantee $f(D_i)$ as in Csóka 2026; consequently, the mechanism is $1.283$-optimal. This provides a simpler and more robust alternative mechanism for this special case and may also help derive sharper upper bounds on the price of anarchy.

AI.title_translation: 重复虚拟第一价格拍卖的1.283无政府状态价格界限
AI.tldr: 本文研究了在多玩家重复资源分配场景中，一种具有相等初始虚拟货币禀赋的重复第一价格拍卖机制。研究发现该机制能够渐进地确保每位玩家获得与现有研究相似的公平底线保证，并且实现了1.283的最优性，提供了一种更简单、更稳健的替代方案，并可能有助于提升无政府状态价格的上限研究。
AI.motivation: 目标是为在多个策略性玩家之间重复分配单一不可分割资源找到公平且高效的机制。
AI.method: 本文应用了具有相等初始虚拟货币禀赋的重复第一价格拍卖机制。
AI.result: 研究表明，每个玩家都能渐进地获得与Csóka 2026中相同的公平底线保证f(Di)；因此，该机制是1.283最优的。
AI.conclusion: 该机制为这种特殊情况提供了一种更简单、更稳健的替代方案，并可能有助于推导出更尖锐的无政府状态价格上限。
AI.translation: 我们研究了在n个策略性玩家之间重复分配单一不可分割资源的问题。每个玩家i都有一个私下已知的价值分布Di，并且价值在玩家和周期之间独立抽取。目标是找到公平高效的机制。我们应用了具有相等初始虚拟货币禀赋的重复第一价格拍卖。我们证明每个玩家都能渐进地获得与Csóka 2026中相同的公平底线保证f(Di)；因此，该机制是1.283最优的。这为这种特殊情况提供了一种更简单、更稳健的替代机制，也可能有助于推导出更尖锐的无政府状态价格上限。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在多玩家重复资源分配背景下，采用具有相等初始虚拟货币禀赋的重复第一价格拍卖机制。研究结果表明，该机制能够渐进地确保每个玩家获得与Csóka 2026研究中相同的公平底线保证，并且其性能达到了1.283的最优水平。这为特定场景提供了一种更为简化和鲁棒的机制选择，并有望促进对无政府状态价格更精确上限的探索。
AI.keywords: 重复拍卖, 虚拟第一价格拍卖, 无政府状态价格, 资源分配, 机制设计

title: A Survey on Adversarial Attacks and Defenses for Diffusion Models Across Multiple Modalities
comments: Accepted into Life-Cycle Intellectual Property Governance of Visual Generative Models Workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Diffusion models have become the dominant family of generative models in the visual domain. However, their widespread public availability enables misuse at scale, motivating a rapidly growing body of research on adversarial attacks and defenses. This survey provides, to our knowledge, the first unified review of this literature across three visual modalities: image, video, and 3D. We introduce a comprehensive, task-centric taxonomy: we first divide the literature by modality; within each modality, we separate methods into attacks and defenses, and then group them by the generative task they target, presenting them chronologically within each task. Moreover, we provide an in-depth analysis of their evaluation settings, consolidating the datasets, metrics, and benchmarks used to assess them. We conclude by identifying several open challenges and outlining concrete future research directions. Project Webpage: https://github.com/ozgurkara99/awesome-adv-attack-defense-on-diffusion
comment: Accepted into Life-Cycle Intellectual Property Governance of Visual Generative Models Workshop at ECCV 2026

AI.title_translation: 多模态扩散模型的对抗性攻击与防御综述
AI.tldr: 本文首次对跨图像、视频和3D三种视觉模态的扩散模型对抗性攻击与防御文献进行了统一综述，并提出了一个全面的任务中心分类法。

AI.method: 采用任务中心分类法，首先按模态（图像、视频、3D）划分文献，然后按攻击和防御分类，再按生成任务分组，并按时间顺序呈现。同时深入分析评估设置，整合数据集、指标和基准。
AI.result: 提供了对扩散模型对抗性攻击与防御文献的首次统一综述，建立了全面的分类法，并分析了评估设置。
AI.conclusion: 识别了若干开放挑战并提出了具体的未来研究方向。
AI.translation: 扩散模型已成为视觉领域生成模型的主导家族。然而，它们的广泛公开可用性使得大规模滥用成为可能，这促使对抗性攻击和防御方面的研究迅速增长。据我们所知，本综述首次对跨图像、视频和3D三种视觉模态的文献进行了统一回顾。我们引入了一个全面的、以任务为中心的分类法：我们首先按模态划分文献；在每种模态中，我们将方法分为攻击和防御，然后根据它们所针对的生成任务进行分组，并在每个任务中按时间顺序呈现。此外，我们对它们的评估设置进行了深入分析，整合了用于评估它们的数据集、指标和基准。最后，我们识别了几个开放挑战并概述了具体的未来研究方向。项目网页：https://github.com/ozgurkara99/awesome-adv-attack-defense-on-diffusion
AI.summary: 这篇综述首次系统地回顾了跨图像、视频和3D三种视觉模态的扩散模型对抗性攻击与防御研究。文章提出了一个任务中心的分类法，将文献按模态、攻击/防御类型和生成任务进行划分，并按时间顺序呈现。此外，综述还深入分析了评估设置、数据集、指标和基准，并指出了未来的研究方向和开放挑战。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 对抗性攻击, 对抗性防御, 视觉模态, 综述
AI.comments: 这篇综述填补了扩散模型对抗性研究领域的一个空白，首次提供了跨多模态的统一视角。其提出的任务中心分类法对于组织和理解该领域的复杂性非常有价值，并为未来的研究提供了清晰的方向。

title: SciLitBench: Benchmark and Design Principles for LLM-Powered Systematic Literature Reviews
comments: 22 pages, 6 figures, and 5 tables. Data and code are available at https://github.com/linlab/SciLitBench
summary: Systematic reviews require sustained human judgment across thousands of records, yet existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) typically examine review stages in isolation. We introduce SciLitBench, a multi-stage benchmark spanning title and abstract screening, full-text screening, and schema-guided data extraction, with 42,981 retrieved records, 1,012 full texts, and annotations for 888 included papers. Across 22 open-weight LLMs from six model families, explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria improve title and abstract screening $F_2$ by 28.8\%, while researcher-authored rationales improve full-text screening by 15\%. Data extraction reveals a different reliability regime: performance declines from 0.97 accuracy for publication year to 0.37 Jaccard overlap for computational approach, while the strongest models recover only 30\% of annotated evaluation evidence and 25\% of limitations. SciLitBench identifies a practical boundary between high-recall screening and evidence-complete extraction and provides a reproducible resource for evaluating LLM-assisted evidence synthesis.
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, and 5 tables. Data and code are available at https://github.com/linlab/SciLitBench

AI.title_translation: SciLitBench：LLM驱动的系统性文献综述的基准和设计原则
AI.tldr: SciLitBench是一个多阶段基准，用于评估LLM在系统性文献综述中的表现，发现LLM在筛选阶段表现良好，但在数据提取的可靠性上存在显著挑战，并为LLM辅助的证据综合提供了可复现资源。
AI.motivation: 系统性综述需要对数千条记录进行持续的人工判断，而现有的大型语言模型（LLM）评估通常孤立地考察综述阶段，缺乏对多阶段、完整流程的评估。
AI.method: 引入SciLitBench，一个多阶段基准，涵盖标题和摘要筛选、全文筛选以及基于模式的数据提取，包含42,981条检索记录、1,012篇全文和888篇纳入论文的注释。研究评估了来自六个模型家族的22个开源LLM。
AI.result: 明确的纳入和排除标准使标题和摘要筛选的$F_2$提高了28.8%；研究人员撰写的理由使全文筛选提高了15%；数据提取的可靠性不同，例如出版年份的准确率为0.97，而计算方法的Jaccard重叠度为0.37；最强的模型仅能恢复30%的带注释评估证据和25%的局限性。
AI.conclusion: SciLitBench确定了高召回率筛选和证据完整提取之间的实际界限，并为评估LLM辅助的证据综合提供了可复现资源。

AI.summary: 本文介绍了SciLitBench，一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在系统性文献综述中表现的多阶段基准。该基准涵盖标题和摘要筛选、全文筛选及数据提取，包含大量真实数据。研究发现，明确的筛选标准和人工理由能显著提高LLM在筛选阶段的性能，但在数据提取方面，LLM的可靠性差异很大，尤其在提取复杂信息时表现不佳。SciLitBench为LLM辅助的证据综合提供了评估工具，并指出了LLM在不同综述任务中的能力边界。
AI.keywords: LLM, 系统性文献综述, 基准, 数据提取, 筛选
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入一个全面的多阶段基准SciLitBench，填补了现有LLM评估在系统性文献综述领域中的空白，具有创新性。它明确指出了LLM在筛选任务中的潜力以及在复杂数据提取任务中的局限性，对未来LLM在科学文献分析中的应用具有重要指导意义。其提供的可复现资源对该领域的研究发展非常重要。

title: ECHO: Dyadic 3D Facial Motion Generation with Asymmetric Deterministic Articulation and Stochastic Reaction
comments: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26) as a poster presentation
summary: We propose ECHO for dyadic 3D facial motion generation under a strict dual-stream audio-only setting, formulating the problem as an asymmetric task involving speech-constrained articulation and one-to-many listener reactions. To address this asymmetry, ECHO decomposes motion into a deterministic anchor that captures stable speech-correlated structure and a stochastic residual that models the remaining one-to-many interaction dynamics. On top of this backbone, Motion Memory acts as a training-only regularizer during brief late-stage fine-tuning to provide local priors for weakly conditioned listening windows, while semantic-group scaling controls residual injection across expression, jaw, and neck. This design balances speaking-side articulatory fidelity with listening-side realism and diversity in a single generation process. Results from unified, state-wise, and ablation evaluations show that conversational 3D motion benefits from decomposing stable and uncertain components rather than applying stochasticity uniformly. ECHO provides a practical formulation and technical basis for deployable conversational digital humans under strict audio-only conditions.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26) as a poster presentation

AI.title_translation: ECHO：具有非对称确定性发音和随机反应的双人3D面部动作生成
AI.tldr: ECHO通过将动作分解为确定性发音和随机反应，在纯音频设置下生成逼真且多样的双人3D面部动作，并证明这种分解优于统一的随机性。
AI.motivation: 在严格的双流纯音频设置下，解决双人3D面部动作生成中的不对称问题，即语音约束的发音与一对多听者反应之间的差异。
AI.method: ECHO将动作分解为捕捉语音相关结构的确定性锚点和模拟一对多交互动力学的随机残差。通过运动记忆（Motion Memory）作为正则化器提供局部先验，并利用语义组缩放控制表情、下颌和颈部的残差注入，以平衡说话方发音保真度与听者方真实性和多样性。
AI.result: 统一、状态感知和消融评估结果表明，对话式3D动作受益于分解稳定和不确定分量，而不是统一应用随机性。
AI.conclusion: ECHO为在严格纯音频条件下部署对话式数字人提供了实用的公式和技术基础，通过有效处理双人面部动作生成中的不对称性和随机性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了ECHO，用于在严格的双流纯音频设置下生成双人3D面部动作，将问题表述为一个涉及语音约束发音和一对多听者反应的非对称任务。为了解决这种不对称性，ECHO将动作分解为捕捉稳定语音相关结构的确定性锚点和模拟剩余一对多交互动力学的随机残差。在此骨干之上，运动记忆（Motion Memory）在短暂的后期微调期间作为仅用于训练的正则化器，为弱条件下的听者窗口提供局部先验；同时，语义组缩放控制表情、下颌和颈部的残差注入。这种设计在单个生成过程中平衡了说话方的发音保真度与听者方的真实性和多样性。统一、状态感知和消融评估的结果表明，对话式3D动作受益于分解稳定和不确定分量，而不是统一应用随机性。ECHO为在严格纯音频条件下部署对话式数字人提供了实用的公式和技术基础。
AI.summary: ECHO是一种用于纯音频双人3D面部动作生成的模型，它通过将动作分解为确定性发音和随机反应来解决不对称问题。该模型引入了运动记忆和语义组缩放，以平衡说话者发音的准确性与听者反应的真实性和多样性。实验结果表明，这种分解方法在生成对话式3D动作方面优于统一随机性，为纯音频条件下的可部署数字人提供了技术基础。
AI.keywords: 双人3D面部动作, 非对称生成, 确定性发音, 随机反应, 纯音频
AI.comments: ECHO的创新之处在于其非对称分解策略，将确定性发音与随机反应分离，并引入运动记忆和语义组缩放来精细控制动作生成。这对于在纯音频条件下创建逼真且多样化的数字人具有重要意义。该方法通过分解稳定和不确定分量，有效提升了生成效果，为数字人领域提供了新的思路。

title: When Do Options Help? Policy Necrosis and Redundant Coverage in Option-Critic
summary: Option-critic learns options: sub-policies together with a learned rule for when each one hands control back. Its headline result is that performance improves as options are added. We explain that result, with theory and experiment. First, the termination rule option-critic learns by maximising return contributes nothing. When the termination test and the policy that picks options read the same values, the test fires at every step, so the learned rule is identical to always terminating. When that policy explores and the test does not, as in option-critic itself, the rule can block the exploration; there are instances where it suffers $Ω(T)$ regret while always terminating holds to $O(\log T)$. Forcing termination at every step leaves the option-count curve intact. Second, the policy inside an option barely explores at all, so a state locks onto the first action that looked good and never updates again. We name this policy necrosis, give a state-level test for it, and find three fifths of states necrotic in a typical option. Restoring exploration repairs those states, and one option then solves the task. Third, extra options improve no option; what falls is the chance that all of them fail in the same state, from $59\\%$ to $4\\%$, and performance follows that joint quantity.

AI.title_translation: 选项何时起作用？Option-Critic中的政策坏死与冗余覆盖
AI.tldr: Option-Critic性能提升并非源于学习到的终止规则，而是由于多选项带来的冗余覆盖降低了失效概率，且选项内部常出现阻碍学习的“策略坏死”。
AI.motivation: 旨在通过理论和实验解释Option-Critic算法的核心现象——为什么增加选项数量会提升性能。
AI.method: 结合理论分析与实验评估，考察了Option-Critic中的终止规则效率、状态级策略坏死现象以及多选项的冗余覆盖效应。
AI.result: 研究发现：1. 学到的终止规则并无实际贡献，甚至可能阻碍探索；2. 选项内部策略存在严重的“策略坏死”现象（约五分之三的状态）；3. 额外选项带来的性能提升本质上是因为降低了所有选项在同一状态下同时失效的概率（冗余覆盖）。
AI.conclusion: Option-Critic的性能提升并非源于其复杂的终止规则或分层学习的优势，而是由于冗余覆盖降低了全盘失败的概率，且通过引入充分探索可以用单个选项替代大量选项。
AI.translation: Option-critic 学习选项：子策略以及关于何时交回控制权的学得规则。其最引人注目的结果是，随着选项的增加，性能会有所提高。我们通过理论和实验解释了这一结果。首先，option-critic 通过最大化回报学到的终止规则毫无贡献。当终止测试和选择选项的策略读取相同的值时，测试在每一步都会触发，因此学到的规则等同于始终终止。当该策略进行探索而测试不进行探索时（如 option-critic 本身），该规则会阻碍探索；在某些情况下，它会遭受 $\Omega(T)$ 的遗憾，而始终保持终止的遗憾则为 $O(\log T)$。在每一步强制终止会使选项数量曲线保持完好。其次，选项内部的策略几乎不进行探索，因此状态会锁定在第一个看起来不错的动作上，并且再也不会更新。我们将此策略命名为坏死（necrosis），给出了它的状态级测试，并发现典型选项中五分之三的状态都是坏死的。恢复探索可以修复这些状态，然后一个选项就可以解决任务。第三，额外的选项不会改进任何选项；下降的是所有选项在同一状态下都失败的概率（从 $59\%$ 降至 $4\%$），并且性能遵循该联合数量。
AI.summary: 本文通过理论与实验研究了解Option-Critic算法中增加选项提升性能的原因。研究发现，算法中的终止规则贡献甚微甚至阻碍探索，选项内部容易出现“策略坏死”，而增加选项的真正益处在于通过冗余覆盖降低了共同失效的概率。
AI.keywords: Option-Critic, 强化学习, 策略坏死, 冗余覆盖, 选项终止规则
AI.comments: 本文通过理论和实验深入剖析了Option-Critic算法中选项数量增加带来性能提升的内在机制，揭示了终止规则失效、策略坏死以及冗余覆盖等关键问题，对理解分层强化学习具有重要意义。

title: Memory as Infrastructure: Reliability Engineering for Persistent Agent Memory in Months-Long LLM-Assisted Development
summary:
LLM coding agents are crossing from task-scale to project-scale: single assisted efforts that run for months, across repeated context compactions, on codebases far larger than any context window. We report operational experience from one such effort (a research project under a single continuous Claude Code session line since January 2026, driving a 633,000-line codebase, with its memory subsystem continuously instrumented since July 2026) and describe SIx Harness, the open-source memory and continuity infrastructure that emerged from keeping it coherent.
  The harness combines per-project long-term memory (hybrid lexical-vector retrieval over SQLite, fully local), precision-gated context injection, anti-recurrence stores for decisions and dead-ends, conventions engineered to survive compaction, and, the part we argue is missing from operational practice, reliability engineering for the memory subsystem itself: a session-start health gate with discriminated failure modes, heartbeat telemetry designed so that no enumerated failure mode can pass unrecorded, and alert-fatigue budgeting borrowed from SRE practice.
  We present what we believe is the first months-scale instrumented operational record of a persistent agent-memory subsystem in production development use: 78,933 hook invocations; 85 recorded failures, none silent: 84 in the subsystem's first three weeks, one since, none in the final 20 days; an injection layer whose ten-day precision instrument shows zero false fires against an intact denominator; and three production incidents traced from instrument reading to structural fix. From the record we distill seven design principles, state our limitations plainly (N=1, no control arm, self-reported), and publish a tagged pre-registered ablation protocol that any team can run with the released MIT-licensed kit.

AI.title_translation: 记忆作为基础设施：面向数月级LLM辅助开发的持久化智能体记忆可靠性工程
AI.tldr: 本论文将SRE（站点可靠性工程）原则引入大语言模型（LLM）的持久化记忆系统，通过开源的SIx Harness基础设施解决了长达数月的AI代码开发中的记忆连贯与可靠性难题。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM编码智能体从任务级走向项目级（运行数月、代码库超大、需经历多次上下文压缩），如何确保持久化记忆的可靠性、连贯性和系统稳定性成为亟待解决的工程空白。
AI.method: 开发了SIx Harness开源基础设施，结合了项目级长期混合检索记忆、精确门控上下文注入、防复发存储、抗压缩规范，以及SRE风格的健康门控、心跳遥测和告警预算。
AI.result: 通过78,933次钩子调用和数月的生产运行数据表明，系统故障率极低且受控（前三周84次，此后仅1次，最后20天零故障），注入层精度达零误报，并成功追踪并修复了生产事故，总结出七大设计原则。
AI.conclusion: 通过将SRE原则应用于智能体记忆管理，SIx Harness成功实现了长达数月的稳定大模型代码开发，证明了可靠性工程对于持久化智能体记忆至关重要。
AI.translation:
LLM编码智能体正从任务级跨越到项目级：单次辅助工作持续数月、经历反复的上下文压缩，并在远超任何上下文窗口的代码库上运行。我们报告了一个此类工作的运维经验（一个自2026年1月以来在单个连续Claude Code会话线下的研究项目，驱动着633,000行的代码库，其记忆子系统自2026年7月起持续进行仪器化监测），并描述了SIx Harness，这是为保持其连贯性而诞生的开源记忆与连续性基础设施。
该工具 harness 结合了每个项目的长期记忆（基于SQLite的完全本地混合词法-向量检索）、精确门控的上下文注入、用于决策和死胡经的防复发存储、经受得住压缩考验的工程规范，以及我们认为当前运维实践中所缺失的记忆子系统可靠性工程：具有可辨别故障模式的会话启动健康门控、旨在确保任何枚举故障模式都不会无记录通过的心跳遥测，以及借鉴自SRE实践的告警疲劳预算。
我们呈现了我们认为是生产开发中首次针对持久化智能体记忆子系统的数月级仪器化运维记录：78,933次钩子调用；85次记录的故障，无一次是静默失败：子系统前三周有84次，此后1次，最后20天为零；一个十天精度监测显示在完整分母下零误报的注入层；以及从仪器读数追踪到结构性修复的三起生产事故。从该记录中，我们提炼出七大设计原则，坦诚了我们的局限性（N=1，无对照组，自我报告），并发布了一个带有标记的预注册消融协议，任何团队都可以使用发布的MIT许可工具包来运行。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM编码智能体在数月长周期项目开发中面临的记忆维持难题，介绍了SIx Harness——一种引入站点可靠性工程（SRE）理念的持久化记忆与连续性基础设施。通过对生产环境运行数据的长期观测与优化，该系统有效解决了上下文压缩带来的记忆衰减与不一致问题，为长周期AI辅助开发提供了可靠的工程范式。
AI.keywords: 大模型编码智能体, 持久化记忆, 可靠性工程, 上下文压缩, 软件工程基础设施
AI.comments: 该论文首次从长达数月的真实开发场景出发，将站点可靠性工程（SRE）的理念引入大模型智能体的记忆基础设施中，填补了该领域的空白。通过严密的度量、故障追踪和开源实践，为解决LLM长效记忆的连贯性与可靠性提供了极具价值的工程范式。

title: SCAFFOLD: Self-Improving Web Agents via Recursive Parametric Skill Abstraction
summary: Web agents need to navigate visually rich, long-horizon interfaces that change across sites, yet most previous agents still learn each task in isolation and discard the procedural knowledge they accumulate. Recent skill-augmented frameworks take an important first step, but they treat the skill library as a flat or two-tier prompt-side cache and offer no principled mechanism for compressing redundancy or composing skills recursively. We introduce \textsc{Scaffold}, a self-improving framework for visual web agents that (i) induces parametric, executable skills from successful trajectories under a multi-instance abstraction constraint, (ii) maintains a recursively composed hierarchy in which higher-level skills invoke lower-level ones, (iii) compacts the library via a minimum-description-length (MDL) criterion and behavioral equivalence checking, and (iv) periodically distills skill-augmented trajectories back into model weights to internalize the abstractions. Across WebArena, VisualWebArena, and a held-out split of Online-Mind2Web, \textsc{Scaffold} improves success rate by $11.1$--$17.2$ absolute points over the strongest skill-augmented baseline and shows monotonic gains across five self-improvement iterations without library collapse. We release the code and documents in the Github \href{https://github.com/BokwaiHo/SCAFFOLD}{repository}.

AI.title_translation: SCAFFOLD：通过递归参数化技能抽象实现自改进的网络代理
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为SCAFFOLD的自改进框架，用于视觉网络代理。它通过递归组合和压缩来学习、组织和内部化可执行的技能，从而克服了现有方法的局限性。实验结果表明，SCAFFOLD在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法，并且在自我改进过程中表现出持续的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有网络代理在处理视觉丰富、长时序且多变的界面时存在局限性，通常孤立地学习任务，丢弃积累的程序性知识。虽然技能增强框架取得了一定进展，但它们将技能库视为扁平或两层缓存，缺乏压缩冗余和递归组合技能的机制。
AI.method: SCAFFOLD框架包含四个关键组成部分：1. 在多实例抽象约束下，从成功的轨迹中诱导参数化、可执行的技能。2. 维护一个递归组合的层次结构，高层技能调用低层技能。3. 通过最小描述长度（MDL）标准和行为等价性检查来压缩技能库。4. 定期将技能增强的轨迹蒸馏回模型权重，以内化抽象。
AI.result: 在WebArena、VisualWebArena和Online-Mind2Web的独立测试集上，SCAFFOLD相比最强的技能增强基线，成功率提高了11.1-17.2个绝对百分点。在五个自我改进迭代过程中，性能持续提升，且技能库没有崩溃。
AI.conclusion: SCAFFOLD框架通过引入参数化技能、递归组合、库压缩和内化抽象等机制，有效解决了现有网络代理在处理复杂网络任务时的局限性，并在多个基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升和持续的自我改进能力。
AI.translation: 网络代理需要浏览视觉丰富、长时序且跨站点变化的界面，但大多数之前的代理仍然孤立地学习每个任务，并丢弃它们积累的程序性知识。最近的技能增强框架迈出了重要一步，但它们将技能库视为一个扁平的或两层的提示端缓存，并且没有提供压缩冗余或递归组合技能的原则性机制。我们引入了 extsc{Scaffold}，一个用于视觉网络代理的自改进框架，它（i）在多实例抽象约束下，从成功的轨迹中诱导参数化、可执行的技能，（ii）维护一个递归组合的层次结构，其中高层技能调用低层技能，（iii）通过最小描述长度（MDL）标准和行为等价性检查来压缩库，（iv）定期将技能增强的轨迹蒸馏回模型权重以内化抽象。在WebArena、VisualWebArena和Online-Mind2Web的一个独立测试集上， extsc{Scaffold}相比最强的技能增强基线，成功率提高了11.1-17.2个绝对百分点，并在五个自我改进迭代过程中显示出单调的收益，且没有出现库崩溃。我们在Github 仓库中发布了代码和文档。
AI.summary: SCAFFOLD是一个创新的自改进框架，用于解决视觉网络代理在处理复杂、动态网络界面时的挑战。它通过递归地学习、组织和压缩可执行的技能，形成一个分层结构，并能将这些技能内化到模型中。实验证明，SCAFFOLD在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法，并且能够持续自我改进。
AI.keywords: 网络代理, 技能抽象, 递归组合, 自我改进, SCAFFOLD
AI.comments: 该研究提出的SCAFFOLD框架在网络代理领域具有重要意义，其核心创新在于引入了递归参数化技能抽象和自我改进机制。通过将技能组织成可递归调用的层次结构，并利用MDL原则进行压缩，有效解决了现有方法中技能库冗余和缺乏组合性的问题。将技能蒸馏回模型权重以内化抽象的思路也为代理的长期学习和适应性提供了新的途径。然而，递归组合的深度和复杂度如何影响性能，以及在更广泛、更复杂的真实世界场景中的泛化能力，是未来值得进一步探索的方向。

title: Reasoning-Aware Compression: Identifying and Protecting Vulnerable Reasoning Circuits for Energy-Efficient LLM Deployment
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) impose substantial energy costs during deployment, yet current compression methods apply uniform quantization across all components, risking damage to critical reasoning circuits. We present a reasoning-aware compression framework that benchmarks quantization conditions across five reasoning benchmarks, GSM8K, FOLIO, MATH-500, ProofWriter, and MuSiQue, with hardware-level GPU energy measurement; profiles per-module INT4 vulnerability across all 196-224 (layer, projection) pairs via a perturbation sweep on a held-out calibration split, then selectively restores the most sensitive circuits to FP16. Three findings emerge. First, INT4 quantization can increase energy by extending reasoning chains; a 25% power reduction becomes a net energy increase on GSM8K. Second, vulnerability is task-dependent: attention projections are more critical for mathematical reasoning, and sensitivity patterns differ by architecture in logical inference. Third, selective compression achieves Pareto-optimal points inaccessible to uniform methods: R1-Qwen-7B Top-10% on ProofWriter gains +12 pp over FP16 at -9.7% energy, validated on held-out data across five reasoning benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 考虑推理的压缩：识别和保护脆弱的推理电路以实现节能型LLM部署
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种考虑推理的压缩框架，通过识别和保护大型推理模型中对INT4量化敏感的推理电路，实现比统一量化更优的节能效果和性能。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRM）在部署过程中会产生巨大的能源成本，然而目前的压缩方法对所有组件都采用统一量化，这可能会损害关键的推理电路。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个考虑推理的压缩框架，该框架在五个推理基准（GSM8K, FOLIO, MATH-500, ProofWriter, MuSiQue）上对量化条件进行基准测试，并进行硬件级GPU能耗测量；通过在保留的校准分割上进行扰动扫描，分析所有196-224个（层、投影）对的每个模块INT4脆弱性，然后选择性地将最敏感的电路恢复到FP16。
AI.result: 1. INT4量化可能通过延长推理链而增加能耗；在GSM8K上，25%的功耗降低反而导致净能耗增加。2. 脆弱性是任务依赖的：注意力投影对数学推理更关键，敏感性模式在逻辑推理中因架构而异。3. 选择性压缩实现了统一方法无法达到的帕累托最优，例如R1-Qwen-7B在ProofWriter上Top-10%比FP16性能提高+12 pp，能耗降低-9.7%，并在五个推理基准的保留数据上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别和选择性保护大型推理模型中的关键推理电路，可以实现比传统统一量化方法更优的能效和性能平衡，从而实现节能的LLM部署。
AI.translation: 大型推理模型（LRM）在部署过程中会产生巨大的能源成本，然而目前的压缩方法对所有组件都采用统一量化，这可能会损害关键的推理电路。我们提出了一个考虑推理的压缩框架，该框架在GSM8K、FOLIO、MATH-500、ProofWriter和MuSiQue这五个推理基准上对量化条件进行基准测试，并进行硬件级GPU能耗测量；通过在保留的校准分割上进行扰动扫描，分析所有196-224个（层、投影）对的每个模块INT4脆弱性，然后选择性地将最敏感的电路恢复到FP16。出现了三个发现。首先，INT4量化可能通过延长推理链而增加能耗；在GSM8K上，25%的功耗降低反而导致净能耗增加。其次，脆弱性是任务依赖的：注意力投影对数学推理更关键，敏感性模式在逻辑推理中因架构而异。第三，选择性压缩实现了统一方法无法达到的帕累托最优：R1-Qwen-7B在ProofWriter上Top-10%比FP16性能提高+12 pp，能耗降低-9.7%，并在五个推理基准的保留数据上得到验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种考虑推理的压缩框架，旨在解决大型推理模型部署中的高能耗问题及现有统一量化方法对关键推理电路的损害。该框架通过在多个推理基准上测量GPU能耗并分析各模块INT4量化的脆弱性，选择性地将敏感电路恢复至FP16。研究发现，INT4量化可能增加能耗，脆弱性具有任务依赖性，而选择性压缩能够实现比统一方法更优的能效与性能平衡，例如在ProofWriter上性能提升12个百分点同时能耗降低9.7%。
AI.keywords: 推理感知压缩, 量化, 大型推理模型, 能效, 脆弱性分析
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入“考虑推理的压缩”概念，创新性地解决了大型语言模型量化中能效与推理性能的矛盾。其核心贡献在于识别并保护了对推理至关重要的电路，避免了统一量化可能导致的负面影响。该方法通过精细化地量化策略，为未来LLM的节能部署提供了新的思路和实践方案，具有重要的理论和实际意义。

title: When and What to Teach: Budget-Aware Online Adaptation for Web Agents
summary: Web agents have achieved significant success in automating complex internet tasks but deploying them in real-world environments requires continuous online adaptation. Given that deploying powerful proprietary models remains commercially cost-prohibitive, practitioners must rely on lightweight local models that evolve post-deployment via online teaching from a stronger teacher. However, standard interactive feedback imposes prohibitive costs. We show that conventional trajectory-level preference optimization wastes budget on both unresolvable episodes and redundant execution turns. To resolve these inefficiencies, we propose \textbf{Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming}, a budget-aware framework that systematically orchestrates \textbf{when} and \textbf{what} to teach. Specifically, our framework integrates a solvability-aware teacher gate to dictate \textbf{when} to query the teacher model and a score-guided turn selection mechanism to decide \textbf{what} informative turns to retain. Extensive experiments on MiniWoB and TimeWarp demonstrate that our method achieves comparable first-pass success while reducing teacher calls by 22.6\% and student training compute by 52.1\% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjw131f1fc/budgeted-online-teaching.

AI.title_translation: 何时以及教授什么：面向Web代理的预算感知在线适应
AI.tldr: 在部署强大的专有模型成本过高的情况下，研究人员必须依赖轻量级的本地模型，这些模型在部署后通过更强的教师进行在线教学。然而，标准的交互式反馈成本过高。本研究提出了一种名为“评分引导在线教学与预算轨迹修剪”的预算感知框架，该框架系统地协调“何时”以及“教授什么”。该框架集成了可解性感知的教师门控来决定何时查询教师模型，以及评分引导的轮次选择机制来决定保留哪些信息轮次。实验表明，该方法在实现可比的首次通过成功率的同时，平均教师调用次数减少了 22.6%，学生训练计算量减少了 52.1%。
AI.motivation: 在部署强大的专有模型成本过高的情况下，需要一种更具成本效益的方法来在线教学和调整轻量级的Web代理模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“评分引导在线教学与预算轨迹修剪”的预算感知框架，该框架包括一个可解性感知的教师门控来决定何时查询教师模型，以及一个评分引导的轮次选择机制来决定保留哪些信息轮次。
AI.result: 在MiniWoB和TimeWarp上的实验表明，该方法在实现可比的首次通过成功率的同时，平均教师调用次数减少了 22.6%，学生训练计算量减少了 52.1%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的预算感知框架“评分引导在线教学与预算轨迹修剪”能够有效地减少在线教学过程中的教师调用和学生训练计算量，同时保持 Web 代理的性能。
AI.translation: Web代理在自动化复杂的互联网任务方面取得了显著的成功，但在现实环境中部署它们需要持续的在线适应。考虑到部署强大的专有模型在商业上仍然成本过高，从业者必须依赖轻量级的本地模型，这些模型在部署后通过更强的教师进行在线教学来演变。然而，标准的交互式反馈会带来高昂的成本。我们表明，传统的轨迹级偏好优化在无法解决的剧集和冗余的执行轮次上浪费了预算。为了解决这些低效率问题，我们提出了	extbf{评分引导在线教学与预算轨迹修剪}，一个预算感知的框架，系统地协调	extbf{何时}和	extbf{教授什么}。具体来说，我们的框架集成了可解性感知的教师门控来决定	extbf{何时}查询教师模型，以及评分引导的轮次选择机制来决定保留	extbf{什么}信息轮次。在MiniWoB和TimeWarp上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在实现可比的首次通过成功率的同时，平均教师调用次数减少了 22.6%，学生训练计算量减少了 52.1%。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/zjw131f1fc/budgeted-online-teaching 获取。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为“评分引导在线教学与预算轨迹修剪”的预算感知框架，用于优化 Web 代理的在线适应过程。该框架通过智能地决定何时查询教师模型（使用可解性感知的教师门控）和保留哪些信息轮次（使用评分引导的轮次选择），有效解决了传统在线反馈方法中的成本和效率问题。实验结果表明，该方法在保持性能的同时，显著减少了教师调用和计算资源消耗。
AI.keywords: Web代理,在线适应,预算感知,教师引导,成本效益
AI.comments: 该研究解决了 Web 代理在线适应中的一个重要实际问题——成本效益。通过提出一个明确的框架来优化教学过程，该研究为开发更经济高效的 AI 代理提供了有价值的见解。然而，该方法在不同类型 Web 代理或更复杂的任务上的泛化能力仍有待进一步研究。

title: The Failure Happens Before the Drift: The Social Dynamics of Values in LLM Agent Societies
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used as proxies for human participants in social science research, yet it remains unclear whether they can faithfully simulate diverse and conflicting human value systems. We present a World Values Survey (WVS)-grounded simulation framework where culturally diverse agents with different communication styles engage in longitudinal, value-laden discussions. Across approximately 4,000 conversations involving 1,200 personas, 15 topics, and three models (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Gemma-4-E4B), we evaluate value faithfulness, value drift, and conversational realism. We find that more than 50\% of personas fail to express their assigned WVS profiles from the outset, while 2-7\% drift after repeated conversations. Ablations removing demographic details improve faithfulness for some models but do not change the broader trend: simulated value distributions still systematically deviate from the assigned WVS profiles. Compared to human discussions, simulated dialogues show a different trade-off between stylistic consistency and semantic diversity, often producing content-wise varied but stylistically repetitive exchanges. These findings suggest that current LLM agents can generate plausible conversations, but remain limited proxies for representing and preserving diverse human value profiles over time.

AI.title_translation: 失败发生在漂移之前：LLM代理社会中的价值观动态
AI.tldr: LLM代理在模拟人类价值观方面存在局限性，超过一半的代理从一开始就未能准确表达其设定的价值观，并且对话的风格和语义多样性与人类存在差异。
AI.motivation: 评估LLM代理在模拟人类多样化和冲突的价值观系统方面的能力，以及它们在长期对话中保持这些价值观的能力。
AI.method: 使用基于世界价值观调查（WVS）的模拟框架，让具有不同沟通风格的文化多样化LLM代理就15个话题进行长期的、带有价值观的讨论。通过大约4000次对话，涉及1200个虚拟角色和三种模型（GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Flash和Gemma-4-E4B），评估价值观的忠实度、价值观漂移和对话的真实性。
AI.result: 超过50%的代理从一开始就未能准确表达其设定的WVS价值观，只有2-7%的代理在多次对话后出现价值观漂移。移除人口统计学细节信息可以提高某些模型的价值观忠实度，但总体趋势不变，模拟的价值观分布仍系统性地偏离设定的WVS档案。与人类讨论相比，模拟对话在风格一致性和语义多样性之间呈现出不同的权衡，通常产生内容多样但风格重复的交流。
AI.conclusion: 当前的LLM代理虽然能够生成看似合理的对话，但在代表和长期保持多样化的人类价值观方面仍然是有限的代理。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的代理越来越多地被用作社会科学研究中人类参与者的替代品，但它们能否忠实地模拟多样化和冲突的人类价值观体系尚不清楚。我们提出了一个基于世界价值观调查（WVS）的模拟框架，其中具有不同沟通风格的文化多样化代理进行长期的、带有价值观的讨论。在约4000次对话中，涉及1200个虚拟角色、15个话题和三种模型（GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Flash和Gemma-4-E4B），我们评估了价值观的忠实度、价值观漂移和对话的真实性。我们发现，超过50%的虚拟角色从一开始就未能表达其设定的WVS档案，而2-7%的代理在重复对话后出现漂移。移除人口统计学细节信息可以提高某些模型的忠实度，但并未改变更广泛的趋势：模拟的价值观分布仍然系统性地偏离设定的WVS档案。与人类讨论相比，模拟对话在风格一致性和语义多样性之间呈现出不同的权衡，通常产生内容多样但风格重复的交流。这些发现表明，当前的LLM代理可以生成看似合理的对话，但在代表和长期保持多样化的人类价值观方面仍然是有限的替代品。
AI.summary: 本研究评估了LLM代理在模拟和维持多样化人类价值观方面的能力。研究发现，超过一半的代理从一开始就无法准确表达其设定的价值观，并且在长期对话中，模拟对话在风格和语义多样性上与人类存在差异，表明LLM代理在作为人类价值观的替代品方面存在局限性。
AI.keywords: LLM代理,价值观模拟,社会动态,对话真实性,世界价值观调查
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了LLM代理在模拟复杂人类社会动态方面的重大挑战，特别是对价值观的准确表征和长期保持。研究结果强调了在将LLM代理用于社会科学研究时需要谨慎，并指出了未来研究需要解决的关键问题，例如如何提高代理对人类价值观的忠实度以及如何改善对话的真实性。

title: Multi-robot Learning-based Informative Path Planning Using Spatio-Temporal Gaussian Process Kalman Filter
summary: Multi-robot informative path planning (IPP) for persistent target monitoring requires robots to reason about spatial uncertainty, temporal evolution, and practical sensing and communication constraints. Recent learning-based multi-robot IPP methods use Gaussian Processes (GPs) for target uncertainty, but often rely on simplified sensing models and centralized belief updates. We propose a grid-based spatio-temporal GP-Kalman filtering framework for learning-based multi-robot IPP. Instead of maintaining one GP per target, we represent anonymous target presence as a single latent field over a discrete workspace grid. The proposed recursive update considers all visible cells inside a camera footprint and supports arbitrary fields of view and range-dependent noise. A GP-consistent temporal process update accounts for moving targets and stale information by inflating uncertainty over time. For decentralized deployment, each robot maintains its own mapper and exchanges compact belief summaries rather than raw measurements. Received beliefs are fused using diagonal covariance intersection to remain conservative under unknown inter-robot correlations. We integrate the mapper with a reinforcement-learning policy for graph-based neighbor selection. Simulation benchmarks show about 20% lower average target uncertainty and improved target visitation compared with learning-based and classical auction/coverage baselines. Real-world two-UAV experiments demonstrate transfer to outdoor multi-robot search over a large field of more than 7000 square meters.

AI.title_translation: 基于时空高斯过程卡尔曼滤波的多机器人学习型信息路径规划
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于多机器人信息路径规划的时空高斯过程卡尔曼滤波框架，结合强化学习策略，显著降低了目标不确定性并在真实户外环境中得到验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于学习的多机器人信息路径规划（IPP）方法在处理持续目标监测时，通常依赖于简化的传感模型和集中的信念更新，未能很好地兼顾空间不确定性、时间演化、实际传感和通信约束。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于网格的时空高斯过程卡尔曼滤波框架，使用单个潜在场表示匿名目标存在，支持任意视场和距离相关噪声；结合GP一致的时间过程更新来处理移动目标；在去中心化部署中利用对角协方差交叉融合信念；并与用于基于图的邻居选择的强化学习策略相结合。
AI.result: 仿真基准测试表明，该方法的平均目标目标不确定性降低了约20%，并且目标访问率得到了提升；真实世界的双UAV实验成功展示了其在超过7000平方米大面积户外多机器人搜索中的迁移应用。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的时空高斯过程卡尔曼滤波与强化学习相结合的框架，有效解决了多机器人持续目标监测中的不确定性推理、时空演化及通信约束问题，具有优异的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 用于持续目标监测的多机器人信息路径规划（IPP）需要机器人对空间不确定性、时间演变以及实际的传感和通信约束进行推理。近期的基于学习的多机器人IPP方法使用高斯过程（GPs）来处理目标不确定性，但通常依赖于简化的传感模型和集中的信念更新。我们提出了一种用于基于学习的多机器人IPP的基于网格的时空GP-卡尔曼滤波框架。该框架不为每个目标维护一个GP，而是将匿名目标的存在表示为离散工作空间网格上的单一潜在场。所提出的递归更新考虑了相机视场内的所有可见单元，并支持任意视场和距离相关的噪声。GP一致的时间过程更新通过随时间膨胀不确定性来处理移动目标和陈旧信息。对于去中心化部署，每个机器人维护自己的映射器，并交换紧凑的信念摘要而不是原始测量值。接收到的信念使用对角协方差交叉进行融合，以便在未知的机器人间相关性下保持保守。我们将该映射器与用于基于图的邻居选择的强化学习策略相集成。仿真基准测试显示，与基于学习和经典的拍卖/覆盖基线相比，平均目标不确定性降低了约20%，并且提高了目标访问率。真实世界的两架无人机实验证明了其向超过7000平方米大面积的户外多机器人搜索的迁移能力。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于时空高斯过程卡尔曼滤波的多机器人信息路径规划框架，通过将匿名目标存在建模为单一潜在场，并结合递归更新、时间不确定性膨胀、去中心化协方差交叉融合及强化学习策略，实现了高效的持续目标监测。
AI.keywords: 多机器人系统, 信息路径规划, 时空高斯过程, 卡尔曼滤波, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个基于时空高斯过程卡尔曼滤波的多机器人信息路径规划框架，创新点在于将潜在场建模、递归更新与强化学习相结合，并支持去中心化部署与协方差交叉融合，在仿真和真实无人机实验中均验证了优越性能。

title: An Exploratory Study of Frequency-Aware Task Weighting for YOLOv8-Based Unified Driving Perception
summary:
Unified perception enables autonomous driving systems to perform object detection, drivable-area segmentation, and lane segmentation within a single network, improving efficiency and reducing deployment complexity. Jointly optimizing multiple perception tasks remains challenging because tasks exhibit different convergence rates, loss scales, and optimization stability. Existing task-weighting methods use loss magnitude, learned uncertainty, short-term loss changes, or gradient statistics; here, we explore the frequency structure of a recent loss-history window as a complementary signal.
  We implement and examine Frequency-aware Task Weighting (FTW), a dynamic task-balancing rule that estimates a loss-trajectory stability proxy from the low-frequency energy ratio of recent loss histories. FTW assigns larger weights to tasks whose mean-centered loss trajectories contain a larger proportion of low-frequency power. We document FTW and two baselines under full-network static training and progressive freezing using a unified YOLOv8-based perception framework with three task-specific heads.
  Experiments on Mapillary Vistas compare FTW with fixed and uncertainty-based weighting under both configurations. Final holdout metrics are reported for the checkpoint with the lowest per-epoch validation loss in each run. Across six single-run configurations, static FTW has the largest derived overall score and lane mIoU, progressive FTW has the largest detection mAP, and static uncertainty weighting has the largest drivable-area mIoU. Without repeated-seed estimates, single-task baselines, or FTW ablations, these rankings are descriptive. The evidence supports the feasibility of loss-frequency-based weighting in this pipeline, but does not establish improvement over the baselines or generalization beyond the reported runs.

AI.title_translation: 基于YOLOv8的统一驾驶感知中频率感知任务权重的探索性研究
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于损失频率分析的动态任务权重方法（FTW）用于YOLOv8统一自动驾驶感知，并在Mapillary Vistas数据集上评估了其性能。
AI.motivation: 在统一感知中，联合优化多个感知任务（对象检测、可行驶区域分割、车道线分割）由于收敛速率、损失尺度和优化稳定性的不同而极具挑战性，现有的任务加权方法各有局限，因此作者探索将损失历史窗口的频率结构作为一种互补信号来动态平衡任务。
AI.method: 实现并检验了频率感知任务权重（FTW）方法，通过估计近期损失历史的低频能量比来计算损失轨迹稳定性代理，并以此动态分配任务权重；在YOLOv8基础的统一感知框架上进行了静态训练和逐步冻结（progressive freezing）两种配置的实验。
AI.result: 在Mapillary Vistas数据集上的实验表明，静态FTW取得了最高的综合得分和车道线mIoU，逐步冻结的FTW取得了最高的目标检测mAP，而静态不确定性加权取得了最高的可行驶区域mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明了基于损失频率权重的可行性，但在当前设定下未能确立对基线的绝对超越或泛化能力，仍需进一步研究。
AI.translation:
统一感知使自动驾驶系统能够在单个网络中执行目标检测、可行驶区域分割和车道线分割，从而提高效率并降低部署复杂度。然而，联合优化多个感知任务仍然具有挑战性，因为这些任务表现出不同的收敛速度、损失规模和优化稳定性。现有的任务加权方法使用损失幅度、学习到的不确定性、短期损失变化或梯度统计；在这里，我们将近期损失历史窗口的频率结构作为一种互补信号进行探索。
我们实现并检查了频率感知任务加权（FTW），这是一种动态任务平衡规则，通过近期损失历史的低频能量比来估计损失轨迹稳定性代理。FTW为均值中心化损失轨迹包含更大比例低频率功率的任务分配更大的权重。我们在一个基于YOLOv8的、带有三个特定任务头的统一感知框架下，记录了FTW和两个基线在全网络静态训练和逐步冻结（progressive freezing）下的表现。
在Mapillary Vistas上的实验在两种配置下将FTW与固定加权和不确定性加权进行了比较。最终的留出指标报告了每次运行中每个epoch验证损失最低的检查点。在六个单次运行配置中，静态FTW具有最大的派生综合得分和车道线mIoU，逐步FTW具有最大的检测mAP，静态不确定性加权具有最大的可行驶区域mIoU。由于缺乏重复种子估计、单任务基线或FTW消融实验，这些排名仅具描述性。证据支持了在此流水线中基于损失频率加权的 Så的可行性，但并未确立对基线的改进或超出所报告运行的泛化能力。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种基于频率感知的任务权重（FTW）方法，用于YOLOv8的统一自动驾驶感知框架。FTW利用损失历史中的低频能量比来动态调整任务权重。在Mapillary Vistas上的实验表明了其可行性，但由于缺乏多次运行和消融实验，其优越性尚待进一步证实。
AI.keywords: 统一自动驾驶感知, YOLOv8, 动态任务平衡, 损失频率分析, 多任务学习
AI.comments: 该论文探索了一种新颖的基于频率感知的任务权重调整方法（FTW），用于YOLOv8驱动的统一感知框架中。创新之处在于利用损失历史窗口的低频率能量比来估计损失轨迹的稳定性代理，从而动态平衡多任务。但局限性在于缺乏重复种子实验和消融实验，结果仅具描述性。

title: Emergent Goal-Directed Attention in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Human observers prioritize visual information according to task goals. Most computational models of naturalistic viewing are gaze-trained for free viewing, leaving open whether goal-directed attention can emerge in systems without gaze supervision. We tested two off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs), Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, on 4,887 naturalistic scenes under visual-search and free-viewing instructions. Model predictions were compared with human fixations on the same images under corresponding tasks. Both models aligned more closely with human fixations under matching goals than under mismatched goals. This crossover persisted in target-absent scenes, where alignment could not be explained by simple visual grounding, and appeared in decoder-layer readouts. Furthermore, model-thinking traces were grounded in target semantics during search and in visual prominence during free viewing. These findings show that general-purpose VLMs can generate human-aligned, goal-directed spatial priorities without gaze-specific training, informing theories of goal-directed attention and offering scalable tools for predicting where people look across tasks.

title: CrossModalQA: A Cross-modal and Multi-hop Benchmark for Multimodal Retrieval-augmented Generation
summary: Despite the strong capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), their parametric knowledge remains incomplete and difficult to update, motivating multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to ground responses in external text and images. However, existing benchmarks face two major limitations: (i) they typically emphasize single-hop retrieval or reasoning over a small set of provided contexts rather than open-domain evidence discovery; and (ii) they provide fragmented coverage of cross-modal reasoning paths, leaving complex multi-hop and multi-image reasoning underexplored. In this paper, we introduce CrossModalQA, an open-domain benchmark for evaluating multimodal retrieval and reasoning over heterogeneous corpora. CrossModalQA contains 1,863 question-answer pairs constructed from 4,987 Wikipedia articles and 4,431 Wikimedia Commons images. It covers five complementary reasoning paths: vision-to-text, text-to-vision, vision-to-text-to-vision, multi-image intersection, and image-set reasoning. Every question requires retrieving and composing distributed textual and visual evidence, with an average reasoning depth of 3.50 hops. We construct the benchmark through multimodal knowledge graph-guided subgraph sampling and apply rule-based consistency checking and LLM verification to ensure multimodal dependence and traceable evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that existing multimodal RAG systems struggle to recover complete evidence chains and can underperform closed-book models when incomplete retrieval introduces distracting context. Further analysis reveals that complete cross-modal retrieval contributes more to answer accuracy than generator scaling, while multi-image retrieval and reasoning remain the primary bottlenecks limiting end-to-end performance.

title: Robots Influencing Humans to Reveal their Goals during Collaboration and Competition
summary: We propose a unified strategy for fast goal inference in human-robot interaction. The core idea is to drive the human toward Critical Decision Points (CDPs)-states where competing human strategies prescribe different next actions and thus maximally reveal the goal. We formalise CDPs using a goal-conditioned policy divergence measure and incorporate them into a Receding-Horizon Planner that explores future action sequences while optimizing a cost function balancing task progress and information gain. We evaluate this approach in both a collaborative, fully observable cooking task and a competitive, partially observable hide-and-seek game, each in simulation and on real robots. In both scenarios, our method infers human goals more accurately and earlier than baseline strategies.

title: Contrastive Knowledge Distillation for Anomaly Detection in Multi-Illumination/Focus Display Images
summary: In this paper, we tackle automatic anomaly detection in multi-illumination and multi-focus display images. The minute defects on the display surface are hard to spot out in RGB images and by a model trained with only normal data. To address this, we propose a novel contrastive learning scheme for knowledge distillation-based anomaly detection. In our framework, Multiresolution Knowledge Distillation (MKD) is adopted as a baseline, which operates by measuring feature similarities between the teacher and student networks. Based on MKD, we propose a novel contrastive learning method, namely Multiresolution Contrastive Distillation (MCD), which does not require positive/negative pairs with an anchor but operates by pulling/pushing the distance between the teacher and student features. Furthermore, we propose the blending module that transforms and aggregate multi-channel information to the three-channel input layer of MCD. Our proposed method significantly outperforms competitive state-of-the-art methods in both AUROC and accuracy metrics on the collected Multi-illumination and Multi-focus display image dataset for Anomaly Detection (MMdAD).

title: Situation Awareness for Intelligent Data Distribution in Connected Vehicles
comments: Peer-reviewed and Published in the 2025 IEEE 101st Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC2025-Spring)
summary: The limitations of on-board sensors and blind spots caused by occlusion cause the reduction of perception quality in autonomous vehicles. In such cases, cooperative perception provides additional data via Vehicle-to-Everything communication to enhance local perception, causing a large volume of data transmission. The vehicle can focus on acquiring and utilizing relevant data according to the prevailing road context by identifying the current traffic situation. To achieve this, we propose a concept for the situation identification of the vehicle using Bird's-Eye-View images. Firstly, the situation around the vehicle is identified using object detection with semantic segmentation, followed by understanding the context of the traffic using a situation identification module consisting of an open-source projective transformation network Cam2BEV and a situation identification neural network. The concept was evaluated and validated by running the software on the CARLA simulator using the in-built RGB camera and the semantic segmentation camera. Additionally, the portability of the situation identification module for real-world applications was verified on Cityscapes and nuScenes urban driving datasets. Overall, the proposed situation identification approach enables efficient sensor data management by prioritizing relevant data to the current traffic situation. The source code is available in the following link: https://github.com/akshaynarla/DySi_Select
comment: Peer-reviewed and Published in the 2025 IEEE 101st Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC2025-Spring)

title: Diffusion models for eye-gaze trajectory generation using position and velocity representations
summary: Eye-tracking data are expensive to collect, requiring specialized hardware and controlled laboratory conditions, and difficult to share because of privacy constraints. We address this using two complementary denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) for unconditional generation of eye-gaze dynamics from visual-search data. Both use an identical FiLM-conditioned one-dimensional U-Net with self-attention (19.35,M parameters), trained on 8,s sliding-window sequences from 28 participants. One model generates raw two-dimensional gaze-position sequences, while the other generates two-component velocity sequences; each uses representation-specific preprocessing, training settings, data partitions, and evaluation protocols. Both are evaluated across three independent training seeds, with aggregated metrics reported as mean,$\pm$,SD. The position-space model achieves a mean Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence of $0.016\pm0.004$ across nine kinematic features, with the highest feature-wise mean below $0.030$, fixation duration within 2% of real data, and a Fr'echet Gaze Distance more than an order of magnitude below statistical and Markovian baselines. Under a Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real protocol, synthetic-only training achieves $R^2=0.66\pm0.02$, or 82.7% of the real-data $R^2$ point estimate. The velocity-space model achieves a mean JS divergence of $0.0065$ across velocity components, speed, log-speed, and turning angle, with a maximum of $0.015\pm0.005$. Reconstructed path length is less accurate ($0.21\pm0.02$ versus $0.03\pm0.01$ in position space), although the protocols differ. Overall, unconditional diffusion captures local gaze kinematics and short-range temporal and directional structure, while long-range properties such as saccade counts and cumulative path geometry remain targets for future conditioned models.

title: Infrastructure-based Monocular 3D Vehicle Localization Framework with Experimental Validation
summary: This paper presents a one-stage learning framework that maps monocular roadside-camera images directly to vehicle states in a ground-fixed coordinate frame. Unlike conventional approaches that first detect vehicles in the image plane and subsequently apply geometric post-processing, the proposed method leverages features from a pretrained object detector to jointly estimate each vehicle's ground-plane position, dimensions, and yaw angle. The framework therefore uses visual features not only for vehicle detection but also for direct spatial and orientation estimation. To support model training and evaluation, we develop a data-collection and label-generation pipeline based on synchronized video from a roadside camera and an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). Acting as a temporary top-view sensing platform, the UAV provides vehicle trajectories, dimensions, and orientations, which are transformed into the ground-fixed coordinate frame and temporally aligned with the roadside-camera images to generate ground-truth labels. The framework is evaluated using data collected during multiple experiments at the Mcity Test Facility. Results show that the proposed method can recover vehicle trajectories and orientations from monocular roadside imagery without a separate geometric post-processing stage, demonstrating its potential as a scalable approach to infrastructure-based perception at urban intersections.

title: DIVA: Exploiting Cross-Step Conditional Propagation for Visual Jailbreaks in Discrete Diffusion Vision-Language Models
comments: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main. Code: https://github.com/loststars2002/DIVA
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical settings, yet existing visual jailbreak research has focused almost exclusively on autoregressive architectures, leaving an important emerging family unstudied: multimodal discrete diffusion vision-language models (dVLMs). We identify a vulnerability specific to diffusion generation: because the visual embedding conditions every reverse denoising step rather than acting as a one-time prefix, adversarial visual semantics are repeatedly propagated and amplified across the generation trajectory, a phenomenon we term cross-step conditional propagation. We provide empirical evidence through stage-sensitivity analysis, prompt-level switch rates, and pairwise denoising-bin disagreement metrics, confirmed by bootstrap resampling. We propose DIVA (Discrete-diffusion Vision-language model Attack), a white-box visual jailbreak framework using cross-modal intent obfuscation and diffusion-aware multi-timestep adversarial optimization. Across three dVLMs, DIVA reaches 58.8%, 67.7%, and 69.1% HADES ASR under the Beaver reward-model metric, outperforming visual jailbreak baselines designed for autoregressive models. Code: https://github.com/loststars2002/DIVA
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main. Code: https://github.com/loststars2002/DIVA

title: Beyond "AI Helps Humans": Decision-Targeted Evaluation Design for Human-Agent Teams in the Agentic Era
summary: Wherever a coding agent works under engineer supervision, or a clinical model assists a radiologist, the deployment question is whether to keep the human-AI workflow or replace it with the human alone or the agent alone. The human-AI workflow is worth keeping only if it beats both of those alternatives. Yet once it is deployed, neither alternative outcome is observed: recovering one means replaying the task under that alternative, and every replay costs expert time or compute. Under a fixed replay budget, the design question is therefore which tasks should be more likely to receive a human-only replay, and which an agent-only replay. Existing methods do not directly target this decision. Agent benchmarks do not choose which missing baseline to measure, variance-based sampling ignores which of the two comparisons is closer to failing, and Bayesian information methods focus on learning model parameters instead of making the deployment decision. We propose TEAM-Design, a rule that gives every task two replay probabilities, one per baseline. It raises a probability where the missing baseline outcome is hard to predict from what is already known about the task and where that comparison is harder to establish, and lowers it where replay is expensive. We prove that the rule solves this budgeted design problem, and that drawing the replays at random from recorded probabilities still controls the chance of wrongly declaring that the workflow beats both. We reanalyze 6 clinical settings, where no human-AI workflow beats both alternatives, and a coding benchmark, where one does, then evaluate TEAM-Design on synthetic designs and on a semi-synthetic design built from a real chest X-ray reader study. TEAM-Design works best when one of the two comparisons is clearly harder to settle than the other, and can do worse than variance-based allocation when the two are similarly difficult.

title: DART: A DAG-Based Reputation and Incentive Framework via Blockchain-Enabled Governance for Trustworthy LLM Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) predominantly rely on centralized orchestration and lack formal verification mechanisms for agent reliability, participation, and system-level behavioral alignment. These shortcomings leave open environments severely vulnerable to uncooperative or malicious agents. This work proposes DART, a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-based reputation and incentive regulation framework for trustworthy multi-agent collaboration, combining centralized operational orchestration with blockchain-enabled decentralized governance and accountability. DART unifies DAG workflow orchestration, capability and reputation-aware task allocation, dynamic behavior updates, multi-factor incentives, and smart contract accountability paired with IPFS storage. Under this paradigm, agent selection dynamically balances task alignment, historical reputation, and workload, while post-execution behavioral evidence continuously calibrates agent trust and the probability of future participation. Evaluated across four axes, DART achieves 93.6% Pass@1 on GSM8K and builds a full-stack application in 142 s using two agents, outperforming centralized baselines. Across five independent 150-round longitudinal trials, Full DART achieves a mean task success rate of 93.33 +/- 2.26%, output quality of 0.9357 +/- 0.0117, retry rate of 0.2307 +/- 0.0816, and allocation delay of 1.1153 +/- 0.0408 s, consistently outperforming its ablated configurations DART isolates persistent and intermittent malicious agents, obtaining a 99.3% output containment rate and restoring system success to 99.8%. These results demonstrate the potential of coupling reputation, incentives, DAG-based coordination, and verifiable blockchain-enabled governance to support adaptive and accountable multi-agent collaboration.

title: When Agent Governance Helps
comments: 35 pages, 14 figures. Companion empirical study to a Purdue D.Tech dissertation. Introduces the GAMPO framework from a 321-source qualitative evidence synthesis and probes a prompt-layer instantiation on the CHI-Bench healthcare benchmark across open and frontier models
summary: No specification says how a governed autotelic AI agent organization, where agents pursue self-generated goals inside guardrails, should be designed and evaluated. We answer in two parts. First, we synthesize the Governed Autotelic Multi-Agent Product Organization (GAMPO) framework from a document-based qualitative evidence synthesis of 321 sources, integrating agency, agile, platform, and governance theory into a runnable specification. Second, we probe a prompt-layer instantiation of GAMPO on CHI-Bench, a long-horizon healthcare benchmark, across open and frontier models. The result is a boundary condition: governance benefit is gated by a model's spare capacity and is domain- and model-specific. On capacity-constrained open models the full procedure yields no reliable benefit, whereas a single "verify your writes" sentence doubles task success (pass@1 2/20 to 4/20). At the frontier the same scaffold lifts prior-authorization 24% to 40% but nets zero on another model, a gap traced to a stable recommendation-override disposition. A second result refines the first: replacing the generic procedure with an answer-blind, per-task definition-of-done, keyed only to the case's own policy and published standards, never the hidden key, raises prior-authorization to 84% under best-of-five self-consistency (68% single-attempt, confirmed by a held-out board) and utilization-management to 44%, while care-management meets a subjective content-quality wall. The contribution is a named, auditable framework and capability-gated evidence that governance should be sized to spare capacity, and that at the frontier a case-grounded specification beats a uniform procedure. Findings are exploratory: partial instantiation, small per-cell samples (n = 5-25), and single trials.
comment: 35 pages, 14 figures. Companion empirical study to a Purdue D.Tech dissertation. Introduces the GAMPO framework from a 321-source qualitative evidence synthesis and probes a prompt-layer instantiation on the CHI-Bench healthcare benchmark across open and frontier models

title: A Specialized Large Multimodal Model for Interpreting PET/CT in Head and Neck Cancer
summary: Background: Diagnosing head and neck cancer using PET/CT is clinically challenging and time-consuming due to the anatomical complexity of the region, motivating computer-aided diagnosis (CAD). Generalist Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) remain limited in medical contexts by insufficient domain-specific knowledge, privacy and security concerns, and verbosity, motivating specialized standalone LMMs. Purpose: We evaluated the feasibility of a specialized LMM for automated PET/CT interpretation in head and neck cancer using a large-scale multi-institutional PET/CT dataset, a tailored training curriculum, and autoregressive training. Methods: LLaVA-NeXT was fine-tuned using a two-level curriculum with image-conversation pairs curated by two radiologists from public data. The dataset included clinically important annotations such as primary tumor presence and metastatic lymph node location. Level 1 used 28,000 image-conversation pairs to learn basic information, including modality type and hypermetabolism. Level 2 used 12,975 pairs to learn primary tumor presence and the existence and anatomical location of cervical lymph node metastases. External validation included four institutions with diverse imaging devices. Results: The specialized LMM substantially outperformed ChatGPT and LLaVA-NeXT. In Level-2 external validation, ROUGE-L, ROUGE-S, Cosine Similarity, Precision, Recall, and F1 were 0.8751, 0.8794, 0.8324, 0.8794, 0.8711, and 0.8751, while generalist models consistently scored below 0.1. Primary tumor classification accuracy was 83.14 +/- 1.15% internally and 69.03 +/- 0.81% externally. For lymph node localization, the corresponding scores were 0.6389, 0.6257, 0.5287, 0.5782, 0.6371, and 0.6648. Conclusion: Specialized LMMs show promising results for fast, accurate PET/CT-based diagnostic support and medical education, highlighting their potential for clinical translation.

title: SimpleMemVLA: A Simple but Effective Native-Video Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Long-horizon manipulation is partially observable: the information needed to choose the next action may appear only in observations from minutes earlier. Existing memory mechanisms: retrieval banks, learned compressors, recurrent states must decide what to keep from the past before knowing what a future decision will require. This was motivated by the assumption that minute-scale history is too large to process directly, which modern VLM backbones no longer make true. In this work, we introduce SimpleMemVLA, a VLA without a dedicated memory module. It keeps the sampled history intact and passes it to the backbone in the timestamped video format the backbone was pretrained to process; the hidden states of a generated sub-task then form the only channel from history to a standard flow-matching action head. Since consecutive decisions share most of their history, prefilling the shared prefix during action execution keeps latency close to a single-frame VLA. SimpleMemVLA sets a new state of the art on four memory benchmarks without cost on general-purpose control. Holding the backbone and training setup fixed, it outperforms retrieval, compression and recurrent-state mechanisms by a wide margin, and causal interventions confirm that the policy genuinely reads its history. Code available at https://github.com/wadeKeith/SimpleMemVLA
