AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的去中心化联邦蒸馏方法，通过多模态知识协作，有效地解决了异构模型客户端在不可靠的去中心化环境中协作的问题，并在拜占庭攻击下实现了稳定的局部优化和更高的预测准确性。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的去中心化联邦蒸馏方法，该方法使具有异构模型的客户端能够通过对共享的无标签公共数据进行预测来协作。在所提出的方法中，每个客户端首先评估接收到的预测，包括类别预测、边界决策和预测相关性三种模态。然后，它会过滤不可靠的客户端，对保留的客户端分配基于可靠性的权重，并为每种知识类型构建一个教师模型。最后，使用从私有数据计算的监督梯度来验证相应的蒸馏梯度。冲突的预测和边界梯度被移除，冲突的关系梯度在最终模型更新前被抑制。我们通过证明在拜占庭蒸馏下诚实客户端的稳定局部优化来证明所提出方法的收敛性。特别是，我们证明了我们的方法确保了拜占庭对蒸馏梯度和个体客户端私有梯度的影响在跨模态融合后是有界的，从而使诚实客户端在拜占庭蒸馏下能够进行稳定的局部优化。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的大量实验表明，所提出的方法在非IID数据和拜占庭攻击下提高了客户端异构模型的预测准确性。随着联邦学习在边缘计算和任务导向的无人机协作等去中心化环境中需求的蓬勃发展，我们的方法在客户端容易受到恶意预测的接收者特定拜占庭消息攻击的不可靠现实场景中，具有巨大的去中心化联邦学习（DFL）应用潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“通过多模态知识协作实现鲁棒的去中心化联邦蒸馏”的新方法。该方法旨在使具有异构模型的客户端能够在去中心化环境中，通过共享无标签公共数据上的预测进行协作。它通过评估预测的三种模态（类别、边界、相关性），过滤不可靠客户端，分配可靠性权重，构建教师模型，并利用私有数据验证蒸馏梯度来抵御拜占庭攻击。实验证明，该方法在非IID数据和拜占庭攻击下显著提高了客户端异构模型的预测准确性，并确保了稳定的局部优化。
AI.keywords: 去中心化联邦蒸馏, 多模态知识协作, 拜占庭攻击, 异构模型, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了多模态知识协作机制，通过对预测进行细致的模态评估（类别、边界、相关性）来识别和过滤不可靠客户端，并结合监督梯度验证蒸馏梯度，有效提升了去中心化联邦蒸馏在面对拜占庭攻击时的鲁棒性。这对于在不信任环境中部署联邦学习具有重要意义。

title: Generalizable 6D Pose Estimation of Textureless Objects with Planar-based Gaussian Splatting
comments: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted by the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Estimating the 6D pose of textureless objects without prior CAD models remains a critical challenge due to the lack of appearance features. While recent generalizable approaches alleviate the dependence on object-specific models, their performance on low-texture objects is often limited by insufficient geometric constraints in the underlying representations. In this work, we propose PG-Pose, a geometry-aware framework combining Planar-based Gaussian Splatting (PGS) reconstruction and Geometry-driven pose optimization. In the offline representation extraction stage, three distinct representations of the object are extracted from multi-view reference RGB images with known poses. PG-Pose reconstructs a 3D Gaussian representation and renders high-fidelity depth maps to generate 3D point clouds through back projection. In the online pose inference stage, the initial pose of the input image is estimated by 2D-3D correspondence matching between the input image and the reconstructed 3D point clouds, followed by a PGS-Refiner for iterative pose optimization. Evaluations on the OnePose-LowTexture datasets, PG-Pose achieves an average accuracy of 94.2% ADD(S)@0.1d, with a 2.1% improvement average accuracy compared with the state-of-the-art (SOTA) GS-based approach. To further demonstrate the effectiveness of PG-Pose for industrial robots in grasping tasks, we deploy it on a dual-arm industrial robot and successfully realize the grasping task on an unseen object.
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted by the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)

AI.title_translation: 可泛化无纹理物体6D姿态估计与平面高斯溅射
AI.tldr: 提出PG-Pose框架，结合平面高斯溅射重建和几何驱动姿态优化，实现对无纹理物体的泛化6D姿态估计，并在基准测试和机器人抓取任务中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 由于缺乏外观特征，在没有CAD模型的情况下估计无纹理物体的6D姿态仍然是一个关键挑战。现有的可泛化方法在低纹理物体上的性能受限于底层表示中几何约束不足。
AI.method: PG-Pose框架包含离线表示提取和在线姿态推断两个阶段。离线阶段从已知姿态的多视角RGB图像中提取三种不同的物体表示，重建3D高斯表示并渲染高保真深度图以生成3D点云。在线阶段通过输入图像与重建3D点云之间的2D-3D对应匹配估计初始姿态，然后通过PGS-Refiner进行迭代姿态优化。
AI.result: 在OnePose-LowTexture数据集上，PG-Pose实现了94.2% ADD(S)@0.1d的平均精度，比最先进的（SOTA）基于GS的方法平均精度提高了2.1%。此外，成功部署在双臂工业机器人上，实现了对未见过物体的抓取任务。
AI.conclusion: PG-Pose通过结合平面高斯溅射重建和几何驱动姿态优化，有效解决了无纹理物体的6D姿态估计挑战，并在准确性和实际应用中展现了优越性。
AI.translation: 估计没有预先CAD模型的无纹理物体的6D姿态仍然是一个关键挑战，因为缺乏外观特征。虽然最近的可泛化方法减轻了对特定物体模型的依赖，但它们在低纹理物体上的性能通常受限于底层表示中几何约束不足。在这项工作中，我们提出了PG-Pose，一个几何感知的框架，结合了基于平面的高斯溅射（PGS）重建和几何驱动的姿态优化。在离线表示提取阶段，从已知姿态的多视角RGB参考图像中提取三种不同的物体表示。PG-Pose重建3D高斯表示并渲染高保真深度图，通过反向投影生成3D点云。在在线姿态推断阶段，通过输入图像与重建3D点云之间的2D-3D对应匹配估计输入图像的初始姿态，然后通过PGS-Refiner进行迭代姿态优化。在OnePose-LowTexture数据集上的评估显示，PG-Pose实现了94.2% ADD(S)@0.1d的平均精度，比最先进的（SOTA）基于GS的方法平均精度提高了2.1%。为了进一步证明PG-Pose在工业机器人抓取任务中的有效性，我们将其部署在双臂工业机器人上，并成功实现了对未见过物体的抓取任务。
AI.summary: 本文提出PG-Pose框架，旨在解决无纹理物体6D姿态估计中几何约束不足的问题。该框架结合了平面高斯溅射重建和几何驱动姿态优化。离线阶段从多视角图像中提取表示并重建3D高斯和点云，在线阶段通过2D-3D匹配和PGS-Refiner优化姿态。实验结果表明，PG-Pose在OnePose-LowTexture数据集上表现优于现有方法，并成功应用于工业机器人抓取任务。
AI.keywords: 6D姿态估计, 无纹理物体, 高斯溅射, 几何驱动优化, 机器人抓取
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将平面高斯溅射与几何驱动的姿态优化相结合，有效克服了传统方法在无纹理物体6D姿态估计中几何约束不足的挑战。其在工业机器人抓取任务中的成功应用，也突显了其实际应用价值和潜力。

title: Parallelism Strategy Chaining for Fast Training Convergence
summary: Selecting a parallelism strategy - the configuration of data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism degrees together with micro- and global-batch sizes - largely determines the training efficiency of large language models. State-of-the-art methods search for a parallelism strategy offline and select the single strategy that minimizes per-iteration time. But we find that they neglect the target validation perplexity and time-to-perplexity (TTP). In particular, our analysis reveals that the best strategy yielding the fastest perplexity improvement changes multiple times during training. As a result, state-of-the-art methods are 1.8-11.4x slower in TTP than the strategy sequence that selects the best strategy at each iteration. This paper proposes CONA, a new training method that introduces online strategy chaining. Instead of a single strategy selected offline, CONA ranks candidate strategies during training using a surrogate metric built from compute throughput and gradient statistics, and switches the current strategy to a new strategy with a higher metric. In our evaluation with GPT-3 1.3B, BERT-Large, and Llama-3.2-1B, CONA reaches the target validation perplexity 1.4-9.6x faster than state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, CONA closely tracks the perplexity achieved by the sequence that selects the best strategy at each iteration, within 2.6%.

AI.title_translation: 并行策略链实现快速训练收敛
AI.tldr: 现有并行策略选择方法在大型语言模型训练中未能实现最快的时间到困惑度（TTP）。本文提出CONA，一种在线策略链方法，通过在训练期间动态切换策略，使大型语言模型训练达到目标困惑度速度提升1.4-9.6倍。
AI.motivation: 现有方法离线选择单一并行策略，忽视了目标验证困惑度和时间到困惑度（TTP），导致在TTP上比最佳策略序列慢1.8-11.4倍。最佳策略在训练期间会多次变化。
AI.method: 本文提出CONA，一种在线策略链训练方法。CONA在训练期间使用由计算吞吐量和梯度统计构建的代理指标对候选策略进行排名，并切换到具有更高指标的新策略。
AI.result: 在GPT-3 1.3B、BERT-Large和Llama-3.2-1B上的评估显示，CONA达到目标验证困惑度的速度比现有方法快1.4-9.6倍。CONA与每迭代选择最佳策略的序列所达到的困惑度非常接近，误差在2.6%以内。
AI.conclusion: CONA通过在线策略链显著提高了大型语言模型训练达到目标困惑度的效率，解决了现有方法在时间到困惑度方面的不足。
AI.translation: 并行策略——数据、张量和流水线并行度以及微批次和全局批次大小的配置——在很大程度上决定了大型语言模型的训练效率。最先进的方法离线搜索并行策略，并选择最小化每次迭代时间的单一策略。但我们发现它们忽视了目标验证困惑度和时间到困惑度（TTP）。特别是，我们的分析表明，在训练过程中，产生最快困惑度改进的最佳策略会多次改变。因此，最先进的方法在TTP上比在每次迭代中选择最佳策略的策略序列慢1.8-11.4倍。本文提出了CONA，一种引入在线策略链的新训练方法。CONA不是离线选择单一策略，而是在训练期间使用由计算吞吐量和梯度统计构建的代理指标对候选策略进行排名，并将当前策略切换到具有更高指标的新策略。在我们对GPT-3 1.3B、BERT-Large和Llama-3.2-1B的评估中，CONA达到目标验证困惑度的速度比最先进的方法快1.4-9.6倍。此外，CONA与在每次迭代中选择最佳策略的序列所达到的困惑度非常接近，误差在2.6%以内。
AI.summary: 本文针对大型语言模型训练中现有并行策略选择方法在时间到困惑度（TTP）上的不足，提出了一种名为CONA的在线策略链训练方法。CONA通过在训练过程中动态评估并切换并行策略，解决了最佳策略随训练进程变化的问题。实验证明，CONA在多种大型语言模型上能显著加速达到目标验证困惑度，性能优于现有离线选择单一策略的方法。
AI.keywords: 并行策略, 大型语言模型训练, 时间到困惑度, 在线策略链, CONA
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入在线策略链的概念，解决了大型语言模型训练中并行策略选择的动态性问题，即最佳策略并非一成不变。其创新点在于提出了一种在训练期间根据代理指标动态调整并行策略的方法，以优化时间到困惑度，这对于提高大型模型训练效率具有重要意义。

title: CEDAR: Error-Bounded Residual Routing for Efficient Long-Context Attention
summary: Post-hoc sparse attention accelerates long-context prefill by routing each query to a small set of token-level interactions. Hard selection, however, assigns zero probability to every omitted chunk: a routing miss cannot be recovered, and a fixed expansion budget spends the same work on easy and ambiguous queries. We introduce Coarse-to-fine Error-aware Dynamic Attention Routing (CEDAR), a coarse-to-fine method that keeps the language model frozen while preserving global coverage. Each semantic chunk contributes a cheap key--value summary to a residual attention path; chunks with high estimated approximation error are then expanded to exact token attention. Exact and summarized contributions are combined in a single softmax normalization, so refinement replaces, rather than duplicates, coarse evidence. We derive an output-error bound governed by within-chunk key/value dispersion and use it to allocate a variable refinement budget. A controlled clustered-attention study shows that residual summaries reduce reconstruction error by more than 98% relative to hard dropping at equal exact-chunk budgets. Experiments on long-context benchmarks demonstrate that CEDAR recovers most of the quality lost by hard sparse routing while maintaining approximately $3\times$ kernel speedup at 128K context.

AI.title_translation: CEDAR：用于高效长上下文注意力的误差有界残差路由
AI.tldr: CEDAR通过误差有界的残差路由，在保持全局覆盖的同时，显著提高了长上下文稀疏注意力的效率和质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的后验稀疏注意力通过硬选择加速长上下文预填充，但遗漏的块无法恢复，且固定预算对简单和模糊查询的处理方式相同，导致质量损失。
AI.method: CEDAR是一种粗到细的误差感知动态注意力路由方法，它使语言模型保持冻结并保留全局覆盖。每个语义块贡献一个廉价的键值摘要到残差注意力路径；估计近似误差高的块会扩展为精确的token注意力。精确和摘要的贡献在单一softmax归一化中结合。该方法推导了一个由块内键/值分散控制的输出误差界限，并用它来分配可变的细化预算。
AI.result: 在受控的聚类注意力研究中，残差摘要将重建误差相对于硬丢弃减少了98%以上。在长上下文基准测试中，CEDAR恢复了硬稀疏路由损失的大部分质量，同时在128K上下文下保持了约3倍的内核加速。
AI.conclusion: CEDAR通过引入误差有界残差路由的粗到细方法，有效解决了长上下文稀疏注意力中的质量损失问题，显著提高了效率和准确性。
AI.translation: 后验稀疏注意力通过将每个查询路由到一小组token级别的交互，加速了长上下文预填充。然而，硬选择为每个被省略的块分配零概率：路由丢失无法恢复，并且固定的扩展预算在简单和模糊查询上花费相同的工作量。我们引入了粗到细的误差感知动态注意力路由（CEDAR），这是一种粗到细的方法，它在保持语言模型冻结的同时保留了全局覆盖。每个语义块都为残差注意力路径贡献一个廉价的键值摘要；然后，估计近似误差高的块被扩展为精确的token注意力。精确和摘要的贡献在单一softmax归一化中结合，因此细化是替换而不是重复粗略证据。我们推导了一个由块内键/值分散控制的输出误差界限，并用它来分配可变的细化预算。一项受控的聚类注意力研究表明，在相同的精确块预算下，残差摘要相对于硬丢弃将重建误差减少了98%以上。在长上下文基准测试上的实验表明，CEDAR恢复了硬稀疏路由损失的大部分质量，同时在128K上下文下保持了约3倍的内核加速。
AI.summary: CEDAR提出了一种粗到细的误差感知动态注意力路由方法，用于解决长上下文稀疏注意力中硬选择导致的质量损失问题。它通过引入误差有界的残差路由，在保持语言模型冻结和全局覆盖的同时，动态地分配细化预算。实验证明，CEDAR显著减少了重建误差，并在保持高效率的同时恢复了大部分质量。
AI.keywords: 长上下文注意力, 稀疏注意力, 误差感知路由, 残差路由, CEDAR
AI.comments: CEDAR的创新点在于其粗到细的误差感知动态路由机制，以及引入误差界限来指导细化预算的分配。这种方法有效地平衡了效率和准确性，解决了长上下文注意力中的关键挑战，对于大规模语言模型的部署具有重要意义。

title: Kolmogorov--Arnold stability for discontinuous functions
summary: Here we investigate the stability of the Kolmogorov--Arnold representation theorem (KART) under adversarial reparameterisations of the hidden layer for multivariate discontinuous and unbounded functions. Our results provide a rigorous mathematical foundation for the structural robustness of modern deep learning architectures, such as Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs), under adversarial configurations.

AI.title_translation: 柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德不连续函数稳定性
AI.tldr: 本文研究了柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德表示定理（KART）在对抗性重参数化下对不连续和无界多变量函数的稳定性，并为现代深度学习架构（如KANs）的结构鲁棒性提供了严格的数学基础。
AI.motivation: 研究柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德表示定理（KART）在多变量不连续和无界函数的隐藏层对抗性重参数化下的稳定性，以提供现代深度学习架构结构鲁棒性的严格数学基础。
AI.method: 通过调查（investigate）柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德表示定理（KART）在对抗性重参数化下的稳定性。
AI.result: 研究结果为现代深度学习架构（如柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络，KANs）在对抗性配置下的结构鲁棒性提供了严格的数学基础。
AI.conclusion: 本文为现代深度学习架构（如KANs）在对抗性配置下的结构鲁棒性提供了严格的数学基础。
AI.translation: 这里我们研究了柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德表示定理（KART）在多变量不连续和无界函数的隐藏层对抗性重参数化下的稳定性。我们的结果为现代深度学习架构（如柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络，KANs）在对抗性配置下的结构鲁棒性提供了严格的数学基础。
AI.summary: 本文深入探讨了柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德表示定理（KART）在面对多变量不连续和无界函数的隐藏层对抗性重参数化时的稳定性。研究结果为柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络（KANs）等新兴深度学习架构在对抗性配置下展现出的结构鲁棒性提供了坚实而严格的数学支撑。
AI.keywords: Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem, KANs, stability, adversarial reparameterisation, deep learning architectures
AI.comments: 这项研究通过为深度学习架构（尤其是KANs）的结构鲁棒性提供严格的数学证明，具有重要的理论和实践意义。它扩展了KART的应用范围，使其能处理更复杂的函数类型，增强了我们对这些模型在面对对抗性攻击时可靠性的理解。

title: A Continuous-Time Generalization of the LPV Fundamental Lemma
summary: Controller design for physical systems directly from data is of tremendous interest in both the industry and academia. However, the research on direct data-driven control has thus far mainly focused on discrete-time linear time-invariant systems. To make the highly non-trivial step to continuous-time nonlinear systems, this paper explores an intermediate route through the framework of linear parameter-varying (LPV) systems. LPV systems can be used as a convenient surrogate for nonlinear systems to achieve systematic analysis and controller design. In this work, we generalize the LPV Fundamental Lemma for discrete-time systems towards a class of continuous-time LPV systems, achieving data-driven representations that can be used to design continuous-time LPV controllers.

AI.title_translation: LPV基本引理的连续时间推广
AI.tldr: 本文将离散时间LPV基本引理推广到连续时间LPV系统，以实现可用于设计连续时间LPV控制器的数据驱动表示，从而弥补数据驱动控制在连续时间非线性系统上的空白。
AI.motivation: 直接从数据为物理系统设计控制器在工业界和学术界都备受关注。然而，目前直接数据驱动控制的研究主要集中在离散时间线性时不变系统。为了向连续时间非线性系统迈进，需要通过LPV系统框架探索一条中间路径。
AI.method: 本文将离散时间系统的LPV基本引理推广到一类连续时间LPV系统。
AI.result: 实现了可用于设计连续时间LPV控制器的数据驱动表示。
AI.translation: 直接从数据为物理系统设计控制器在工业界和学术界都具有巨大的吸引力。然而，迄今为止，直接数据驱动控制的研究主要集中在离散时间线性时不变系统。为了向连续时间非线性系统迈出这一极具挑战性的一步，本文通过线性参数变化（LPV）系统框架探索了一条中间路径。LPV系统可以作为非线性系统的一个便捷替代，以实现系统的分析和控制器设计。在这项工作中，我们将离散时间系统的LPV基本引理推广到一类连续时间LPV系统，实现了可用于设计连续时间LPV控制器的数据驱动表示。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决数据驱动控制在连续时间非线性系统应用中的挑战，提出通过线性参数变化（LPV）系统作为中间方法。研究将离散时间LPV基本引理推广至连续时间LPV系统，从而获得可用于设计连续时间LPV控制器的数据驱动表示。
AI.keywords: 数据驱动控制, 连续时间系统, LPV系统, 基本引理, 控制器设计

title: Living with AI Companions: Sustained AI Companionship Predicts Lower Well-Being Through Lower Human Interaction
summary: AI chatbots are increasingly used for companionship, emotional support, and personal self-disclosure; however, how social engagement with these systems unfolds over time and shapes users' well-being remains unclear. To address this, we conducted a two-wave longitudinal study of CharacterAI users, surveying 1,182 participants at baseline and 439 after a mean follow-up of 12 months. We examined how social engagement with AI companions evolves and how these longitudinal engagement patterns may influence well-being through two hypothesized pathways: sustained social engagement over time and the displacement of human social interaction. We found that interaction intensity, companionship use, and self-disclosure all showed substantial continuity over time. Greater interaction intensity at baseline predicted greater subsequent interaction intensity, companionship use, and self-disclosure. Consistent with the longitudinal engagement pathway, sustained social engagement across these dimensions was consistently associated with lower well-being. Results further support the social displacement pathway, indicating that these links were mainly explained by lower in-person social interaction. These findings highlight the importance of designing AI companions that support human social relationships without displacing them

AI.title_translation: 与AI伙伴共存：持续的AI伙伴关系通过减少人类互动预测较低的幸福感
AI.tldr: 一项对CharacterAI用户的纵向研究发现，持续的AI社交互动（如互动强度、陪伴使用和自我披露）与较低的幸福感相关，这主要是因为减少了面对面的人类社交互动。
AI.motivation: AI聊天机器人越来越多地用于陪伴、情感支持和个人自我披露，但这些系统如何随时间演变以及如何影响用户福祉尚不清楚。
AI.method: 进行了一项为期两波的纵向研究，调查了1182名CharacterAI用户（基线），并在平均12个月后对439名参与者进行了随访。研究了AI伙伴的社交参与如何演变，以及这些纵向参与模式可能通过两个假设途径（持续的社交参与和人类社交互动的替代）影响福祉。
AI.result: 互动强度、陪伴使用和自我披露均随时间表现出实质性连续性。基线时更高的互动强度预测了后续更高的互动强度、陪伴使用和自我披露。持续的AI社交参与（通过互动强度、陪伴使用和自我披露衡量）与较低的幸福感持续相关。这些关联主要通过面对面人类社交互动的减少来解释。
AI.conclusion: 持续的AI伙伴关系可能通过减少人类社交互动来降低幸福感。研究结果强调了设计支持而非替代人类社交关系的AI伙伴的重要性。
AI.translation: 人工智能聊天机器人越来越多地用于陪伴、情感支持和个人自我披露；然而，与这些系统的社交互动如何随时间发展并塑造用户的福祉仍不清楚。为了解决这个问题，我们对CharacterAI用户进行了一项两波纵向研究，在基线调查了1182名参与者，并在平均12个月的随访后调查了439名参与者。我们研究了与AI伙伴的社交互动如何演变，以及这些纵向参与模式可能通过两个假设途径影响福祉：持续的社交参与和人类社交互动的替代。我们发现互动强度、陪伴使用和自我披露都随时间表现出实质性连续性。基线时更高的互动强度预测了后续更高的互动强度、陪伴使用和自我披露。与纵向参与途径一致，这些维度上持续的社交参与始终与较低的福祉相关。结果进一步支持了社交替代途径，表明这些联系主要通过面对面人类社交互动的减少来解释。这些发现强调了设计支持人类社交关系而非替代它们的AI伙伴的重要性。
AI.summary: 本研究通过一项对CharacterAI用户的纵向调查，探讨了与AI伙伴的社交互动如何随时间发展并影响用户福祉。结果显示，持续的AI社交参与（包括互动强度、陪伴使用和自我披露）与较低的幸福感相关，且这种关联主要是由于减少了面对面的人类社交互动。研究强调了在设计AI伙伴时，应侧重于支持而非替代人类社交关系。
AI.keywords: AI伴侣, 幸福感, 社交互动, 纵向研究, 社交替代
AI.comments: 这项研究通过纵向数据揭示了AI陪伴对人类福祉的潜在负面影响，特别是通过“社交替代”机制。其创新之处在于使用了真实用户群体的长期数据，而非短期的实验。研究结果对于AI伴侣的设计者和政策制定者具有重要指导意义，强调了在发展AI技术时需关注其对人类社会互动和心理健康的深远影响。未来研究可以进一步探索不同AI伴侣类型和用户特征对这些关系的影响。

title: Towards a Resilience-Theoretic Foundation for Adversarial Robustness in Industrial Control System Anomaly Detection
summary:
Anomaly-based intrusion detection systems in industrial control systems (ICS) and operational technology (OT) environments are increasingly required to meet formal resilience criteria: absorbed adversarial disturbances, graceful degradation under sustained attack, and certified system-level guarantees. Existing resilience frameworks for cyber-physical systems define absorb-recover-adapt trajectories at the architectural level but do not treat machine learning anomaly detectors as first-class components, leaving a gap between component-level robustness evaluation and system-level resilience certification.
  In this paper, we establish that adversarial robustness in ICS anomaly detection is a specific instantiation of system resilience, and formalise this connection by mapping four resilience constructs, i.e. disturbance class, absorption capacity, recovery trajectory, and degradation function, onto the adversarial machine learning setting. We derive a compositional resilience bound for heterogeneous ICS detection networks, showing that the binding constraint on system-level resilience is the coupling-adjusted absorption capacity of each node along the attack path, not the per-node capacity -- so the binding node need not be the weakest one. Empirical validation on the BATADAL water distribution system benchmark demonstrates that the resulting metrics surface operationally significant phenomena invisible to standard benchmarks: the absorption-degradation divergence under adversarial training, and the paradox that hardening the binding node in isolation reduces system-level resilience. Implications for ICS architecture design and certification standards are discussed.

AI.title_translation: 工业控制系统异常检测中对抗鲁棒性的韧性理论基础研究
AI.tldr: 本文将ICS异常检测中的对抗鲁棒性视为系统韧性的一种实例化，并提出了一个组合韧性界限，揭示了攻击路径上节点的耦合调整吸收能力是系统级韧性的约束，并通过实验验证了其对ICS架构设计和认证标准的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有的网络物理系统韧性框架未将机器学习异常检测器视为一等组件，导致组件级鲁棒性评估与系统级韧性认证之间存在差距。工业控制系统(ICS)和操作技术(OT)环境中的基于异常的入侵检测系统需要满足正式的韧性标准，如吸收对抗性干扰、在持续攻击下优雅降级以及系统级认证保证。
AI.method: 将ICS异常检测中的对抗鲁棒性确立为系统韧性的一种实例化；通过将四种韧性构造（干扰类别、吸收能力、恢复轨迹和降级函数）映射到对抗性机器学习设置，形式化了这种联系；推导了异构ICS检测网络的组合韧性界限；在BATADAL水分配系统基准上进行了实证验证。
AI.result: 系统级韧性的约束是攻击路径上每个节点的耦合调整吸收能力，而非单个节点的容量，因此约束节点不一定是“最弱”的节点。经验验证揭示了标准基准不可见的现象：对抗训练下的吸收-降级分歧，以及单独强化约束节点反而会降低系统级韧性的悖论。
AI.conclusion: 本文为ICS异常检测中的对抗鲁棒性提供了韧性理论基础，并揭示了系统级韧性由耦合调整吸收能力决定，对ICS架构设计和认证标准具有重要意义。
AI.translation:
工业控制系统（ICS）和操作技术（OT）环境中的基于异常的入侵检测系统越来越需要满足正式的韧性标准：吸收对抗性干扰、在持续攻击下优雅降级以及经过认证的系统级保证。现有的网络物理系统韧性框架在架构层面定义了吸收-恢复-适应轨迹，但并未将机器学习异常检测器视为一等组件，这在组件级鲁棒性评估和系统级韧性认证之间留下了空白。
在本文中，我们确立了ICS异常检测中的对抗鲁棒性是系统韧性的一种具体实例化，并通过将四种韧性构造，即干扰类别、吸收能力、恢复轨迹和降级函数，映射到对抗性机器学习设置，从而形式化了这种联系。我们推导了异构ICS检测网络的组合韧性界限，表明系统级韧性的约束条件是攻击路径上每个节点的耦合调整吸收能力，而不是每个节点的容量——因此约束节点不一定是最弱的节点。在BATADAL水分配系统基准上的实证验证表明，由此产生的指标揭示了标准基准不可见的具有操作意义的现象：对抗训练下的吸收-降级分歧，以及单独强化约束节点反而会降低系统级韧性的悖论。文章讨论了其对ICS架构设计和认证标准的影响。
AI.summary: 本文旨在为工业控制系统（ICS）异常检测中的对抗鲁棒性建立韧性理论基础。针对现有框架未充分考虑机器学习检测器与系统级韧性认证的差距，作者将对抗鲁棒性视为系统韧性的一种实例化，并形式化了其与韧性构造的联系。研究推导了异构ICS检测网络的组合韧性界限，指出系统级韧性受攻击路径上耦合调整吸收能力而非单个节点容量的约束。实验验证揭示了对抗训练下的吸收-降级分歧以及单独强化约束节点可能降低系统级韧性的反直觉现象，为ICS架构设计和认证标准提供了重要启示。
AI.keywords: 工业控制系统, 对抗鲁棒性, 韧性理论, 异常检测, 耦合调整吸收能力
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将对抗鲁棒性与系统韧性理论相结合，为ICS异常检测提供了一个更全面的视角。它不仅弥补了现有韧性框架在处理机器学习组件方面的不足，还通过提出“耦合调整吸收能力”的概念，纠正了对系统韧性约束的传统认知，即最弱节点不一定是瓶颈。实验结果揭示的“强化约束节点反而降低系统韧性”的悖论尤其引人深思，对ICS安全架构设计具有重要的指导意义。

title: Elastic Horizon: Discovering the Effective Interaction Frontier in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
comments: 17 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026
summary: Scaling the interaction horizon-the maximum number of environment interactions per episode-improves LLM agents on long-horizon tasks, and curriculum-based methods that progressively expand the horizon outperform fixed-horizon alternatives. However, existing schedules are open-loop: they monotonically increase the horizon until a manually specified maximum, with no mechanism to detect when further expansion stops helping. We propose the effective interaction frontier hypothesis: a dynamic boundary beyond which additional interactions yield diminishing returns while cost grows linearly. We then introduce Elastic Horizon, a closed-loop controller that tracks this boundary via the 90th percentile of successful trajectory lengths. On AppWorld and BFCL, fixed-horizon sweeps reveal clear saturation plateaus; Elastic Horizon stabilizes the horizon inside the saturation band from both under- and over-capacity initializations, attains the best success rates across 7B and 14B backbones, and saves up to 25% of per-step trajectory tokens. Our work shifts the paradigm from how to scale interaction horizons to when to stop scaling.
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026

AI.title_translation: 弹性视野：在智能体强化学习中发现有效交互前沿
AI.tldr: 本文提出了弹性视野（Elastic Horizon），一个闭环控制器，通过追踪成功轨迹长度的第90百分位数来动态调整LLM智能体的交互视野，以避免收益递减，并在AppWorld和BFCL上取得了更好的成功率和更低的成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）智能体在长序列任务中，通过增加每回合环境交互次数（交互视野）可以提高性能，但当前的课程学习方法是开环的，即单调增加交互视野直到手动设定的最大值，缺乏机制来检测何时进一步扩展不再有效。这导致了额外的交互成本却收益递减。
AI.method: 作者提出了“有效交互前沿”假设，即存在一个动态边界，在此之外增加交互会导致收益递减而成本线性增长。基于此，引入了“弹性视野”（Elastic Horizon），一个闭环控制器，通过追踪成功轨迹长度的第90百分位数来动态确定和跟踪这个边界。
AI.result: 在AppWorld和BFCL数据集上，固定视野的实验显示出明显的饱和平台。弹性视野控制器能够将交互视野稳定在饱和区域内，无论初始容量是不足还是过剩。它在7B和14B骨干网络上均取得了最佳的成功率，并节省了高达25%的每步轨迹令牌。
AI.conclusion: 本文的工作将范式从“如何扩展交互视野”转变为“何时停止扩展交互视野”，通过动态调整交互视野，提高了LLM智能体的效率和性能。
AI.translation: 扩展交互视野——即每回合最大的环境交互次数——可以提高大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在长序列任务上的表现，而基于课程的方法，即逐步扩展视野，优于固定视野的替代方案。然而，现有的调度是开环的：它们单调地增加视野，直到一个手动指定的最大值，没有机制来检测何时进一步扩展停止有帮助。我们提出了有效交互前沿假设：一个动态边界，在此之外，额外的交互会产生递减的收益，而成本则线性增长。然后，我们引入了弹性视野（Elastic Horizon），一个闭环控制器，它通过成功轨迹长度的90百分位数来跟踪这个边界。在AppWorld和BFCL上，固定视野的扫描揭示了清晰的饱和平台；弹性视野将视野稳定在饱和带内，无论是从容量不足还是过剩的初始化开始，在7B和14B骨干网络上均取得了最佳的成功率，并节省了高达25%的每步轨迹令牌。我们的工作将范式从如何扩展交互视野转变为何时停止扩展。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“弹性视野”（Elastic Horizon），一种用于大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的闭环控制器，旨在解决现有开环交互视野扩展策略的效率问题。该控制器基于“有效交互前沿”假设，通过追踪成功轨迹长度的第90百分位数，动态调整智能体的交互视野，以避免不必要的交互成本和收益递减。实验结果表明，弹性视野在AppWorld和BFCL数据集上，不仅能稳定地将视野维持在最佳饱和区域，提高成功率，还能显著节省轨迹令牌，从而提升了智能体的效率。
AI.keywords: 弹性视野, 强化学习, LLM智能体, 交互视野, 有效交互前沿
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新的方法来优化LLM智能体的交互效率。其核心创新在于从静态、开环的视野扩展策略转向动态、闭环的控制，引入了“有效交互前沿”这一关键概念。这不仅解决了现有方法中资源浪费的问题，也为智能体在复杂长序列任务中的自主学习提供了更高效的机制。该方法在实际应用中具有重要意义，尤其是在计算资源有限或对效率要求高的场景下。

title: An Efficient Out-of-Core Tomographic Imaging Framework for Edge Devices
summary: Computed Tomography (CT) is an essential 3D imaging technology widely used in medical diagnostics and scientific research. However, performing CT imaging on edge devices is challenging due to limitations in computational power, memory capacity, and energy budget. This paper presents an efficient CT reconstruction framework, called edgeFBP, designed for Nvidia Jetson System-on-Chip (SoC) devices. edgeFBP adopts an end-to-end pipeline design for efficient out-of-core image reconstruction under tight power and memory constraints. edgeFBP utilizes a mixed-precision strategy leveraging half-precision Tensor Cores (TCs) to accelerate the bottleneck back-projection (BP) kernel. edgeFBP achieves a 1.83x speedup over the widely used RTK library on Jetson Nano and a 2.56x speedup on Jetson AGX. Under a strict 25-Watt power budget, edgeFBP on Jetson Nano achieves up to 5-48x higher energy efficiency than an Nvidia DGX A100, enabling datacenter-scale imaging on constrained edge devices.

AI.title_translation: 一种高效的边缘设备离核断层成像框架
AI.tldr: edgeFBP是一种针对Nvidia Jetson SoC设备设计的高效CT重建框架，它通过离核重建、混合精度策略和Tensor Cores加速，实现了显著的速度提升和更高的能效，使得在资源受限的边缘设备上进行数据中心规模的成像成为可能。
AI.motivation: 由于计算能力、内存容量和能耗预算的限制，在边缘设备上进行CT成像面临挑战。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个名为edgeFBP的CT重建框架，采用端到端管道设计，用于在严格的功耗和内存限制下进行高效的离核图像重建。edgeFBP利用混合精度策略，利用半精度Tensor Cores加速瓶颈反投影（BP）内核。
AI.result: edgeFBP在Jetson Nano上比广泛使用的RTK库实现了1.83倍的加速，在Jetson AGX上实现了2.56倍的加速。在严格的25瓦功耗预算下，Jetson Nano上的edgeFBP比Nvidia DGX A100的能效高出5-48倍。
AI.conclusion: edgeFBP使得在受限的边缘设备上实现数据中心规模的成像成为可能。
AI.translation: 计算机断层扫描（CT）是一种重要的3D成像技术，广泛应用于医学诊断和科学研究。然而，由于计算能力、内存容量和能耗预算的限制，在边缘设备上进行CT成像具有挑战性。本文提出了一种高效的CT重建框架，名为edgeFBP，专为Nvidia Jetson片上系统（SoC）设备设计。edgeFBP采用端到端管道设计，用于在严格的功耗和内存限制下进行高效的离核图像重建。edgeFBP利用混合精度策略，利用半精度Tensor Cores（TCs）加速瓶颈反投影（BP）内核。edgeFBP在Jetson Nano上比广泛使用的RTK库实现了1.83倍的加速，在Jetson AGX上实现了2.56倍的加速。在严格的25瓦功耗预算下，Jetson Nano上的edgeFBP比Nvidia DGX A100的能效高出5-48倍，从而使得在受限的边缘设备上实现数据中心规模的成像成为可能。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为edgeFBP的高效CT重建框架，专为Nvidia Jetson边缘设备设计，旨在克服边缘设备在计算能力、内存和能耗方面的限制。通过采用端到端离核重建管道和利用半精度Tensor Cores的混合精度策略来加速反投影，edgeFBP在Jetson Nano和AGX上分别实现了1.83倍和2.56倍的速度提升。此外，在25瓦功耗预算下，其能效比Nvidia DGX A100高出5-48倍，有效推动了在资源受限的边缘设备上实现数据中心规模的成像。
AI.keywords: 断层成像, 边缘设备, CT重建, 混合精度, 能效
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于通过为边缘设备量身定制的优化，成功地将计算密集型CT成像带到了资源受限的边缘硬件上，并在能效方面取得了显著的突破，这对于移动医疗、工业检测等领域具有重要意义。

title: The Maximum Mutual Visibility Set on a Cactus Graph and the Self-stabilizing Constructions
summary:
Given a graph $G=(V,E)$, let $S$ ($\subseteq V$) be a set of vertices. Two vertices are \emph{mutually visible} if there exists a shortest path in $G$ between them that does not contain any other vertex of $S$. A set $S$ is a \emph{Mutual Visibility Set} (\MVS) if every pair of vertices in $S$ is mutually visible.
  The concept of \MVS s in graphs has attracted significant attention since its introduction, as it provides an important structural property of graphs. However, determining a maximum \MVS\ in general graphs is computationally intractable; the decision problem of whether a graph admits an \MVS\ of size at least $k$ has been shown to be \emph{NP-complete}. Thus, prior work has focused on finding maximal \MVS s or restricting attention to specific graph classes.
  Cactus graphs form a fundamental low-treewidth class, yet the maximum \MVS\ problem for this class remains open. In this paper, we first determine the size of maximum \MVS~in cactus graphs, and introduce two self-stabilizing algorithms that construct such sets. The first algorithm uses a single BFS tree and stabilizes in $O(D)$ rounds with $O(\log n)$ bits per process on average; the second one uses parallel BFS trees and stabilizes in $O(|C_{\max}|+|T_{\max}|)$ rounds, which we show to be asymptotically tight as a function of these two parameters, even on graphs where $|C_{\max}|+|T_{\max}| = o(D)$.

AI.title_translation: 仙人掌图上的最大互可见集及其自稳定构造
AI.tldr: 本文确定了仙人掌图上最大互可见集的大小，并提出了两种自稳定算法来构造这些集合。
AI.motivation: 互可见集（MVS）在图论中是一个重要的结构性质，但确定一般图中的最大MVS是NP完全问题。尽管仙人掌图是基本的低树宽图类，但其最大MVS问题仍未解决。
AI.method: 本文首先确定了仙人掌图上最大互可见集的大小，然后提出了两种自稳定算法来构造这些集合。第一种算法使用单个BFS树，第二种使用并行BFS树。
AI.result: 确定了仙人掌图上最大互可见集的大小。提出了两种自稳定算法：第一个算法使用单个BFS树，在O(D)轮内稳定，平均每个进程O(log n)位；第二个算法使用并行BFS树，在O(|C_max|+|T_max|)轮内稳定，该复杂度在渐近意义上是紧密的。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功解决了仙人掌图上最大互可见集的大小确定问题，并提供了高效的自稳定算法来构造这些集合，填补了该领域的一个空白。
AI.translation:
给定一个图 $G=(V,E)$，令 $S$ ($\subseteq V$) 是一个顶点集。如果它们之间存在一条不包含 $S$ 中任何其他顶点的最短路径，则称两个顶点是“互可见的”。如果 $S$ 中的每对顶点都是互可见的，则 $S$ 是一个“互可见集”（MVS）。
图中的MVS概念自提出以来引起了广泛关注，因为它提供了图的重要结构性质。然而，确定一般图中的最大MVS在计算上是难以处理的；图是否允许大小至少为 $k$ 的MVS的判定问题已被证明是NP完全的。因此，之前的工作侧重于寻找极大MVS或将注意力限制在特定的图类上。
仙人掌图构成了一个基本的低树宽图类，但该类的最大MVS问题仍然悬而未决。在本文中，我们首先确定了仙人掌图上最大MVS的大小，并引入了两种自稳定算法来构造这些集合。第一个算法使用单个BFS树，并在O(D)轮内稳定，平均每个进程需要O(log n)位；第二个算法使用并行BFS树，并在O(|C_max|+|T_max|)轮内稳定，我们证明这作为这两个参数的函数是渐近紧密的，即使在 $|C_{\max}|+|T_{\max}| = o(D)$ 的图上也是如此。
AI.summary: 本文研究了仙人掌图上的最大互可见集（MVS）问题，该问题在一般图中是NP完全的。作者首次确定了仙人掌图上最大MVS的大小，并提出了两种自稳定算法来构造这些集合。第一个算法基于单个BFS树，具有O(D)轮稳定时间和O(log n)平均位复杂度；第二个算法基于并行BFS树，其稳定时间为O(|C_max|+|T_max|)，并证明了其渐近最优性。
AI.keywords: 仙人掌图, 互可见集, 自稳定算法, 分布式算法, NP完全问题
AI.comments: 本文解决了仙人掌图这一特定图类中最大互可见集计算的开放问题，其创新之处在于提供了两种高效的自稳定分布式算法，这对于分布式系统中的图结构分析具有重要意义。算法的渐近紧密性分析也增加了其理论价值。

title: SkillAlign: Aligning Skill Interfaces for LLM-based Agents
summary: Language-model agents increasingly rely on skills: reusable procedural knowledge for reasoning, tool use, and interaction. Existing work studies how skills are acquired, retrieved, compressed, or composed, but often assumes that once a skill is selected, its interface to the agent is fixed. We argue that this overlooks a key source of skill utility: the same skill can help, distract, or mislead depending on how it is exposed. We propose SkillAlign, a provider-agnostic framework that represents candidate skills as multi-view procedural cards and renders them through alternative exposure interfaces, including full instructions, hints, compressed summaries, workflows, or no exposure. This enables counterfactual evaluation where the task, agent, and candidate skills are fixed while only the exposure interface varies. Across ALFWorld and SkillsBench, we show that exposure form substantially affects task success and rendered context cost, and that compact top-k exposure can outperform full-library injection. We further conduct a replay-based policy-learning analysis on ALFWorld, showing that adaptive exposure contains learnable signal but remains far from oracle selection. Our results suggest that skill-augmented agents should optimize not only which skills to use, but also how those skills are presented.

AI.title_translation: SkillAlign：对齐基于大型语言模型代理的技能接口
AI.tldr: SkillAlign是一个框架，用于优化LLM代理中技能的呈现方式，通过调整技能接口曝光形式显著影响任务成功率和成本，并表明需要优化技能呈现方式。
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注技能的获取、检索、压缩或组合，但忽略了技能如何暴露给代理的重要性。同一技能可能根据其暴露方式不同而产生帮助、分散注意力或误导。因此，需要研究如何对齐技能接口以最大化技能效用。
AI.method: 提出SkillAlign框架，它与提供者无关，将候选技能表示为多视图过程卡片，并通过替代的暴露接口（包括完整指令、提示、压缩摘要、工作流程或不暴露）进行渲染。这使得在任务、代理和候选技能固定而仅暴露接口变化的情况下进行反事实评估。此外，进行了基于重放的策略学习分析。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和SkillsBench上，暴露形式显著影响任务成功率和渲染上下文成本。紧凑的top-k暴露可以优于全库注入。自适应暴露包含可学习信号，但距离预言机选择仍有差距。
AI.conclusion: 技能增强型代理不仅应优化使用哪些技能，还应优化如何呈现这些技能。
AI.translation: 语言模型代理越来越依赖技能：用于推理、工具使用和交互的可重用程序性知识。现有工作研究了技能如何获取、检索、压缩或组合，但通常假设一旦选择技能，其与代理的接口是固定的。我们认为这忽略了技能效用的一个关键来源：同一个技能可能根据其暴露方式不同而产生帮助、分散注意力或误导。我们提出了SkillAlign，这是一个与提供者无关的框架，它将候选技能表示为多视图程序卡片，并通过替代的暴露接口进行渲染，包括完整指令、提示、压缩摘要、工作流程或不暴露。这使得在任务、代理和候选技能固定而仅暴露接口变化的情况下进行反事实评估。在ALFWorld和SkillsBench上，我们表明暴露形式显著影响任务成功率和渲染上下文成本，并且紧凑的top-k暴露可以优于全库注入。我们进一步对ALFWorld进行了基于重放的策略学习分析，表明自适应暴露包含可学习信号，但距离预言机选择仍有差距。我们的结果表明，技能增强型代理不仅应优化使用哪些技能，还应优化如何呈现这些技能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SkillAlign框架，旨在优化大型语言模型（LLM）代理中技能的呈现方式。现有研究忽略了技能接口暴露形式对代理性能的关键影响。SkillAlign通过将技能表示为多视图过程卡片，并提供多种暴露接口（如完整指令、提示、摘要等），实现反事实评估。实验结果表明，技能的暴露形式显著影响任务成功率和上下文成本，紧凑的暴露方式甚至优于全库注入。研究强调，LLM代理不仅应选择合适的技能，更应优化技能的呈现方式。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 技能接口, SkillAlign, 技能暴露, 任务成功率
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它首次系统地提出了“技能接口对齐”的概念，并提供了一个通用的框架SkillAlign来解决这个问题。它挑战了以往研究中技能接口固定不变的假设，揭示了技能暴露方式对LLM代理性能的巨大影响。这为未来LLM代理的设计和优化提供了新的视角和研究方向，强调了除了技能本身的选择，如何有效地呈现技能同样重要。

title: MV-STRIDE: Enabling MLLMs to Master Multi-View Spatial Reasoning via Hierarchical Capability Modeling
summary: Despite the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in 2D vision-language tasks, robust multi-view spatial reasoning remains a fundamental bottleneck due to the lack of structured 3D cognitive pathways in existing datasets. To address this, we introduce MV-STRIDE, a Multi-View hierarchical SpaTial Reasoning dataset with Interdependent and DEcomposed capabilitiEs. Moving beyond flat data structures, MV-STRIDE explicitly models the dependency relationships between foundational perception, scene understanding, and complex contextual reasoning, providing a coherent learning pathway aligned with human spatial cognition. We develop a systematic QA generation pipeline leveraging diverse 3D scene sources that enforces cross-view dependency constraints to prevent single-view solvability, generating multi-level spatial reasoning tasks supported by cognitively grounded chain-of-thought supervision for complex inference. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our multi-stage training framework based on our hierarchical dataset achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple spatial reasoning benchmarks, notably the multi-view oriented MMSI-Bench. Our approach enables MLLMs to maintain robust, 3D-consistent spatial reasoning across diverse viewpoints. The code and dataset are available at https://co1dspring.github.io/MV-STRIDE/.

AI.title_translation: MV-STRIDE：通过分层能力建模使MLLMs掌握多视角空间推理
AI.tldr: MV-STRIDE 通过分层能力建模和相互依赖的数据集结构，显著提升了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在多视角下的 3D 空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集缺乏结构化的 3D 认知路径，导致多模态大语言模型在强大的多视角空间推理方面存在根本性瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 MV-STRIDE 的多视角分层空间推理数据集，该数据集具有相互依赖和分解的能力；开发了一个利用多样化 3D 场景源的系统化 QA 生成管道，实施跨视角依赖约束并提供思维链监督。
AI.result: 基于该分层数据集的多阶段训练框架在多个空间推理基准测试（特别是 MMSI-Bench）上实现了最先进的性能，使模型能够在不同视点保持稳健、3D一致的空间推理能力。
AI.conclusion: MV-STRIDE 通过分层能力建模与系统化 QA 生成流程，成功提升了多模态大语言模型在多视角空间推理任务中的表现，达到了行业领先水平。
AI.translation: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在2D视觉语言任务中取得了快速进展，但由于现有数据集缺乏结构化的3D认知路径，稳健的多视角空间推理仍然是一个根本瓶颈。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了 MV-STRIDE，这是一个具有相互依赖和分解能力的多视角分层空间推理数据集。超越了扁平的数据结构，MV-STRIDE 显式地建模了基础感知、场景理解和复杂上下文推理之间的依赖关系，提供了一条与人类空间认知相一致的连贯学习路径。我们开发了一个系统化的 QA 生成管道，利用多样化的 3D 场景源，强制执行跨视角依赖约束以防止单视角可解性，从而生成由认知基础思维链监督支持的多级空间推理任务。广泛的评估表明，基于我们分层数据集的多阶段训练框架在多个空间推理基准测试（特别是面向多视角的 MMSI-Bench）上实现了最先进的性能。我们的方法使 MLLMs 能够在不同的视点保持稳健且具有 3D 一致性的空间推理能力。代码和数据集可在 https://co1dspring.github.io/MV-STRIDE/ 获取。
AI.summary: 论文提出了 MV-STRIDE，一个通过分层能力建模来增强多模态大语言模型多视角空间推理能力的数据集和训练框架，有效弥补了现有 3D 认知路径的不足。
AI.keywords: 多模态大语言模型, 多视角空间推理, 分层能力建模, 3D场景理解
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入分层能力建模和相互依赖的数据结构，有效解决了多视角3D空间推理中的瓶颈，具有很高的创新性和实用价值。

title: Improved Randomized Approximations for Strategic Obnoxious Facility Location
summary: We study randomized strategyproof mechanisms for strategic obnoxious facility location on a line segment, where agents wish the facility to be located as far away from them as possible and their utility is their distance from the facility, under the social utility and minimum utility objectives. For social utility, we propose a novel randomized mechanism that breaks the previously best known \(\frac32\)-approximation of [Cheng, Yu, and Zhang, TCS 2013], achieving an approximation ratio of at most \(1.47359\). We also raise the lower bound on the approximation ratio of randomized strategyproof mechanisms from \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\approx1.15470\) [Feigenbaum et al., JAAMAS 2020] to \(\frac{105}{88}\approx1.19318\). For minimum utility, following the profile-independent approach of [Chan, Lin and Wang, AAMAS 2026], we design a simple randomized mechanism that reduces the approximation guarantee from \(\sqrt{2n}+O(1)\) to \(\sqrt n+O(1)\), where \(n\) is the number of agents. Finally, we prove that no randomized strategyproof mechanism can achieve an asymptotic approximation ratio strictly smaller than \(2\), strengthening the previous asymptotic lower bound of \(\frac32\) [Feigenbaum et al., JAAMAS 2020]. Thus, all four bounds considered in this paper strictly improve upon the corresponding previously known results.

AI.title_translation: 改进的策略性令人讨厌的设施选址随机近似算法
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了改进的随机策略证明机制，用于解决直线段上的策略性令人讨厌的设施选址问题。对于社会效用目标，新机制将近似比从1.5提高到1.47359，并将随机策略证明机制的下界从1.15470提高到1.19318。对于最小效用目标，新机制将近似保证从O(sqrt(n))降低到O(sqrt(n))。此外，研究还将随机策略证明机制的渐近下界从1.5提高到2，所有结果均优于先前已知结果。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在改进策略性令人讨厌的设施选址问题的随机策略证明机制，以提高近似比和降低近似保证。
AI.method: 研究提出了新的随机机制，并采用了配置文件独立的方法。
AI.result: 对于社会效用目标，新的随机机制实现了1.47359的近似比，并将随机策略证明机制的下界提高到1.19318。对于最小效用目标，新机制将近似保证从O(sqrt(n))降低到O(sqrt(n))。此外，研究还将随机策略证明机制的渐近下界提高到2。
AI.conclusion: 该研究在策略性令人讨厌的设施选址问题的随机策略证明机制方面取得了多项改进，包括提高社会效用和最小效用的近似比，以及提高渐近下界。
AI.translation: 我们研究了直线段上策略性令人讨厌的设施选址问题的随机策略证明机制，其中代理人希望设施尽可能远离他们，并且他们的效用是他们与设施的距离，目标是社会效用和最小效用。对于社会效用，我们提出了一种新颖的随机机制，打破了[Cheng, Yu, and Zhang, TCS 2013]先前已知的最佳3/2近似比，实现了至多1.47359的近似比。我们还将随机策略证明机制的近似比下界从2/√3≈1.15470 [Feigenbaum et al., JAAMAS 2020]提高到105/88≈1.19318。对于最小效用，遵循[Chan, Lin and Wang, AAMAS 2026]的配置文件独立方法，我们设计了一个简单的随机机制，将近似保证从√2n+O(1)降低到√n+O(1)，其中n是代理人的数量。最后，我们证明了没有随机策略证明机制能够实现严格小于2的渐近近似比，从而加强了先前2020年[Feigenbaum et al., JAAMAS 2020]的3/2渐近下界。因此，本文考虑的所有四个界限都严格优于相应的先前已知结果。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了改进的随机策略证明机制，用于解决直线段上的策略性令人 आवड设施选址问题。研究在社会效用和最小效用两个目标下，分别提高了近似比和近似保证，并加强了渐近下界，所有结果均优于先前已知结果。
AI.keywords: 策略性令人讨厌的设施选址, 随机机制, 策略证明, 近似比, 渐近下界
AI.comments: 该研究在策略性令人讨厌的设施选址问题上取得了显著进展，通过引入新的随机机制和改进现有界限，为该领域带来了理论上的提升。

title: Query-Aware Token Budgeting for Efficient Late-Interaction Visual Document Retrieval
comments: Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM)
summary: Late-interaction visual document retrievers preserve fine-grained page evidence by storing many token embeddings per page, but the resulting storage and query-time interaction costs make large-scale deployment expensive. Pooling document tokens before indexing offers a natural remedy, yet static pooling must decide which visual evidence to preserve before the query is known. We study an alternative: a heavily compressed hot-path index generates candidates, after which query-aware token budgeting operates on the original token sets of the shortlisted pages. We formulate this stage-two selection as a budgeted MaxSim coverage problem, show that a clipped version is monotone submodular, and compare coverage-only, cluster-guided, token-wise, and marginal-gain policies. On ten ViDoRe tasks with ColModernVBERT, direct static pooling reduces macro normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank five from 0.6309 without compression to 0.4738 at a thirty-two-fold pool factor. Under the same candidate-generation regime and a pool-factor-eight-equivalent reranking budget, token top-k recovers 93.93 percent of the full-token score, while greedy marginal-gain selection recovers 98.39 percent. Held-out and leave-one-dataset-out evaluations yield positive greedy improvements over token top-k on every dataset. The latency analysis reveals two useful operating points: token top-k for interactive retrieval and the naive greedy implementation as a quality upper envelope. Together, these results show that late-interaction visual retrieval benefits from query-aware allocation rather than query-agnostic pooling alone.
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM)

AI.title_translation: 面向高效晚交互视觉文档检索的查询感知令牌预算
AI.tldr: 为了解决晚交互视觉文档检索中存储和查询成本高昂的问题，该研究提出了一种两阶段方法：首先使用压缩的快速路径索引生成候选文档，然后对候选文档的原始令牌集进行查询感知的令牌预算。这种方法将选择问题建模为预算最大相似性覆盖问题，并通过比较不同的策略（包括覆盖率、聚类引导、令牌级和边际增益）来评估其有效性。实验结果表明，与静态池化相比，查询感知方法能显著提高检索性能，同时保持较低的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 晚交互视觉文档检索在存储和查询时会产生高昂的成本，这限制了其大规模部署。现有的静态池化方法在查询前就决定了要保留哪些视觉证据，不够灵活。
AI.method: 提出了一种两阶段检索方法：1. 使用高度压缩的快速路径索引生成候选文档。2. 对候选文档应用查询感知的令牌预算，将其视为一个预算约束的最大相似性覆盖问题，并研究了不同的选择策略（覆盖率、聚类引导、令牌级、边际增益）。
AI.result: 在十个ViDoRe任务上，与静态池化相比，查询感知令牌预算在相同的重排预算下，令牌前k策略恢复了93.93%的完整令牌分数，而贪婪边际增益策略恢复了98.39%的分数。此外，贪婪方法在所有数据集上都优于令牌前k策略。延迟分析表明，令牌前k适用于交互式检索，而贪婪方法是质量的上限。
AI.conclusion: 查询感知分配比单纯的查询无关池化更能使晚交互视觉检索受益。
AI.translation: 晚交互视觉文档检索器通过存储每页的许多令牌嵌入来保留细粒度的页面证据，但由此产生的存储和查询时间交互成本使得大规模部署成本高昂。在索引前对文档令牌进行池化提供了一种自然的解决方案，但静态池化必须在查询已知之前决定要保留哪些视觉证据。我们研究了一种替代方案：一个高度压缩的快速路径索引生成候选，然后查询感知的令牌预算作用于候选页面的原始令牌集。我们将这个第二阶段的选择表述为一个预算约束的最大相似性覆盖问题，证明了一个裁剪版本是单调次模的，并比较了覆盖率、聚类引导、令牌级和边际增益策略。在十个ViDoRe任务上，使用ColModernVBERT，直接静态池化将宏观归一化折损累计增益（macro normalized discounted cumulative gain）在第五名时的值从0.6309（无压缩）降低到0.4738（池化因子为32）。在相同的候选生成机制和相当于池化因子为8的重排预算下，令牌前k恢复了93.93%的完整令牌分数，而贪婪边际增益选择恢复了98.39%。留出和留一数据集评估在每个数据集上都产生了比令牌前k更有利的贪婪改进。延迟分析揭示了两个有用的操作点：用于交互式检索的令牌前k，以及作为质量上限的朴素贪婪实现。总而言之，这些结果表明，晚交互视觉检索受益于查询感知分配，而不是单纯的查询无关池化。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种用于晚交互视觉文档检索的查询感知令牌预算方法，以解决现有方法成本高昂的问题。通过两阶段检索（压缩索引生成候选，然后进行查询感知预算），并将问题建模为预算最大相似性覆盖问题，该方法在保持较低成本的同时，显著提高了检索性能，并且优于静态池化方法。
AI.keywords: 晚交互检索, 视觉文档检索, 令牌预算, 查询感知, 最大相似性覆盖
AI.comments: 这项研究有效地解决了晚交互视觉文档检索中的关键挑战，即在保证检索性能的同时降低成本。通过引入查询感知令牌预算，该方法在效率和效果之间取得了良好的平衡。然而，对于“查询感知”的具体实现方式以及其在不同类型文档和查询下的泛化能力，仍有待进一步探索。此外，模型对于“池化因子”的敏感性以及最优选择策略在不同场景下的适应性也值得关注。

title: Dense Structural Compression of Transformers via Gauge-Correct Channel Removal
comments: 10 pages main text, 28 pages total including appendices
summary:
Inference energy per token drives the cost and carbon footprint of deployed transformers. It is dominated by dense matrix products that incur fused multiply-accumulate (FMA) operations and memory traffic. To reduce these computations while retaining dense tensors for high GPU throughput, we develop a methodology from first principles to adapt structural complexity during training to maximize inference utility per unit compute. Channel penalties drive entire tensor slices to zero to enable physical removal while preserving density and the network function.
  The natural approach, penalizing the norm of operator components acting through each channel, is provably destabilized by gauge freedom. We resolve this pathology with GaugeLasso: additive symmetric group-lasso penalties that recover a monotone function of product-norms when the network converges to gauge balance. Our equilibrium analysis enables per-channel calibration to correctly suppress slices that under-perform in inference utility per unit compute.
  Under adaptive pressure, the network reorganizes into depth-dependent structural profiles that can be far smaller than the architecture required to learn the task. On polynomial long division over $\mathbb{F}_{31}$, compute compresses from 148 to 255 times with perfect accuracy. On character-level language modeling, compressed models outperform the hand-designed baseline at equal FMA. On masked autoencoding, a compression trial exposes which axes were over-provisioned and which saturated, guiding a better second design. Compaction also accelerates training monotonically as the model progresses. Post-hoc pruning with the same utility ranking cannot reach these structures, showing that sustained pressure is central to discovery of efficient models. Retraining a discovered architecture recovers baseline quality on our statistical tasks, but fails on our exact algorithmic task.
comment: 10 pages main text, 28 pages total including appendices

AI.title_translation: 基于规范修正通道移除的Transformer稠密结构压缩
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为GaugeLasso的Transformer结构压缩方法，通过解决规范自由度问题，在训练中自适应移除冗余通道，实现了计算效率的大幅提升和性能保持。
AI.motivation: 部署Transformer时的推理能量消耗及碳足迹巨大，主要由于稠密矩阵乘法导致。现有方法在去除通道时容易受到规范自由度（gauge freedom）的干扰而导致不稳定，因此需要一种从第一性原理出发、能在训练中自适应调整结构复杂性的方法。
AI.method: 开发了GaugeLasso方法，利用加性对称群Lasso惩罚项解决规范自由度带来的不稳定性，并在训练过程中施加自适应压力，通过通道惩罚实现物理上的通道移除。
AI.result: 在多项任务中表现出色：在有限域上的多项式长除法任务中，计算量压缩了148到255倍且准确率保持完美；在字符级语言建模中，压缩后的模型在相同FMA下优于手工设计的基线；在掩码自编码任务中，能有效识别资源过配或饱和的轴以指导架构设计。
AI.conclusion: 通过GaugeLasso进行稠密结构压缩能有效发现高效的Transformer架构，在保持甚至提升性能的同时大幅降低计算开销。
AI.translation:
Transformer部署时的每个token推理能量消耗决定了其成本和碳足迹。这主要由产生融合乘加（FMA）操作和内存流量的稠密矩阵乘积主导。为了在保持高GPU吞吐量的稠密张量的同时减少这些计算，我们从第一性原理出发开发了一种方法，在训练期间调整结构复杂性，以最大化每单位计算的推理效用。通道惩罚将整个张量切片驱动至零，从而在保持密度和网络功能的同时实现物理移除。
直接的方法（即对通过每个通道作用的算子分量的范数进行惩罚）被证明会因规范自由度（gauge freedom）而导致不稳定。我们通过GaugeLasso解决了这一病态问题：当网络收敛到规范平衡时，加性对称群Lasso惩罚项恢复了乘积范数的单调函数。我们的平衡分析使得每通道校准能够正确抑制在每单位计算推理效用中表现不佳的切片。
在自适应压力下，网络重组为深度依赖的结构轮廓，这些轮廓可以比学习该任务所需的架构小得多。在 $\mathbb{F}_{31}$ 上的多项式长除法任务中，计算量在保持完美准确率的情况下被压缩了 148 到 255 倍。在字符级语言建模中，压缩后的模型在相等的 FMA 下表现优于人工设计的基线。在掩码自编码中，压缩试验揭示了哪些轴被过度配置以及哪些轴饱和了，从而指导了更好的第二次设计。随着模型进展，压缩还单调地加速了训练。具有相同效用排序的事后剪枝无法达到这些结构，这表明持续的压力是发现高效模型的关键。重新训练发现的架构可以在我们的统计任务上恢复基线质量，但在我们的精确算法任务上失败了。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于规范修正通道移除（Gauge-Correct Channel Removal）的Transformer稠密结构压缩方法。通过引入GaugeLasso解决规范自由度带来的训练不稳定问题，该方法在训练过程中施加自适应压力，在保持稠密张量特性的同时物理移除低效通道，从而在多个任务中实现了显著的计算压缩和性能提升。
AI.keywords: Transformer, 模型压缩, 规范理论, 通道剪枝, 效率优化
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入规范不变性（Gauge Invariance）解决了传统Transformer通道剪枝中的不稳定性问题，提出了GaugeLasso方法，不仅在理论上有创新性，而且在实践中显著提升了Transformer的计算效率和推理效用比。

title: Singularity-Free Guiding Vector Fields on SO(3) with Designer-Specified Progression Behavior
summary: This paper develops a singularity-free guiding vector field (SF-GVF) for path following on the special orthogonal group SO(3). First, we lift the Euclidean SF-GVF construction to SO(3), integrating the augmented-state approach with the intrinsic Lie-group geometry and obtaining a closed-form geometric guidance law whose integral curves converge to a designer-specified attitude path. The field is defined on a dense open subset of SO(3), excluding only the measure-zero antipodal set - a manifestation of the topological obstruction to continuous global stabilization on SO(3). The construction requires no per-step optimization and produces a control input intrinsically in so(3) as body angular rates. Second, we formalize the progression behavior along the path as a designer-supplied function ν(ξ), promoting the parametric speed from an implicitly resolved degree of freedom to a first-class design specification. In contrast to the Euclidean condition v = 0, which excludes vehicles with minimum-speed constraints, the corresponding condition ω= 0 on SO(3) is physically admissible for most platforms with active attitude control, making the progression behavior a design freedom structurally available on SO(3) but absent in the Euclidean setting. The framework's structural results are established under a bi-invariant Riemannian metric and hold uniformly across choices of path, progression, and Lyapunov gain. The framework is illustrated in simulation on self-intersecting paths under both constant and point-convergence progression behaviors.

AI.title_translation: 具有设计者指定进程行为的SO(3)无奇异导引矢量场
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在SO(3)上进行路径跟踪的无奇异导引矢量场（SF-GVF），允许设计者指定进程行为，这是SO(3)特有的设计自由度，克服了欧几里得设置的局限性。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在开发一种在SO(3)上进行路径跟踪的无奇异导引矢量场，以克服欧几里得设置中关于进程行为和最小速度限制的局限性，并解决SO(3)上连续全局稳定化的拓扑障碍。
AI.method: 首先，将欧几里得SF-GVF构造提升到SO(3)，结合增广状态方法与内在李群几何，获得闭合形式的几何导引律。其次，将沿路径的进程行为形式化为设计者提供的函数ν(ξ)。该框架的结构结果在双不变黎曼度量下建立，并通过仿真进行了验证。
AI.result: 开发了在SO(3)上进行路径跟踪的无奇异导引矢量场（SF-GVF），其定义在SO(3)的稠密开子集上。该构造不需要每步优化，并产生so(3)中的固有控制输入。引入了设计者指定的进程行为作为一流设计规范，且SO(3)上相应的ω= 0条件物理上可行，提供了欧几里得设置中不存在的设计自由度。结构结果在路径、进程和李雅普诺增益的选择上均保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功开发了SO(3)上的无奇异导引矢量场，并引入了设计者可指定的进程行为，为姿态路径跟踪提供了新的设计自由度和鲁棒的结构结果。
AI.translation: 本文开发了一种在特殊正交群SO(3)上进行路径跟踪的无奇异导引矢量场（SF-GVF）。首先，我们将欧几里得SF-GVF构造提升到SO(3)，将增广状态方法与内在李群几何相结合，获得了一个闭合形式的几何导引律，其积分曲线收敛到设计者指定的姿态路径。该矢量场定义在SO(3)的一个稠密开子集上，仅排除了测度为零的对映点集——这是SO(3)上连续全局稳定化的拓扑障碍的表现。该构造不需要每步优化，并以so(3)中的本体角速率形式产生固有的控制输入。其次，我们将沿路径的进程行为形式化为设计者提供的函数ν(ξ)，将参数速度从隐式解析的自由度提升为一流的设计规范。与欧几里得条件v = 0（排除了具有最小速度限制的车辆）相反，SO(3)上相应的条件ω= 0对于大多数具有主动姿态控制的平台来说在物理上是可行的，这使得进程行为成为SO(3)上结构上可用但在欧几里得设置中不存在的设计自由度。该框架的结构结果是在双不变黎曼度量下建立的，并且在路径、进程和李雅普诺增益的选择上均保持一致。该框架在自相交路径上，在恒定和点收敛进程行为下进行了仿真说明。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在特殊正交群SO(3)上进行路径跟踪的无奇异导引矢量场（SF-GVF）。该方法将欧几里得SF-GVF提升到SO(3)并结合李群几何，得到一个收敛于指定姿态路径的闭合形式导引律。该矢量场在SO(3)的稠密开子集上定义，并能将路径上的进程行为作为设计者可指定的函数进行形式化，这在SO(3)上提供了欧几里得设置中不具备的设计自由度。其结构结果在双不变黎曼度量下稳健成立，并通过仿真进行了验证。
AI.keywords: 无奇异导引矢量场, SO(3), 路径跟踪, 进程行为, 李群几何
AI.comments: 这项工作具有创新性，它将欧几里得空间的SF-GVF概念成功推广到复杂的SO(3)流形，解决了姿态路径跟踪中的奇异性问题。特别值得注意的是，该方法引入了设计者可指定的进程行为，将其从隐式自由度提升为显式设计规范，并在SO(3)上提供了独特的物理可行性，这对于实际应用中的姿态控制系统是一个重要的进步。该框架的结构结果在不同选择下保持一致性，显示了其鲁棒性。

title: Task-Blind No MORE: Multi-Task Information Flow in Unified Ranking Backbones
summary:
Industrial ranking models for recommendation have scaled feature interaction and sequence modeling separately; recent architectures such as HyFormer and MixFormer unify both in a stackable backbone. Real-world recommender systems, however, nearly always require multi-task learning, yet existing unified architectures confine multi-task modeling to shallow post-backbone towers, leaving the backbone without task-aware information flow. We propose MORE (Multi-task cO-evolving Ranking modEl), which embeds multi-task information flow inside the backbone, enabling task-specific signals to co-evolve with sequence and feature representations at every layer rather than in a post-hoc fusion. It introduces Anchor Tokens that persist across backbone layers: Shared Anchors encode cross-task commonalities, while Private Anchors capture task-specific priors. In each block, Anchor Tokens (1) read task-conditioned signals from behavior sequences, (2) mix with non-sequential features under a task-boundary mask, and (3) refine per-task representations through independent branches; as blocks stack, each task obtains a differentiated representation refined through all backbone layers.
  Experiments on large-scale industrial datasets show that MORE consistently outperforms baselines across all tasks under comparable parameter and FLOPs budgets, and scales well with model size. Online A/B tests on Momo, a leading Chinese social discovery platform with tens of millions of monthly active users, yield 3% improvement in usage duration, 3.6% in interaction rate, and 2% in deep-chat rate. MORE is deployed in production with request-level shared computation reducing scoring latency by about 30%.

AI.title_translation: 告别任务盲区：统一排序骨干网络中的多任务信息流
AI.tldr: 本文提出了MORE模型，将多任务学习深度内嵌于统一的推荐排序骨干网络中，实现了任务信号与特征、序列的逐层协同演化，在提升推荐效果的同时显著降低了线上推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的统一排序骨干网络（如HyFormer和MixFormer）将多任务建模局限于浅层的骨干网络后方塔结构中，导致骨干网络缺乏任务感知的信息流，无法满足真实世界推荐系统中多任务学习的需求。
AI.method: 提出了MORE（Multi-task cO-evolving Ranking modEl）模型，在骨干网络内部嵌入多任务信息流，引入了在各层之间持久存在的Anchor Tokens（包括Shared Anchors和Private Anchors），通过读取序列、特征混合和独立分支细化，实现多任务信号与序列及特征表示的逐层协同演化。
AI.result: 在大规模工业数据集上，MORE在同等参数量和FLOPs预算下全面优于基线模型；在陌陌的线上A/B测试中，使用时长提升3%，互动率提升3.6%，深度聊天率提升2%，并且线上部署实现了约30%的打分延迟降低。
AI.conclusion: MORE架构通过将多任务信息流内嵌于统一排序骨干网中，有效解决了传统统一架构中多任务建模流于浅层的痛点，是工业级推荐系统在模型架构演进方面的一项重要突破。
AI.translation: 工业推荐排序模型分别对特征交互和序列建模进行了规模化扩展；诸如HyFormer和MixFormer等最新架构在可堆叠的骨干网络中统一了这两者。然而，现实世界的推荐系统几乎总是需要多任务学习，但现有的统一架构将多任务建模局限于骨干网络后方的浅层塔结构中，使得骨干网络缺乏任务感知的信息流。为此，我们提出了MORE（多任务协同演化排序模型），它将多任务信息流嵌入骨干网络内部，使任务特定信号能够在每一层与序列和特征表示协同演化，而不是进行事后融合。它引入了在骨干网络各层中持久存在的锚点Token（Anchor Tokens）：共享锚点（Shared Anchors）编码跨任务共性，而私有锚点（Private Anchors）捕获任务特定先验。在每个模块中，锚点Token（1）从行为序列中读取任务条件信号，（2）在任务边界掩码下与非序列特征混合，以及（3）通过独立分支精炼每个任务的表示；随着模块的堆叠，每个任务都能获得经过所有骨干网络层精炼的差异化表示。在大规模工业数据集上的实验表明，在同等参数量和FLOPs预算下，MORE在所有任务上均持续优于基线模型，且随模型规模扩展良好。在拥有数千万月活用户的领先中国社交发现平台——陌陌上进行的线上A/B测试表明，使用时长提升了3%，互动率提升了3.6%，深层聊天率提升了2%。MORE已在生产环境中部署，其请求级别的共享计算将打分延迟降低了约30%。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有统一推荐排序骨干网络忽视深层多任务信息流的问题，提出了MORE模型。该模型通过引入共享和私有Anchor Tokens，将多任务建模深度嵌入骨干网络的每一层，实现了任务信号与特征、序列的逐层协同演化。实验证明其在离线性能、线上业务指标以及推理延迟方面均取得了显著提升。
AI.keywords: 多任务学习, 推荐系统, 排序模型, 骨干网络, 锚点Token
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多任务学习深度融合到统一的排序骨干网络中，改变了以往“浅层塔式多任务”的做法，通过锚点Token实现了特征、序列与多任务信号的逐层协同演化，不仅在离线指标上表现优异，还在工业界大规模上线并取得了显著的线上业务增长和推理加速效果。

title: LightSplat: Real-Time High-Fidelity 3D Gaussian SLAM with Loop Closure
comments: Accepted to 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have recently demonstrated promising reconstruction accuracy for dense 3D scene representations. However, current 3DGS systems struggle to meet the strict demands of real-world deployments due to severe limitations in operational performance and map adaptability. To this end, we propose LightSplat, a hybrid-representation RGB-D SLAM framework. It synergizes local sparse features for robust and fast tracking with a dual-thread backend that progressively constructs dense Gaussian submaps. Crucially, we enable online loop closure through feature-accelerated 3DGS registration, refining overall map consistency through pose graph optimization. Ultimately, LightSplat achieves the online reconstruction of high-fidelity Gaussian map. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets and real-world robotic platform demonstrate that our method achieves near state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and the capability to accommodate practical camera motions, maintaining an average framerate of 8 FPS. Overall, LightSplat provides an efficient and robust foundation for deploying high-fidelity 3DGS in real-world environments.
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)

AI.title_translation: LightSplat：具有回环检测功能的实时高保真 3D 高斯 SLAM
AI.tldr: LightSplat 是一个高效、鲁棒的 3D Gaussian SLAM 框架，通过引入局部稀疏特征、双线程后端和在线回环检测，在真实世界中实现了高保真度的实时 3D 重建。
AI.motivation: 当前的 3DGS 系统由于在运行性能和地图适应性方面的严重限制，难以满足真实世界部署的严格要求。
AI.method: 提出 LightSplat 混合表示 RGB-D SLAM 框架，结合用于鲁棒且快速跟踪的局部稀疏特征、渐进式构建稠密高斯子图的双线程后端，以及通过特征加速 3DGS 配准和位姿图优化实现的在线回环检测。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和真实机器人平台上进行的大量实验表明，该方法实现了接近当前最优的重建质量，能够适应实际的相机运动，并维持平均 8 FPS 的帧率。
AI.conclusion: LightSplat 提供了一个高效且鲁棒的框架，实现了真实世界环境中高保真 3DGS 的在线重建，在保证高重建质量的同时兼顾了实用性。
AI.translation: 基于 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 的 SLAM 系统最近在密集 3D 场景表示方面展示了有前景的重建精度。然而，由于在运行性能和地图适应性方面的严重限制，当前的 3DGS 系统难以满足真实世界部署的严格要求。为此，我们提出了 LightSplat，一个混合表示的 RGB-D SLAM 框架。它将用于鲁棒且快速跟踪的局部稀疏特征与渐进式构建密集高斯子图的双线程后端协同起来。至关重要的是，我们通过特征加速的 3DGS 配准实现了在线回环检测，并通过位姿图优化来完善整体地图的一致性。最终，LightSplat 实现了高保真高斯地图的在线重建。在多个数据集和真实机器人平台上进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法实现了接近当前最优的重建质量，并具备适应实际相机运动的能力，同时保持了平均 8 FPS 的帧率。总的来说，LightSplat 为在真实世界环境中部署高保真 3DGS 提供了一个高效且鲁棒的基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 LightSplat，一个基于混合表示的 RGB-D SLAM 框架。它将局部稀疏特征与双线程后端相结合以构建稠密高斯子图，并通过特征加速的 3DGS 配准和位姿图优化支持在线回环检测，从而在真实世界环境中实现了高效、鲁棒的高保真 3D 地图重建。
AI.keywords: 3D Gaussian Splatting, SLAM, RGB-D, 回环检测, 实时重建
AI.comments: LightSplat 针对现有 3DGS SLAM 系统在实时性能和地图适应性上的不足，创新性地提出了一种混合表示的 RGB-D SLAM 框架，通过引入局部稀疏特征和双线程后端，并支持在线回环检测与位姿图优化，有效提升了地图的一致性和重建精度，为 3DGS 在真实世界机器人中的实际部署奠定了坚实基础。

title: Mathematical Modeling of a Cognitive Continuum Digital Shadow for Large-Scale, Cross-Facility Workflows
summary: We present the mathematical foundations of a \emph{Cognitive Continuum Digital Shadow} (CCDS), a decision-support layer between users and the cross-facility infrastructure---instruments, networks, data stores and compute centers---of exascale and post-exascale scientific workflows. The CCDS couples a state-space representation of the continuum with multistage stochastic programming, so that deployment scenarios can be explored and optimized \emph{before} jobs are launched. This allows operators and users to quantify the cost, makespan and energy trade-offs of a workflow under uncertain resource availability, and hedge their decisions accordingly. We formulate the underlying optimization as a multimode, resource-constrained, stochastic supply-chain network design problem and demonstrate it on a realistic genomics workflow scheduled across heterogeneous HPC and data-center resources. This is the first of three papers; the second treats the underlying software architecture and the third reports large-scale use-cases.

AI.title_translation: 认知连续体数字阴影在大规模、跨设施工作流中的数学建模
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了认知连续体数字阴影（CCDS）的数学基础，这是一个用于管理大规模科学工作流的决策支持层。CCDS 使用状态空间表示和多阶段随机规划来优化资源部署，并在资源可用性不确定时量化成本、完成时间和能源的权衡。
AI.motivation: 为了在作业启动之前探索和优化大规模、跨设施科学工作流的部署方案，量化成本、完成时间和能源的权衡，并相应地对冲决策。
AI.method: 提出认知连续体数字阴影（CCDS），它将状态空间表示与多阶段随机规划相结合，以解决多模式、资源约束、随机供应链网络设计问题。
AI.result: 在现实的基因组学工作流上进行了演示，该工作流跨异构 HPC 和数据中心资源进行调度。
AI.conclusion: CCDS 为大规模科学工作流提供了一个数学框架，用于在资源不确定性下进行决策支持和优化。
AI.translation: 我们提出了	extit{认知连续体数字阴影}（CCDS）的数学基础，这是一个位于用户和前沿科学工作流的跨设施基础设施（仪器、网络、数据存储和计算中心）之间的决策支持层。CCDS 将连续体的状态空间表示与多阶段随机规划相结合，以便在作业启动	extit{之前}探索和优化部署方案。这使得操作员和用户能够量化在资源可用性不确定情况下工作流的成本、完成时间和能源的权衡，并相应地对冲他们的决策。我们将潜在的优化问题形式化为一个多模式、资源约束、随机供应链网络设计问题，并在跨异构 HPC 和数据中心资源调度的现实基因组学工作流上进行了演示。这是三篇论文中的第一篇；第二篇将介绍基础软件架构，第三篇将报告大规模用例。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了认知连续体数字阴影（CCDS）的数学框架，旨在为前沿科学工作流中的用户和跨设施基础设施（如仪器、网络、数据存储和计算中心）之间提供决策支持。CCDS 结合了状态空间表示和多阶段随机规划，允许在执行前优化部署方案，并量化在资源可用性不确定情况下的成本、完成时间和能源消耗之间的权衡。该方法被表述为一个多模式、资源约束、随机供应链网络设计问题，并在一个跨异构 HPC 和数据中心资源的基因组学工作流上进行了验证。
AI.keywords: 认知连续体数字阴影, 科学工作流, 随机规划, 供应链网络设计, 资源优化
AI.comments: 该研究为管理复杂的大规模科学工作流提供了一个创新的数学框架。CCDS 的核心思想是通过在作业启动前进行优化来应对资源不确定性，这对于前沿科学计算至关重要。然而，该方法在实际应用中的计算复杂性和可扩展性仍有待进一步研究。此外，该模型对“认知连续体”的定义和量化方式也值得深入探讨。

title: Matryoshka Hash Representations for Model-Aware Compact Semantic Retrieval
summary:
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) depends on dense retrieval: each document is stored as a learned vector, and a query is answered by finding its nearest neighbors in that vector space. Keeping one full-precision vector per document is the dominant index cost at corpus scale, so retrieval systems replace each vector with a short code of a few bytes---a step called quantization. Standard quantizers such as product quantization (PQ) pick the code that reconstructs the original vector most closely.
  A single code is even more useful if it serves several byte budgets at once: when its short prefixes are each directly searchable, a deployment can set its efficiency--quality operating point without re-encoding the corpus. But training all prefixes under one objective makes the early bits a compromise across budgets---short codes improve while the full-width code degrades. Quantization to low-bit representation, such as binary codes, further sharpens the conflict. We introduce Matryoshka Hash Representations (MHR), a two-stage procedure that separates full-width training from prefix organization. MHR first learns a longer binary code, then freezes the model and trains additional zero-initialized residual code adaptors for directly searchable prefixes. Documents are stored at one bit per coordinate, while queries keep continuous logits like PQ to attain sufficient expressivity. We implement the search process with FAISS FastScan. Trained on MS MARCO and zero-shot transferred to seven BEIR datasets, MHR reaches .5561 NDCG@10 and .6535 Recall@100 at 32 bytes, surpassing the best baseline of the same budget. The advantage is more pronounced in lower budgets. The same code also strengthens two common pipelines: shortlisting candidates for full-precision reranking, and pruning a low-storage graph index such as LEANN.

AI.title_translation: 用于模型感知紧凑语义检索的套娃哈希表示
AI.tldr: 本文提出了套娃哈希表示（MHR）方法，通过两阶段训练解决了稠密检索中多字节预算的性能折中问题，在极低存储成本下实现了优于现有基线的检索准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的单代码量化在支持多字节预算（套娃式前缀搜索）时存在折中问题，即早期比特位需要在不同预算间妥协，导致短代码改善的同时全宽代码性能下降，低比特量化（如二进制代码）更剧了这一冲突。
AI.method: 提出套娃哈希表示（MHR）的两阶段训练过程：首先学习较长的二进制代码，然后冻结模型并训练额外的零初始化残差代码适配器以实现可直接搜索的前缀；文档以每坐标1位存储，查询保留连续逻辑值以保证足够的表达能力，并使用 FAISS FastScan 实现搜索过程。
AI.result: 在 MS MARCO 上训练并在 7 个 BEIR 数据集上进行零样本迁移时，MHR 在 32 字节下达到了 0.5561 的 NDCG@10 和 0.635 的 Recall@100，超越了同等预算下的最佳基线，且在更低预算下优势更加显著，同时能够增强候选重排和图索引剪枝等常见流水线。
AI.conclusion: MHR 是一种有效的模型感知紧凑语义检索方法，通过解耦全宽训练与前缀组织，在不同字节预算下均能实现卓越的检索性能，且在低字节预算下优势尤为明显。
AI.translation:
检索增强生成（RAG）依赖于稠密检索：每个文档被存储为一个学习到的向量，通过在向量空间中寻找最近邻来回答查询。在语料库规模下，每个文档保留一个全精度向量是主要的索引成本，因此检索系统用几个字节的短代码代替每个向量——这一步骤称为量化。诸如乘积量化（PQ）的标准量化器会选择最接近重建原始向量的代码。
如果一个单一的代码能同时服务于多个字节预算，它将更加有用：当其短代码前缀都可以直接搜索时，部署系统就可以在不重新编码语料库的情况下设置其效率与质量的折中点。但是，在一个目标下训练所有前缀会使早期比特成为跨预算的妥协——短代码改善的同时，全宽代码却在退化。诸如二进制代码的低比特表示量化进一步加剧了这种冲突。我们引入了套娃哈希表示（MHR），这是一个将全宽训练与前缀组织分离的两阶段过程。MHR 首先学习一个较长的二进制代码，然后冻结模型并训练额外的零初始化残差代码适配器，以获得可直接搜索的前缀。文档以每坐标一位（one bit per coordinate）存储，而查询则保持类似 PQ 的连续逻辑值（logits）以获得足够的表达能力。我们使用 FAISS FastScan 实现了搜索过程。在 MS MARCO 上训练并在七个 BEIR 数据集上进行零样本迁移时，MHR 在 32 字节下达到了 0.5561 的 NDCG@10 和 0.6535 的 Recall@100，超过了同等预算的最佳基线。这种优势在更低的预算下更加明显。相同的代码还增强了两个常见的流水线：为全精度重排筛选候选，以及剪枝诸如 LEANN 等低存储图索引。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了套娃哈希表示（MHR），这是一种用于模型感知紧凑语义检索的两阶段量化方法，能够解决多字节预算下的性能折中问题，并在保持高效的同时显著提升检索准确率。
AI.keywords: 稠密检索, 量化, 套娃哈希表示, 检索增强生成, 向量索引
AI.comments: 该论文针对稠密检索中的量化效率与精度权衡问题，提出了套娃哈希表示（MHR）方法，通过两阶段训练成功解决了多字节预算下的性能折中问题，在各种检索和重排任务中表现出优异的性能。

title: Merging Cyber Threat Intelligence Through Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Small Language Models for Rich Threat Representation
summary: Modern cybersecurity operations rely on CTI collected from heterogeneous sources, including semi-structured threat representations, IoCs, and narrative technical reports. However, these artifacts are often insufficient in isolation to reconstruct how an attack unfolds, under which conditions each step is feasible, and which traces it leaves behind. In practice, analysts must manually correlate partial evidence scattered across multiple and only partially structured sources, delaying the design of effective prevention, detection, and response actions. To address this gap, we propose an automated pipeline that derives an actionable representation of a cyberattack from heterogeneous CTI sources. The pipeline combines a RAG architecture with a locally deployable SLM, used to consolidate such evidence and infer missing operational details. Starting from a semi-structured threat representation and auxiliary CTI documents, the pipeline produces an enriched Attack Graph that captures a coarse, tactic-aligned progression of the attack and annotates each step with explicit pre-conditions and post-conditions, and an enriched description. This representation supports prevention by exposing execution requirements, detection by highlighting observable traces, and response by clarifying the temporal progression of the attack. Then, due to the lack of validated datasets with ground-truth information on the temporal evolution of real-world attacks, we test the complete pipeline on 10 real-world case studies spanning multiple threat types, including backdoors and staged downloaders delivered via phishing. A manual assessment across 10 real-world case studies provides initial evidence that the generated graphs are consistent with expected attack progressions, indicating that the proposed approach can support analysts by consolidating dispersed CTI evidence into a structured and actionable view of attacks.

AI.title_translation: 合并网络威胁情报，通过检索增强生成和小型语言模型实现丰富的威胁表示
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种自动化流程，结合检索增强生成（RAG）和本地部署的小型语言模型（SLM），从异构网络威胁情报（CTI）源中提取丰富、可操作的网络攻击表示。该流程旨在解决手动关联分散证据的低效问题，通过生成包含先决条件、后置条件和可观察痕迹的攻击图，从而支持预防、检测和响应。在10个真实案例研究中的测试表明，该方法能够将分散的CTI证据整合为结构化的攻击视图，为分析师提供支持。
AI.motivation: 现代网络安全运营依赖于来自异构来源的网络威胁情报（CTI），但这些信息通常不足以单独重建攻击的全貌，包括攻击如何展开、每个步骤的可行条件以及留下的痕迹。分析师需要手动关联多个来源的部分证据，这延迟了有效预防、检测和响应措施的设计。
AI.method: 提出一个自动化流程，结合检索增强生成（RAG）架构和本地部署的小型语言模型（SLM）。该流程以半结构化的威胁表示和辅助CTI文档为输入，旨在整合证据并推断缺失的操作细节，最终生成一个丰富的攻击图。该攻击图捕获了攻击的粗粒度、与战术对齐的进展，并为每个步骤添加了明确的先决条件、后置条件以及一个丰富的描述。
AI.result: 在10个涵盖后门和通过网络钓鱼交付的分阶段下载器的真实案例研究中对完整流程进行了测试。手动评估表明，生成的攻击图与预期的攻击进展一致，表明该方法能够将分散的CTI证据整合为结构化的攻击视图，从而支持分析师。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的自动化流程，通过结合RAG和SLM，能够将分散的网络威胁情报（CTI）证据整合为结构化的、可操作的攻击表示（如攻击图），从而支持网络安全分析师进行预防、检测和响应。尽管缺乏经过验证的真实攻击时间演化数据集，但对10个真实案例的研究表明该方法具有潜力。
AI.translation: 现代网络安全运营依赖于从异构来源收集的网络威胁情报（CTI），包括半结构化的威胁表示、IoCs和叙述性技术报告。然而，这些信息孤立来看往往不足以重建攻击如何展开、每个步骤的可行条件以及它留下哪些痕迹。在实践中，分析师必须手动关联分散在多个且仅部分结构化的来源中的部分证据，从而延迟了有效预防、检测和响应措施的设计。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种自动化流程，从异构CTI来源中提取可操作的网络攻击表示。该流程结合了RAG架构和一个本地部署的SLM，用于整合这些证据并推断缺失的操作细节。从半结构化的威胁表示和辅助CTI文档开始，该流程生成一个丰富的攻击图，该图捕获了攻击的粗粒度、与战术对齐的进展，并为每个步骤添加了明确的先决条件、后置条件以及一个丰富的描述。这种表示通过暴露执行需求来支持预防，通过突出可观察的痕迹来支持检测，并通过阐明攻击的时间进展来支持响应。然后，由于缺乏关于真实世界攻击时间演化的经过验证的数据集，我们在10个真实案例研究中测试了完整流程，这些案例涵盖了多种威胁类型，包括通过网络钓鱼交付的后门和分阶段下载器。对10个真实案例研究的手动评估提供了初步证据，表明生成的攻击图与预期的攻击进展一致，表明所提出的方法可以通过将分散的CTI证据整合为结构化的可操作的攻击视图来支持分析师。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种自动化流程，利用检索增强生成（RAG）和小型语言模型（SLM）来整合异构的网络威胁情报（CTI）源，并生成结构化的、可操作的网络攻击表示。该方法旨在解决分析师手动关联分散证据的挑战，通过生成包含攻击步骤、先决条件、后置条件以及可观察痕迹的攻击图，从而增强网络安全防御能力。在10个真实案例研究中的初步评估表明，该方法能够有效地将零散的CTI信息转化为有价值的攻击视图。
AI.keywords: 网络威胁情报, 检索增强生成, 小型语言模型, 攻击图, 威胁表示
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法，利用RAG和SLM来自动化网络威胁情报的整合和分析，这在处理海量、异构的CTI数据方面具有重要意义。其生成的攻击图能够提供结构化的威胁表示，对安全分析师非常有价值。然而，研究中提到“缺乏经过验证的真实攻击时间演化数据集”是其测试的一个限制，未来可以考虑如何构建或利用此类数据集来进一步验证模型的有效性。此外，SLM的本地部署特性值得关注，这可能有助于解决数据隐私和计算资源的问题。

title: Separating Stream Stability from Long-Term Recall in Language Models
summary: Methods for streaming language models are often discussed alongside long-context and memory systems, although they solve different problems. An attention sink can stabilize autoregressive generation over an indefinitely long stream while the model remains unable to use content that has left its recent-token cache. We argue that this distinction should be explicit in system claims and evaluation. We introduce three horizons: the stability horizon, over which predictive behavior remains well behaved; the access horizon, over which past content can still causally affect the output; and the utility horizon, over which a task retains acceptable performance. We show constructively that the stability horizon can be infinite while the access and utility horizons are finite. We then propose ThreeH, an evaluation contract that measures all three horizons under a common state and compute budget. Applying the framework to attention-sink streaming clarifies its strength, constant-memory, stable generation, without treating anchor tokens as semantic memory. The framework exposes roles for cache policies, recurrent state, retrieval, and external memory. Experiments on 128K-token streams, delayed binding recall, and delayed decisions show that attention sinks preserve local modeling but not content beyond the active cache; recurrent and retrieval state extend the semantic horizon.

title: TAD: Token-Adaptive Contrastive Decoding with Confidence-Guided Gating for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) can hallucinate audio objects, answering "yes" to absent sound events, thus undermining reliability in audio question answering. We propose Token-Adaptive Decoding (TAD), a training-free strategy for hallucination mitigation that grounds the initial yes/no decision by contrasting logits under real audio with a matched silent reference. TAD introduces a token-adaptive, confidence-guided gate that is decision-critical at the first decoding step and class-conditional on affirmative tokens, using the audio-silent margin to avoid overcorrection when evidence is weak or already sufficient. Experiments on AudioCaps-Hallucination show that, relative to Audio-Aware Decoding (AAD), a contrastive baseline with fixed contrast strength, TAD improves F1 for Qwen2 by 0.059 to 0.117 across Popular, Adversarial, and Random splits, and for Gemma by 0.025 to 0.064, while on Clotho-AQA it raises F1 from 0.810 to 0.816 on Qwen2 and remains comparable to AAD on Gemma.

title: How Long Until Your Robot Ignores You? A Safety Benchmark for LLM Orchestrators in Human-Humanoid Collaboration
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly employed to orchestrate robot behavior through natural-language interfaces, yet no benchmark exists to evaluate their reliability as safety-aware decision makers in human-humanoid collaboration. Unlike deterministic safety systems that enforce binary allow/deny decisions, LLM-based orchestrators exhibit a compliance spectrum ranging from overcompliance (refusing safe actions) to full safety violations. This paper introduces the first safety benchmarking environment for LLM orchestrators in human-humanoid collaboration, built on a Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based architecture with safety invariants grounded in ISO 10218-2:2025 protective measures. The benchmark defines five testable safety invariants, a four-level compliance taxonomy (correct compliance, overcompliance, undercompliance, full violation), and a three-layer evaluation pipeline (text prompting, simulated sensor-actuator loops, and physical validation on a Unitree G1 EDU humanoid). We report Layer-1 results: three cloud backends (Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash) and a local open-weights baseline (qwen3:8b) across 40 100-turn sessions under full-context and sliding-window budget conditions, while the simulation and physical layers remain ongoing. We find that (1) model family determines the safety floor, as Claude and Gemini remain at or near zero violations while GPT-4o-mini commits up to 13 per session, (2) context management dissociates two failure axes, reducing mean behavioral issues by 42-57% for every cloud backend while nearly doubling GPT-4o-mini's violations (3.8 to 7.2 per session), and (3) proportional compliance, clamping movement speed to the rule-specified maximum rather than refusing, emerges consistently only in Gemini; the preliminary simulation layer reproduces the model ranking and the GPT-4o-mini failure-mode inversion.

title: Quality Metrics for LLM-Generated Asset Administration Shells: A Perturbation-Based Evaluation Approach
summary: The rapid digital transformation of manufacturing, often referred to as Industry 4.0, relies on seamless interoperability between physical and software assets. A central enabler is the Asset Administration Shell (AAS), a standardized digital representation of such assets. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable the generation of AAS submodels from unstructured sources such as product datasheets but raise challenges for quality assurance. In particular, unexpected errors, the lack of ground truth references, and the absence of standardized quality metrics hinder reliable adoption. In this work, we evaluate quality metrics for AI-generated AAS using a perturbation-based evaluation framework. By systematically degrading AAS generation along multiple dimensions, we assess how well different metrics reflect quality changes. Based on a dataset of 200 products from multiple manufacturers, we generate 6,400 AAS instances using GPT-4o-mini, Qwen3, and DeepSeek-R1. Our results show that metrics based on exact matching of property names and similarity-based soft matching of property values, in particular value-based recall and name-based F1 score, provide the most reliable indicators of quality degradation. Furthermore, we quantify the impact of different perturbation types and analyze differences across model families and product segments. These findings support the selection of suitable metrics, the tuning of LLM-based pipelines, and the integration of AI-generated AAS into industrial applications.

title: Ex Ante Estimation of Payable Relief and Compensation Timing for Supplier Selection
summary:
Supplier selection affects not only operating performance but also the payable network entered by a new obligation. This paper develops the Compensability Capacity Assessment (CCA), an ex ante buyer-supplier measure of expected gross payable relief and its likely timing. CPM provides the bounded structural kernel; concave CCA variants add bilateral invoice capacity. The measure is tested on 749,952 analytical invoices issued during 2012-2023, using frozen nine-month histories and future weekly, monthly, quarterly, semester, and annual windows. Cycle-restricted and path-enabled clearing are independent outcome-generating environments used to validate the measure, not technologies compared by this study.
  Across seven fully observed quarters in 2022-2023, log-CCA has a median Spearman correlation of 0.638 with future integrated relief; persistent relations carry 93.5% of relief, and the highest-scoring relation captures 92.5% of buyer-specific best relief. Predictability remains positive from week to year, with quarterly recalibration providing the best operating balance between signal, coverage, and timeliness. A timing analysis shows that, across the two validation environments, 89-91% of attributed relief occurs within seven days of invoice issue and 94-96% within thirty days, on average about sixteen days before contractual maturity. Log-CCA correlates 0.564 with thirty-day relief and 0.566 with relief-days. Its highest quartile has a 96.5% median probability of thirty-day compensation, compared with 57.6% in the lowest quartile. Conditional waiting-time prediction is weaker, so CCA should rank timely compensation opportunity rather than forecast an exact payment date. The findings link supplier placement, financial circularity, and working-capital exposure while motivating deployment, causal testing, and quarterly drift monitoring.

title: Constitutive State-Space Modeling of Path-Dependent Plasticity: A Resolution-Consistent and Parallelizable Computational Framework
summary: Data-driven constitutive models for path-dependent plasticity are commonly formulated using nonlinear recurrent neural networks, whose sequential state evolution limits parallel training and whose predictions may depend on the discretization of the applied strain path. We introduce a Constitutive State Space (CSS) model that reformulates structured state-space dynamics as an incremental constitutive operator. The strain increment is decomposed into magnitude and direction: the loading direction drives the latent state-space system, while the increment magnitude enters the zero-order-hold discretization of its continuous-time linear recurrence. This mechanics-tailored construction guarantees stationarity under zero increments, strongly reduces sensitivity to strain-path resolution, and retains the parallel-scan structure of S5 for efficient training on long constitutive histories. The CSS and Minimal State Cell (MSC) architectures are compared for four multiaxial path-dependent material models including isotropic J2 plasticity, pressure-sensitive foam plasticity, and combined isotropic-kinematic hardening. CSS matches or exceeds the prediction accuracy of the MSC, including one order of magnitude lower validation losses for the plastically incompressible materials. Importantly, CSS maintains low errors across large changes in strain-path discretization, whereas the MSC error increases substantially when evaluated at coarser resolutions than used for training. CSS trains substantially faster and requires fewer strain-stress pairs to attain comparable or better accuracy. Analysis of the learned state further reveals latent structure consistent with the dimensionality of the underlying physical constitutive models. These results establish mechanics-tailored structured state-space dynamics as a computational framework for efficient and discretization-robust data-driven constitutive modeling.

title: Probing the Structure and Dynamics of LLM Value Expression through Value Conflicts
comments: Code and data are available at https://github.com/ZeroGen-Lab/CFProbe
summary: Ethical evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) often characterizes model values as static and monolithic. In contrast, we argue that LLM value expression is better understood as a structured yet dynamic phenomenon. To investigate this, we introduce Conflict-driven Value Probing, a controlled framework that places LLMs in value conflicts and implements four types of interventions that perturb these conflicts to probe LLM value expression. Applying this framework to ten LLMs, we identify three recurring patterns. (1) Expression duality: models shift from broad idealistic orientations in abstract assessment toward more pragmatic priorities in concrete conflicts. (2) Functional steerability: models readily reconfigure their expressed value profiles toward task-defined value objectives. (3) Bounded plasticity: such reconfiguration is not without constraints, i.e. pressure induces a security- and goal-oriented priority shift while negative framing distinguishes protected values from those more amenable to redirection. Together, these findings characterize both the structure and dynamics of LLM value expression: context flexibly reconfigures expressed priorities, yet within behavioral boundaries. This behavioral account provides a foundation for understanding controllability, alignment, and safety in LLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ZeroGen-Lab/CFProbe.
comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/ZeroGen-Lab/CFProbe

title: KODAMA: Multimodal Digital Twin Reconstruction for Urban RF Propagation Modelling
summary: 3D reconstruction typically strives for geometric fidelity or visual plausibility. Radio frequency digital twins (RFDT) are instead judged by whether communication channels behave in them as they do in the real world. RFDTs promise site-specific channel prediction but current practice forces a choice between coarse automated scenes and hand-built, measurement-calibrated models that take weeks to construct per-site. We present KODAMA, an automated pipeline that reconstructs ray tracing-ready RFDTs at city scale from off-the-shelf geospatial data alone: aerial imagery, LiDAR, and photogrammetry yield terrain and watertight building meshes, while exposure-weighted multi-view fusion of street-level imagery recovers façade relief, electromagnetic materials, and clutter---all without site visits or calibration. Across three sites spanning 3.6 to 28 GHz, KODAMA's uncalibrated predictions achieve single-digit RMSE, reducing point-to-point error by up to 5.35 dB over automated baselines and coming within 0.22 dB of a measurement-calibrated, hand-built RFDT.

title: World Models Under Asynchronous Sensor Observations
comments: 13 pages, 2 figures. All authors contributed equally
summary: Learned world models typically assume that observations arrive synchronously, an abstraction inherited from simulators that return a complete state vector at each environment step. Physical sensing instead operates at heterogeneous rates, leaving most observation channels stale at any given instant. Interpolating stale channels introduces measurements that were never observed, while downsampling to the slowest sensor discards valid measurements. A natural alternative is to zero-order-hold the most recent reading and provide the known sampling schedule to the model through two features, staleness and time-to-refresh. We test this prediction using transformer world models across three regimes of increasing causal coupling: open-loop rollouts in continuous-control locomotion, closed-loop model-predictive planning in which each learned model serves as the planner dynamics, and a linear latched-actuator system in which refresh events apply a zero-order-held command to the plant. Our findings show that the effectiveness of time-to-refresh depends on the causal role of the sampling schedule, specifically when refresh events affect the system rather than merely report its state. These results establish when sampling schedules provide useful information for predictive world models operating under asynchronous physical observations.
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. All authors contributed equally

title: PCFlow: Physics-Conditioned Flow Matching for GPR B-Scan Image Synthesis
summary: Ground-penetrating radar (GPR) B-scan image synthesis is important for data augmentation, algorithm validation, and simulation acceleration, yet generating radargrams with both visual realism and physical consistency remains challenging. Existing learning-based generative models often emphasize visual appearance but provide limited control over response geometry. In this paper, we propose PCFlow, a physics-conditioned flow matching framework for fast GPR B-scan image synthesis. The core of PCFlow is a Maxwell-informed dense physical condition field constructed from the parameterized physical model used for electromagnetic simulation, including material properties, target geometry, propagation cues, and response-domain priors. This condition field provides an interpretable interface between physical scene parameters and radar response geometry, and guides conditional flow matching in the VAE latent space toward physically feasible generation paths. We evaluate PCFlow on a gprMax-based buried-pipeline dataset with both in-distribution and out-of-distribution test cases. Experimental results show that PCFlow generates images with more accurate response geometry and high visual fidelity, demonstrating its effectiveness for controllable and physically faithful radar image synthesis.

title: Timescale-aware surrogate-assisted multi-objective optimization of battery cell design for energy density, fast charging, and degradation
summary: Battery cell design must balance energy density, fast charging, and degradation, yet these metrics evolve over different time scales and are costly to optimize jointly. We develop a timescale-aware surrogate-assisted framework that evaluates beginning-of-life volumetric energy density and 10--80% charging time together with state-of-health (SOH) loss over 200 cycles. Physics-based simulations of 1501 cell designs generate 1427 quality-controlled samples across 12 manufacturing-relevant parameters. Objective-specific surrogates support total-order Sobol analysis, which reveals distinct parameter rankings across the three metrics. A cross-objective rank-union strategy then retains variables influential to at least one objective before evolutionary Pareto optimization. Re-evaluation of the optimized candidates using the original physics-based models confirms designs that outperform the reference cell in all three metrics. Among these jointly improving candidates, the objective-wise best solutions, attained by different designs, can reduce SOH loss by 99.31%, increase volumetric energy density by 12.49%, and shorten charging time by 28.73%. The framework makes Pareto exploration across disparate electrochemical timescales computationally tractable, thereby enabling systematic multi-objective optimization of battery cell design.

title: Long-Horizon Language Model Reinforcement Learning via Progressive Point Matching
summary: Current paradigms for training language models via reinforcement learning rely heavily on sparse outcome rewards. However, as we pursue tasks that require longer and more complicated trajectories, such strategies result in slow learning. Prior work has attempted to address this problem by rewarding partial progress; however, naive formulations are often biased and converge to suboptimal policies. We show that a simple and unbiased dense reward formulation, which we term progressive point matching, scales exponentially more efficiently to long-horizon tasks by rewarding partial progress on a segment level, both theoretically and empirically via synthetic environments. We then show how progressive point matching can be practically instantiated using a single reference trajectory per task.
