AI.title_translation: OntologyBench: 密集检索能否满足结构化生物医学约束？
AI.tldr: OntologyBench是一个生物医学检索基准。研究发现，密集检索在处理关系和组合任务时表现不如概念接地任务，且难以可靠地恢复本体论编码的兼容性。
AI.motivation: 评估密集检索系统在满足结构化生物医学约束方面的能力，并找出其局限性，从而推动更好地整合学习表示与结构化生物医学知识的检索系统。
AI.method: 引入OntologyBench，一个分层的生物医学检索基准，包含471,854个训练对和125,744个评估对，涵盖概念接地、关系检索和组合表型检索。评估了嵌入模型、本体论监督下的微调、重排序和基于LLM的候选评分方法。
AI.result: 嵌入模型在关系和组合任务上的表现普遍低于概念接地任务。本体论监督下的微调能改善部分关系和组合任务的性能。重排序和基于LLM的候选评分方法提供的端到端改进很小或没有。错误通常反映疾病只匹配部分表型证据。
AI.conclusion: 评估的嵌入和重排序配置不能可靠地恢复本体论关系和表型组合所编码的兼容性，因此需要更好地将学习表示与结构化生物医学知识集成的检索系统。
AI.translation:
我们引入了OntologyBench，这是一个分层的生物医学检索基准，包含471,854个训练查询-文档相关性对和125,744个评估查询-文档相关性对，涵盖概念接地、关系检索和组合表型检索。
尽管这些任务可以使用本体论感知的参考方法来处理，但在不同任务层级中，嵌入模型在关系和组合任务上的性能普遍低于概念接地任务。在本体论派生监督下进行微调可以改善一些关系和组合任务的性能，而所评估的重排序和基于LLM的候选评分方法提供的端到端改进很小或没有。错误经常反映疾病只匹配部分表型证据。
这些发现表明，所评估的嵌入和重排序配置不能可靠地恢复所选本体论关系和表型组合所编码的兼容性，并促使开发能够更好地将学习表示与结构化生物医学知识相结合的检索系统。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了OntologyBench，一个用于评估密集检索在生物医学领域满足结构化约束能力的分层基准。研究发现，尽管本体论感知方法有效，但密集检索在关系和组合任务上的表现不如概念接地任务。本体论监督下的微调有所帮助，但重排序和LLM方法改进有限。结果表明现有密集检索方法难以充分编码本体论兼容性，亟需结合学习表示与结构化知识的检索系统。
AI.keywords: OntologyBench, 密集检索, 生物医学, 结构化知识, 本体论
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入OntologyBench基准，系统地揭示了当前密集检索模型在处理复杂生物医学结构化约束（如关系和组合表型）时的局限性。其创新之处在于提供了具体的数据集和分析，量化了现有方法的不足。重要性在于指出了未来研究的方向，即如何更好地将深度学习表示与本体论等结构化知识进行融合，以提高生物医学信息检索的准确性和可靠性。

title: Safe Harness Self-Evolution: A Theoretical Analysis of Feasibility and Limits
summary: Harness self-evolution is the process by which an agent modifies its prompts, tools, code, or orchestration in response to task feedback while keeping the underlying language model frozen, with changes persisting across subsequent tasks. We provide a systematic theoretical analysis of the feasibility and limits of safe harness self-evolution, connecting modification generation, finite-data certification and selection, safe adoption, and behavior after an update. Under a fixed user-task distribution, we establish conditions guaranteeing overall expected-reward improvement while controlling changes on retained tasks, characterize the probability of generating qualified modifications, and derive finite-data bounds for safe selection and adoption. Our analysis shows that generation and certification impose distinct constraints: current task performance does not determine the probability of generating qualified modifications, and generating more candidates need not improve the guarantee of a successful update when evaluation is limiting. Stagnation may therefore arise even when improvement opportunities remain. We further show that worst-case evaluation cost for recognizing genuine improvements diverges as expected reward approaches its upper bound. Across successive updates, certified improvement guarantees accumulate over a finite run, but a successful update does not by itself guarantee that further improvement remains possible. These results provide a basis for diagnosing bottlenecks and designing safer self-evolution mechanisms.

AI.title_translation: 安全线束自进化：可行性与局限性的理论分析
AI.tldr: 本文对安全线束自进化的可行性及其局限性进行了系统的理论分析，揭示了其在改进性能、生成修改和评估成本方面的挑战。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在对安全线束自进化的可行性与局限性进行系统的理论分析，以建立在控制保留任务变化的同时保证整体预期奖励提升的条件，并表征生成合格修改的概率，以及推导安全选择和采纳的有限数据界限。
AI.method: 本文采用系统性的理论分析方法，连接了修改生成、有限数据认证与选择、安全采纳以及更新后的行为。
AI.result: 在固定用户-任务分布下，建立了保证整体预期奖励提升并控制保留任务变化的条件；表征了生成合格修改的概率；推导了安全选择和采纳的有限数据界限；分析表明，生成和认证施加了不同的限制：当前任务性能不决定生成合格修改的概率，且当评估受限时，生成更多候选者不一定能改善成功更新的保证；即使仍存在改进机会，也可能出现停滞；识别真正改进的最坏情况评估成本在预期奖励接近其上限时会发散；在连续更新中，认证改进保证在有限运行中累积，但成功的更新本身并不能保证进一步改进的可能性。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为诊断瓶颈和设计更安全的自进化机制提供了基础。
AI.translation: 线束自进化是指代理响应任务反馈修改其提示、工具、代码或编排的过程，同时保持底层语言模型不变，并且这些更改在后续任务中持续存在。我们对安全线束自进化的可行性及其局限性进行了系统的理论分析，连接了修改生成、有限数据认证与选择、安全采纳以及更新后的行为。在固定的用户-任务分布下，我们建立了保证整体预期奖励提升并控制保留任务变化的条件，表征了生成合格修改的概率，并推导了安全选择和采纳的有限数据界限。我们的分析表明，生成和认证施加了不同的限制：当前任务性能不决定生成合格修改的概率，并且当评估受限时，生成更多候选者不一定能改善成功更新的保证。因此，即使仍然存在改进机会，也可能出现停滞。我们进一步表明，识别真正改进的最坏情况评估成本在预期奖励接近其上限时会发散。在连续更新中，认证改进保证在有限运行中累积，但成功的更新本身并不能保证进一步改进的可能性。这些结果为诊断瓶颈和设计更安全的自进化机制提供了基础。
AI.summary: 本文对代理通过修改提示、工具、代码或编排进行线束自进化的过程进行了理论分析，重点关注其安全性和局限性。研究建立了在固定任务分布下保证预期奖励提升并控制变化的条件，并探讨了生成合格修改的概率以及安全选择和采纳的有限数据界限。分析揭示了生成和认证过程中的独特限制，指出了可能导致停滞的因素，并发现识别真实改进的评估成本可能发散。研究结果为诊断自进化系统中的瓶颈和设计更安全的机制提供了理论基础。
AI.keywords: 线束自进化, 理论分析, 安全性, 局限性, 停滞
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过严谨的理论分析，深入探讨了线束自进化的核心挑战，特别是在“安全”方面的可行性和局限性。其创新之处在于揭示了生成和认证过程中的关键瓶颈，如性能与修改生成概率的不相关性、评估受限时增加候选者的无效性，以及可能出现的停滞现象和评估成本发散问题。这些发现对于理解当前基于LLM的自进化系统的局限性、指导未来更安全、更高效的自进化机制设计具有重要意义。

title: Beyond Cut Balance: Spectral Sparsification of the Nonlinear Directed Laplacian
summary:
Digraphs with constant cut balance admit nearly linear directed cut sparsifiers. This condition requires the total arc weights in the two directions of every cut to be within a constant factor of each other. We ask whether this condition also permits nearly linear spectral sparsification with respect to the energy of the nonlinear directed Laplacian. For a weighted digraph $G=(V,E,w)$, let \[
  Q_G^+(x)=\sum_{(u,v)\in E}w_{uv}(x_u-x_v)_+^2,
  \qquad (t)_+:=\max\{t,0\}. \] This energy agrees with the outgoing-cut function on binary vectors. A spectral sparsifier is a nonnegatively reweighted subgraph that preserves $Q_G^+(x)$ within a factor of $1\pm\varepsilon$ simultaneously for all $x\in\mathbb R^V$.
  We show that cut balance alone does not yield nearly linear spectral sparsifiers: for constant error, the worst-case support size for simple unweighted Eulerian digraphs is $\widetildeΘ(n^{3/2})$, although Eulerian digraphs are perfectly cut-balanced and admit nearly linear directed cut sparsifiers. In contrast, we prove that every $n$-vertex tournament has a spectral sparsifier with $\widetilde O(n/\varepsilon^3)$ arcs, without any assumption on its cut balance. This includes the transitive tournament, whose cut balance is unbounded. Thus perfect balance does not guarantee nearly linear spectral sparsification, while unbounded imbalance does not preclude it.
  Finally, we use convex duality to show that preserving $Q_G^+$ also preserves, for every feasible demand vector, the optimum quadratic cost of a nonnegative flow. Hence the guarantee contains information beyond directed cut values.

AI.title_translation: 超越割平衡：非线性有向拉普拉斯算子的谱稀疏化
AI.tldr: 割平衡对有向图的谱稀疏化不总是必要的或充分的；特定类型的图（如锦标赛图）即使不平衡也能实现高效的谱稀疏化。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在探讨有向图的“割平衡”条件是否允许非线性有向拉普拉斯算子能量的近似线性谱稀疏化，该条件已知在有向割稀疏化中有效。
AI.method: 论文通过理论分析和构造性证明来研究割平衡与谱稀疏化之间的关系。具体方法包括：1. 展示了割平衡的有向图（如欧拉有向图）在最坏情况下需要超线性数量的弧才能实现谱稀疏化。2. 证明了所有n顶点锦标赛图，无论割平衡如何，都存在具有$\widetilde O(n/\varepsilon^3)$弧的谱稀疏化器。3. 利用凸对偶性证明保留$Q_G^+$能量也保留了非负流的最优二次成本。
AI.result: 1. 仅凭割平衡并不能产生近似线性的谱稀疏化器：对于常数误差，简单无权欧拉有向图的最坏情况支持大小为$\widetildeΘ(n^{3/2})$，尽管它们是完全割平衡的。2. 每个n顶点锦标赛图都存在一个具有$\widetilde O(n/\varepsilon^3)$弧的谱稀疏化器，而无需任何割平衡假设。3. 保留$Q_G^+$能量也保留了每个可行需求向量的最优二次成本的非负流。
AI.conclusion: 割平衡并不能保证近似线性的谱稀疏化，而无界的不平衡性也并不排除它。谱稀疏化$Q_G^+$的保证包含了超出有向割值的信息，因为它能保留非负流的最优二次成本。
AI.translation: 具有恒定割平衡的有向图允许近似线性的有向割稀疏化器。此条件要求每个割的两个方向上的总弧权重彼此在常数因子范围内。我们询问此条件是否也允许关于非线性有向拉普拉斯算子能量的近似线性谱稀疏化。对于加权有向图$G=(V,E,w)$，令 $Q_G^+(x)=\sum_{(u,v)\in E}w_{uv}(x_u-x_v)_+^2, \qquad (t)_+:=\max\{t,0\}。$ 该能量在二值向量上与出割函数一致。谱稀疏化器是一个非负重新加权的子图，它同时为所有$x\in\mathbb R^V$将$Q_G^+(x)$保持在$1\pm\varepsilon$的因子内。我们表明，仅凭割平衡并不能产生近似线性的谱稀疏化器：对于常数误差，简单无权欧拉有向图的最坏情况支持大小为$\widetildeΘ(n^{3/2})$，尽管欧拉有向图是完全割平衡的并允许近似线性的有向割稀疏化器。相反，我们证明每个n顶点锦标赛图都有一个具有$\widetilde O(n/\varepsilon^3)$弧的谱稀疏化器，而无需对其割平衡进行任何假设。这包括传递锦标赛图，其割平衡是无界的。因此，完美平衡不能保证近似线性的谱稀疏化，而无界的不平衡性也不能排除它。最后，我们使用凸对偶性表明，保留$Q_G^+$也保留了每个可行需求向量的最优二次成本的非负流。因此，此保证包含超出有向割值的信息。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了有向图的割平衡条件在非线性有向拉普拉斯算子谱稀疏化中的作用。研究发现，尽管割平衡对有向割稀疏化有效，但它并不能保证近似线性的谱稀疏化，例如欧拉有向图在最坏情况下需要超线性数量的弧。然而，某些不平衡的图，如所有n顶点锦标赛图，却能实现高效的谱稀疏化。此外，通过凸对偶性，作者证明保留非线性有向拉普拉斯算子能量$Q_G^+$还能保留非负流的最优二次成本，这表明这种谱稀疏化提供了比传统有向割稀疏化更丰富的信息。
AI.keywords: 有向图, 谱稀疏化, 割平衡, 非线性拉普拉斯算子, 锦标赛图
AI.comments: 这篇论文挑战了关于有向图稀疏化的直观认识，即割平衡是实现高效稀疏化的关键。其创新之处在于揭示了割平衡与非线性有向拉普拉斯算子谱稀疏化之间复杂的、非直观的关系。特别是，证明了锦标赛图即使在割不平衡的情况下也能实现高效稀疏化，这是一个重要的发现。通过引入凸对偶性，论文进一步强调了非线性谱稀疏化在保留流成本方面的强大能力，超越了简单的割值信息。这为理解和设计有向图的稀疏化算法提供了新的视角。

title: Less Is Personal: Learning Minimal Sufficient User Profiles for Personalized Language Models
summary: Retrieval-augmented personalization enables large language models to produce more accurate and preference-aligned outputs using relevant records retrieved from user histories. Personalized language models typically prepend a fixed number of retrieved user records, even when additional history is redundant, harmful, or unrelated to a user's distinctive behavior. We study minimal sufficient personalization: constructing the least costly ordered profile for each input while preserving the utility achievable from a retrieved candidate pool. We introduce ENOUGH, a method that iteratively appends behavioral records or emits STOP to construct profiles with adaptive lengths. Offline, bounded counterfactual search evaluates profile prefixes by jointly considering downstream gains, user specificity, and token costs. The resulting long-horizon targets are distilled into a multi-head value controller with explicit ranking and stopping supervision. At inference, the controller selects and orders records through lightweight decisions, and the frozen generator is invoked once after stopping. Extensive experiments on six personalized tasks demonstrate that ENOUGH consistently outperforms strong heuristic and retrieval-augmented baselines in both effectiveness and efficiency, achieving minimal sufficient profiles that preserve personalization utility while reducing unnecessary context costs.

AI.title_translation: 少即是个人：学习个性化语言模型的最小充分用户画像
AI.tldr: 本文提出了ENOUGH方法，旨在为个性化语言模型构建最小且充分的用户画像，通过自适应选择相关用户历史，提高效率和效果。
AI.motivation: 个性化语言模型通常预先添加固定数量的检索到的用户记录，即使这些记录可能是冗余、有害或不相关的，导致不必要的上下文成本。本文旨在为每个输入构建成本最低的有序画像，同时保持从检索到的候选池中可实现的效用。
AI.method: 本文引入了ENOUGH方法，该方法通过迭代附加行为记录或发出STOP信号来构建自适应长度的用户画像。离线阶段，通过有界反事实搜索评估画像前缀，综合考虑下游收益、用户特异性和令牌成本。由此产生的长视野目标被蒸馏到一个具有显式排名和停止监督的多头价值控制器中。在推理时，该控制器通过轻量级决策选择和排序记录，并在停止后调用一次冻结的生成器。
AI.result: ENOUGH方法在六个个性化任务上的广泛实验表明，其在有效性和效率方面始终优于强大的启发式和检索增强基线。它实现了最小充分画像，在保留个性化效用的同时显著减少了不必要的上下文成本。
AI.conclusion: ENOUGH方法成功地为个性化语言模型创建了最小充分的用户画像，通过自适应选择相关用户历史并减少上下文成本，显著提高了模型的有效性和效率。
AI.translation: 检索增强的个性化使用从用户历史中检索到的相关记录，使大型语言模型能够产生更准确、更符合偏好的输出。个性化语言模型通常预先添加固定数量的检索到的用户记录，即使额外的历史记录是冗余的、有害的或与用户的独特行为无关。我们研究最小充分个性化：为每个输入构建成本最低的有序画像，同时保留从检索到的候选池中可实现的效用。我们引入了ENOUGH，这是一种迭代地附加行为记录或发出STOP以构建自适应长度画像的方法。离线地，有界反事实搜索通过联合考虑下游收益、用户特异性和令牌成本来评估画像前缀。由此产生的长视野目标被蒸馏到一个具有显式排名和停止监督的多头价值控制器中。在推理时，控制器通过轻量级决策选择和排序记录，并在停止后调用一次冻结的生成器。对六个个性化任务的广泛实验表明，ENOUGH在有效性和效率方面始终优于强大的启发式和检索增强基线，实现了最小充分画像，在保留个性化效用的同时减少了不必要的上下文成本。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ENOUGH方法，旨在为个性化语言模型构建最小且充分的用户画像。针对现有方法固定数量检索记录导致冗余和高成本的问题，ENOUGH通过迭代选择行为记录并自适应地停止，以生成最优长度的画像。该方法利用离线反事实搜索评估画像前缀，并通过多头价值控制器进行推理时的记录选择和排序。实验证明，ENOUGH在多个个性化任务上显著优于现有基线，有效提高了效率并降低了上下文成本，同时保持了个性化效用。
AI.keywords: 个性化语言模型, 用户画像, 检索增强, 自适应长度, 效率
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“最小充分个性化”的概念，并通过ENOUGH方法实现了自适应长度的用户画像构建，有效解决了现有个性化语言模型中固定上下文长度导致的冗余和效率问题。其结合离线反事实搜索和在线轻量级控制器的设计，为个性化模型的高效部署提供了有价值的思路。

title: WSPolypNet: Weakly Supervised Polyp Localization in Colonoscopy Videos
summary: Because dense frame-level annotation of colonoscopy videos is costly, we propose WSPolypNet, a weakly supervised framework for polyp localization using only video-level labels. WSPolypNet employs a 3D convolutional neural network trained with video-level supervision to generate class activation maps (CAMs), which identify candidate polyp regions without requiring frame-level spatial annotations. The CAM-derived localization cues are further enhanced using a multi-view strategy and provided to MedSAM2 as point prompts. MedSAM2 then propagates segmentation masks across the video, refining the coarse localization cues according to polyp boundaries. WSPolypNet achieved CorLoc scores of 47.80%, 43.68%, and 35.01% at IoU thresholds of 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7, respectively, compared with 36.87%, 33.72%, and 27.94% in the single-view setting. For small polyps, the multi-view strategy improved CorLoc@0.5 from 16.01% to 30.97%. The framework also achieved a recall of 94.51%. These results demonstrate the potential of weakly supervised spatiotemporal learning to substantially reduce spatial annotation requirements for polyp localization in colonoscopy videos.

AI.title_translation: WSPolypNet：结肠镜视频中息肉的弱监督定位
AI.tldr: WSPolypNet是一个弱监督框架，仅使用视频级标签在结肠镜视频中定位息肉，通过3D CNN、CAMs和MedSAM2实现，显著降低了标注成本并取得了良好的定位效果。
AI.motivation: 结肠镜视频中密集帧级标注成本高昂。
AI.method: WSPolypNet是一个弱监督框架，仅使用视频级标签进行息肉定位。它采用一个在视频级监督下训练的3D卷积神经网络来生成类激活图（CAMs），用于识别候选息肉区域，无需帧级空间标注。CAMs衍生的定位线索通过多视角策略进一步增强，并作为点提示提供给MedSAM2。MedSAM2随后在视频中传播分割掩模，根据息肉边界细化粗略的定位线索。
AI.result: WSPolypNet在IoU阈值0.3、0.5和0.7下分别取得了47.80%、43.68%和35.01%的CorLoc分数，相比单视角设置的36.87%、33.72%和27.94%有显著提升。对于小型息肉，多视角策略将CorLoc@0.5从16.01%提高到30.97%。该框架还实现了94.51%的召回率。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，弱监督时空学习有潜力大幅减少结肠镜视频中息肉定位的空间标注需求。
AI.translation: 由于结肠镜视频的密集帧级标注成本高昂，我们提出了WSPolypNet，一个仅使用视频级标签进行息肉定位的弱监督框架。WSPolypNet采用一个在视频级监督下训练的3D卷积神经网络来生成类激活图（CAMs），该图识别候选息肉区域，而无需帧级空间标注。CAMs衍生的定位线索通过多视角策略进一步增强，并作为点提示提供给MedSAM2。MedSAM2随后在视频中传播分割掩模，根据息肉边界细化粗略的定位线索。WSPolypNet在IoU阈值0.3、0.5和0.7下分别取得了47.80%、43.68%和35.01%的CorLoc分数，相比之下，单视角设置下为36.87%、33.72%和27.94%。对于小型息肉，多视角策略将CorLoc@0.5从16.01%提高到30.97%。该框架还实现了94.51%的召回率。这些结果证明了弱监督时空学习在大幅减少结肠镜视频中息肉定位的空间标注需求方面的潜力。
AI.summary: WSPolypNet是一个针对结肠镜视频中息肉定位的弱监督框架，旨在解决帧级标注成本高的问题。它利用3D CNN生成CAMs，结合多视角策略和MedSAM2进行精细化定位。实验结果显示，WSPolypNet在CorLoc分数和召回率上表现出色，尤其在小型息肉定位方面有显著提升，证明了弱监督方法在减少标注需求方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 弱监督学习, 息肉定位, 结肠镜视频, 3D CNN, MedSAM2
AI.comments: WSPolypNet的创新之处在于其弱监督方法，仅依赖视频级标签进行息肉定位，显著降低了医疗图像分析中的标注成本。结合3D CNN捕获时空信息、多视角增强和MedSAM2进行边界细化，构建了一个高效且实用的系统。这对于推动医疗AI在资源受限环境下的应用具有重要意义。

title: NeoHorse-1: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement via Agentic Post-Training with Routing Harness
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires a concrete mechanism through which an AI system observes its capabilities and converts that evidence into the next round of learning. We present NeoHorse-1, a family of agent-native models developed to explore this path through agentic post-training. Our system combines a heterogeneous model pool with intelligent routing, recording the predicted capability demand, selected service tier, and subsequent interaction for each user turn. These records are converted into training examples that preserve interleaved reasoning, tool calls, and harness context, and are admitted through structural validation, six-dimensional semantic evaluation, and subscene-level labeling. Routing signals organize supervised fine-tuning into a three-stage curriculum and extend to routing-guided on-policy distillation, where a teacher supervises student-generated responses under the same progression. Capability-guided allocation then converts evaluation feedback into the next training mixture, closing an evaluation-selection-update loop in which what the system learns to do shapes what it learns from next. Across eleven benchmarks covering harness-based agents, tool use, coding, and instruction following, post-training raises the macro-average from 58.94 to 64.87 at 4B and from 65.60 to 69.04 at 9B, substantially narrowing the aggregate gap between the post-trained 4B model and the 9B base model. NeoHorse-1 provides an initial prototype of this feedback-driven process and a path toward harness-mediated RSI across successive iterations.

AI.title_translation: NeoHorse-1：通过带有路由线束的智能体后训练实现递归式自我改进
AI.tldr: NeoHorse-1是一个通过智能体后训练实现递归式自我改进的AI系统，它结合了模型池、智能路由和反馈循环，显著提升了模型在多项基准测试中的性能。
AI.motivation: 递归式自我改进（RSI）需要一个具体的机制，使AI系统能够观察自身能力并将其转化为下一轮学习的证据。
AI.method: NeoHorse-1系统结合了异构模型池和智能路由，记录预测的能力需求、选择的服务层级和后续交互，并将这些记录转换为训练样本。这些样本经过结构验证、六维语义评估和子场景级标记。路由信号将监督式微调组织成三阶段课程，并扩展到路由引导的在线策略蒸馏。能力引导的分配将评估反馈转化为下一轮训练混合，从而形成一个评估-选择-更新的闭环。
AI.result: 在涵盖基于线束的智能体、工具使用、编码和指令遵循的11个基准测试中，后训练将4B模型的宏观平均分数从58.94提高到64.87，将9B模型的宏观平均分数从65.60提高到69.04，显著缩小了后训练的4B模型与9B基础模型之间的总体差距。
AI.conclusion: NeoHorse-1为这种反馈驱动的过程提供了一个初步原型，并为通过线束介导的递归式自我改进在连续迭代中实现提供了途径。
AI.translation: 递归式自我改进（RSI）需要一个具体的机制，通过该机制，AI系统能够观察其能力并将该证据转化为下一轮学习。我们提出了NeoHorse-1，一个为探索通过智能体后训练实现这一路径而开发的智能体原生模型家族。我们的系统结合了异构模型池和智能路由，记录了每个用户回合的预测能力需求、选择的服务层级以及后续交互。这些记录被转换为训练示例，保留了交错推理、工具调用和线束上下文，并通过结构验证、六维语义评估和子场景级标记进行准入。路由信号将监督式微调组织成三阶段课程，并扩展到路由引导的在线策略蒸馏，其中教师在相同的进展下监督学生生成的响应。能力引导的分配随后将评估反馈转化为下一个训练混合物，从而关闭一个评估-选择-更新的循环，其中系统学会做什么塑造了它接下来从什么中学习。在涵盖基于线束的智能体、工具使用、编码和指令遵循的11个基准测试中，后训练将4B模型的宏观平均分数从58.94提高到64.87，将9B模型的宏观平均分数从65.60提高到69.04，显著缩小了后训练的4B模型与9B基础模型之间的总体差距。NeoHorse-1为这种反馈驱动的过程提供了一个初步原型，并为通过线束介导的递归式自我改进在连续迭代中实现提供了途径。
AI.summary: NeoHorse-1是一个旨在通过智能体后训练实现递归式自我改进（RSI）的AI系统。它通过结合异构模型池、智能路由和反馈循环来运作，将用户交互数据转化为训练样本，并利用多阶段课程和在线策略蒸馏进行模型优化。在多项基准测试中，NeoHorse-1显著提升了模型的性能，为实现RSI提供了一个有效的原型和路径。
AI.keywords: 递归式自我改进, 智能体后训练, 路由线束, NeoHorse-1, 在线策略蒸馏
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的智能体后训练范式，通过引入智能路由和评估-选择-更新的闭环机制，为递归式自我改进提供了一个具体的实现框架。其创新点在于将用户交互数据转化为结构化训练样本，并利用分阶段的训练课程和在线策略蒸馏来持续优化模型。这种反馈驱动的方法对于构建更自主、更具适应性的AI系统具有重要意义。性能提升的数据也验证了其方法的有效性。

title: UnespDataLens-RM: A Reference Model for Analytical Data Engineering with Governance, Quality, Provenance, and Reproducibility
summary: The growing reliance on data in analytical processes and evidence-based decision-making has reinforced the importance of Data Engineering in building pipelines capable of integrating, transforming, validating, and delivering data from heterogeneous sources. However, the reliability of analytical assets depends not only on data processing capabilities but also on mechanisms for governance, quality assurance, provenance, traceability, versioning, and reproducibility throughout their lifecycle. These responsibilities are commonly addressed by different models, frameworks, and operational practices, resulting in methodological fragmentation across the analytical data lifecycle. To address this gap, this article proposes UnespDataLens-RM, a technology-independent reference model that integrates technical-operational processes and cross-cutting capabilities within a unified structure for Analytical Data Engineering. The model aims to support the specification, organization, and evolution of analytical pipelines by incorporating governance, quality, provenance, traceability, and reproducibility from the design stage. Developed following the Design Science Research approach, UnespDataLens-RM comprises eight technical-operational modules, eight cross-cutting modules, complementary dimensions, and a formalized set of artifacts, metrics, and validation criteria. The resulting specification offers a conceptual and methodological framework for future instantiations and empirical evaluations of analytical pipelines designed to be more governable, documented, traceable, auditable, and reproducible.

AI.title_translation: UnespDataLens-RM：一个用于分析数据工程的参考模型，具有治理、质量、溯源和可复现性
AI.tldr: UnespDataLens-RM 提出了一个用于分析数据工程的参考模型，它将治理、质量、溯源和可复现性整合到一个统一的结构中，以解决方法论碎片化的问题。
AI.motivation: 分析过程和循证决策对数据的日益依赖，凸显了数据工程在构建数据管道方面的重要性。然而，分析资产的可靠性不仅取决于数据处理能力，还取决于其生命周期中的治理、质量保证、溯源、可追溯性、版本控制和可复现性机制。这些职责通常由不同的模型、框架和操作实践来解决，导致分析数据生命周期中存在方法论碎片化的问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了UnespDataLens-RM，一个技术独立的参考模型，它将技术操作过程和跨领域能力整合到分析数据工程的统一结构中。该模型旨在通过在设计阶段就纳入治理、质量、溯源、可追溯性和可复现性来支持分析管道的规范、组织和演进。UnespDataLens-RM 遵循设计科学研究方法开发，包含八个技术操作模块、八个跨领域模块、互补维度以及一套形式化的工件、指标和验证标准。
AI.result: 所形成的规范为未来分析管道的实例化和实证评估提供了一个概念和方法论框架，旨在使这些管道更具可治理性、可文档化、可追溯性、可审计性和可复现性。
AI.conclusion: UnespDataLens-RM 提供了一个统一的技术独立框架，解决了分析数据工程中的方法论碎片化问题，确保从设计阶段就纳入治理、质量、溯源和可复现性，从而支持创建更可靠的分析资产。
AI.translation: 分析过程和循证决策对数据的日益依赖，强化了数据工程在构建能够整合、转换、验证和交付来自异构源数据的数据管道方面的重要性。然而，分析资产的可靠性不仅取决于数据处理能力，还取决于其整个生命周期中的治理、质量保证、溯源、可追溯性、版本控制和可复现性机制。这些职责通常由不同的模型、框架和操作实践来解决，导致分析数据生命周期中存在方法论碎片化的问题。为了解决这一空白，本文提出了UnespDataLens-RM，一个技术独立的参考模型，它将技术操作过程和跨领域能力整合到分析数据工程的统一结构中。该模型旨在通过在设计阶段就纳入治理、质量、溯源、可追溯性和可复现性来支持分析管道的规范、组织和演进。UnespDataLens-RM 遵循设计科学研究方法开发，包含八个技术操作模块、八个跨领域模块、互补维度以及一套形式化的工件、指标和验证标准。所形成的规范为未来分析管道的实例化和实证评估提供了一个概念和方法论框架，旨在使这些管道更具可治理性、可文档化、可追溯性、可审计性和可复现性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了UnespDataLens-RM，一个技术独立的参考模型，旨在通过整合治理、质量、溯源和可复现性，解决分析数据工程中方法论碎片化的问题。该模型通过八个技术操作模块和八个跨领域模块，为分析管道的规范、组织和演进提供了一个统一的结构，使其更具可治理性、可追溯性和可复现性。
AI.keywords: 分析数据工程, 参考模型, 数据治理, 数据质量, 数据溯源, 可复现性
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一个统一的、技术独立的参考模型UnespDataLens-RM，它将治理、质量、溯源和可复现性等关键方面从设计阶段就整合到分析数据工程中。这解决了现有方法论碎片化的问题，有望显著提高分析资产的可靠性和可信度。该模型的结构化方法和对关键能力的整合是其重要性所在。

title: Cassette: Case-to-Case Structural Distillation for Efficient Legal Case Retrieval
summary: Legal case retrieval (LCR) is an essential tool for not only assisting legal practitioners to efficiently retrieve precedents but also enabling ordinary individuals to find valuable legal case information without relying on expensive professional legal services. Our previous work CaseLink demonstrated the effectiveness of using case to case graph structures to improve retrieval accuracy. However, its high computational cost during inference on large-scale legal databases limits its practical use in real-world settings. The main inefficiency comes from constructing test time graphs and computing pairwise term frequency similarities of cases. This process has O(n^2) complexity for n legal cases, making the runtime prohibitive as the number of candidates grows. For example, the retrieval time for one query on a database (COLIEE2022) with 1,563 candidate cases is more than 500 milliseconds, while the runtime would increase drastically to more than 3,500 seconds for a database (LeCaRDv2) with 55,192 candidate cases. To further enhance the retrieval performance while achieving a significant speed-up, in this extension paper, Cassette framework is proposed with a distillation strategy involving ranking objective and eigen-matching objective for an effective transfer of knowledge from a powerful and well-trained heavy teacher retriever to a lightweight and efficient hybrid student dual encoder. Specifically, the student query encoder is implemented as a multilayer perceptron model designed for fast online processing, whereas the student candidate encoder adopts a GNN architecture, suitable for an offline manner within the case database. Extensive experiments are conducted on three benchmark datasets, and the results verify the effectiveness of the ranking distillation while achieving high efficiency. The code has been released on https://github.com/yanran-tang/Cassette/.

AI.title_translation: Cassette：用于高效法律案例检索的案例到案例结构化蒸馏
AI.tldr: Cassette框架通过结构化蒸馏，将知识从复杂的教师检索器转移到轻量级学生模型，显著提高了法律案例检索的效率和准确性，解决了现有方法计算成本高的问题。
AI.motivation: 法律案例检索（LCR）对于法律从业者和普通大众都非常重要，但之前的CaseLink方法在处理大规模法律数据库时计算成本过高，尤其是在构建测试时图和计算成对词频相似度方面，导致运行时长呈O(n^2)复杂度，限制了其实际应用。
AI.method: 提出了Cassette框架，采用蒸馏策略，包括排序目标（ranking objective）和特征匹配目标（eigen-matching objective），将知识从强大且训练有素的重型教师检索器有效转移到轻量级高效的混合学生双编码器。具体而言，学生查询编码器实现为多层感知器（MLP）模型以实现快速在线处理，而学生候选编码器采用图神经网络（GNN）架构，适用于案例数据库的离线处理。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上进行了广泛实验，结果验证了排序蒸馏的有效性，同时实现了高效率。
AI.conclusion: Cassette框架通过结构化蒸馏策略，成功解决了法律案例检索中现有方法效率低下的问题，在提高检索性能的同时显著加快了处理速度，使其更适用于实际大规模应用。
AI.translation: 法律案例检索（LCR）是一种重要的工具，它不仅能帮助法律从业者高效检索判例，还能让普通人无需昂贵的专业法律服务就能找到有价值的法律案例信息。我们之前的工作CaseLink证明了使用案例到案例图结构可以提高检索准确性。然而，其在大型法律数据库上的推理过程中高昂的计算成本限制了其在实际场景中的应用。主要的低效性来自于构建测试时图和计算案例的成对词频相似度。这个过程对于n个法律案例具有O(n^2)的复杂度，导致随着候选案例数量的增加，运行时间变得 prohibitive。例如，在一个包含1,563个候选案例的数据库（COLIEE2022）上进行一次查询的检索时间超过500毫秒，而在一个包含55,192个候选案例的数据库（LeCaRDv2）上，运行时间将急剧增加到3,500多秒。为了进一步提高检索性能，同时实现显著的加速，在本扩展论文中，提出了Cassette框架，采用蒸馏策略，包括排序目标和特征匹配目标，以有效地将知识从一个强大且训练有素的重型教师检索器转移到一个轻量级且高效的混合学生双编码器。具体而言，学生查询编码器实现为多层感知器模型，专为快速在线处理而设计，而学生候选编码器采用图神经网络架构，适用于案例数据库中的离线处理。在三个基准数据集上进行了广泛实验，结果验证了排序蒸馏的有效性，同时实现了高效率。代码已在https://github.com/yanran-tang/Cassette/上发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Cassette框架，旨在解决现有法律案例检索（LCR）方法在处理大规模数据库时效率低下的问题。通过采用一种结构化蒸馏策略，该框架将一个强大教师检索器的知识转移到一个轻量级的混合学生双编码器。学生模型包含一个用于快速在线处理的多层感知器查询编码器和一个用于离线处理的图神经网络候选编码器。实验结果表明，Cassette框架在提高检索效率的同时保持了高准确性。
AI.keywords: 法律案例检索, 结构化蒸馏, 效率, 双编码器, 图神经网络
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了Cassette框架，通过结构化蒸馏策略有效解决了法律案例检索在处理大规模数据时的计算效率瓶颈。通过将复杂教师模型的知识转移到轻量级学生模型，并结合MLP和GNN的混合架构，实现了性能与效率的平衡，对于法律人工智能的实际应用具有重要意义。

title: Does Deeper Reasoning Compromise Alignment? Revealing and Mitigating of Alignment Collapse in Large Reasoning Models
summary: The emergence of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has established a robust foundation for Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). While deep reasoning is widely believed to enhance safety alignment, the stability of alignment mechanisms under extended reasoning remains underexplored. This paper challenges the prevailing view by revealing a critical vulnerability: Deep Reasoning May Induce Alignment Collapse. To rigorously quantify this phenomenon, we propose the Alignment Loss Rate (ALR) metric. Our experiments demonstrate that as reasoning depth increases, ALR rises significantly, indicating a severe degradation in model robustness against external perturbations. Capitalizing on this instability, a novel jailbreaking paradigm, Reasoning Trap (RT), is proposed. RT induces the model into extended reasoning to amplify the impact of adversarial attacks, leading to a sharp decline in safety capabilities. To elucidate the mechanism behind this collapse, we identify Attention Dilution as the root cause, arising from the competition for attention between the extended reasoning process and the original input. To mitigate this, Reasoning Residual Alignment (RRA), a lightweight defense strategy that dynamically re-emphasizes the input via residual connections integrated with the reasoning process.

AI.title_translation: 深度推理是否会损害对齐？揭示大型推理模型中的对齐崩溃并缓解
AI.tldr: 深度推理可能导致大型推理模型的对齐崩溃，表现为对外部干扰的鲁棒性下降。研究提出了“推理陷阱”（RT）来放大这种崩溃，并确定“注意力稀释”是根本原因。通过“推理残差对齐”（RRA）进行缓解。
AI.motivation: 评估深度推理对大型推理模型（LRMs）安全对齐机制稳定性的影响，挑战了深度推理能增强安全对齐的普遍观点。
AI.method: 提出“对齐损失率”（ALR）指标来量化对齐崩溃，并提出“推理陷阱”（RT）作为一种新的越狱范式来放大攻击效果。通过识别“注意力稀释”作为根本原因，并提出“推理残差对齐”（RRA）作为一种轻量级防御策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，随着推理深度的增加，ALR显著上升，表明模型在对抗外部干扰方面的鲁棒性严重下降。RT范式能够显著降低模型的安全能力。
AI.conclusion: 深度推理可能导致大型推理模型的对齐崩溃，其根本原因是推理过程中的注意力稀释。提出的RRA防御策略能够有效缓解此问题。
AI.translation: 链式思考（CoT）的出现为大型推理模型（LRMs）奠定了坚实的基础。虽然深度推理被广泛认为可以增强安全对齐，但在扩展推理下对齐机制的稳定性仍未得到充分探索。本文通过揭示一个关键漏洞来挑战普遍观点：深度推理可能导致对齐崩溃。为了严格量化这种现象，我们提出了对齐损失率（ALR）指标。我们的实验表明，随着推理深度的增加，ALR显著上升，表明模型在对抗外部干扰方面的鲁棒性严重下降。利用这种不稳定性，我们提出了一种新颖的越狱范式，推理陷阱（RT）。RT诱导模型进行扩展推理，以放大对抗性攻击的影响，导致安全能力急剧下降。为了阐明这种崩溃背后的机制，我们将注意力稀释确定为根本原因，这是由于扩展推理过程和原始输入之间的注意力竞争造成的。为了缓解这种情况，我们提出了推理残差对齐（RRA），这是一种轻量级的防御策略，通过与推理过程相结合的残差连接来动态地重新强调输入。
AI.summary: 该研究探讨了大型推理模型（LRMs）在深度推理过程中可能出现的“对齐崩溃”现象。研究人员提出了“对齐损失率”（ALR）指标来量化此问题，并发现随着推理深度的增加，模型的对齐能力会显著下降，容易受到“推理陷阱”（RT）等越狱攻击。研究将“注意力稀释”确定为导致对齐崩溃的根本原因，并提出了一种名为“推理残差对齐”（RRA）的轻量级防御机制来重新强调输入，从而缓解对齐崩溃问题。
AI.keywords: 对齐崩溃,深度推理,大型推理模型,推理陷阱,推理残差对齐
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了一个重要且被忽视的问题——深度推理可能破坏大型推理模型的对齐性。提出的ALR指标和RT范式为量化和利用对齐崩溃提供了有价值的工具。将注意力稀释确定为根本原因并提出RRA作为解决方案，为提高大型推理模型的安全性和鲁棒性提供了切实可行的途径。未来的工作可以进一步探索RRA在不同模型架构和更复杂的推理任务上的有效性。

title: Bridging the Semantic-Utility Gap in Multimodal RAG via Generator-in-the-Loop Alignment
comments: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) augmented with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) benefit from access to external evidence. However, standard retrievers and rerankers optimize for semantic similarity rather than answer utility, creating a preference gap: documents that appear relevant may not help the generator produce a correct answer. Motivated by this, we propose a two-stage generator-in-the-loop alignment framework that closes this gap without human document-level relevance annotations. Our framework consists of two stages: in Stage 1, a VLM generates a hypothetical text passage from the image-query pair, which is used as the retrieval query for dense text search, bridging the image-to-text modality gap. In Stage 2, a cross-encoder reranker adapted with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is fine-tuned using answer-supervised preference pairs mined from the frozen VLM: given the dataset answer label, a candidate document is labeled positive if the VLM produces the correct answer when given that document as context, and negative otherwise. This generator-guided signal is compatible with multiple alignment loss functions, including contrastive (triplet) loss, pairwise direct preference optimization (DPO), and supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and supports periodic re-mining to refresh preference pairs as the reranker improves. Experiments on VQA-X and A-OKVQA with Qwen3.5-2B and Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct show that our proposed framework consistently outperforms rank-order, random, and REPLUG-style likelihood baselines under various alignment losses and pool size settings, suggesting that answer-level generator feedback is an effective supervision signal for preference alignment.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence

AI.title_translation: 多模态RAG中通过生成器循环对齐弥合语义-效用鸿沟
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个两阶段的生成器循环对齐框架，通过利用VLM的答案级反馈作为监督信号，在无需人工标注的情况下，有效弥合了多模态RAG中检索结果的语义相似性与生成器答案效用之间的鸿沟，并在VQA任务上取得了显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 标准的检索器和重排序器优化语义相似性而非答案效用，导致了一个偏好鸿沟：即文档在语义上可能相关，但对生成器产生正确答案的帮助不大。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个两阶段的生成器循环对齐框架。第一阶段，VLM从图像-查询对生成一个假设文本段落作为密集文本搜索的检索查询，以弥合图像到文本的模态鸿沟。第二阶段，一个通过低秩适应（LoRA）调整的交叉编码重排序器，利用从冻结VLM中挖掘的答案监督偏好对进行微调。这些偏好对的标签基于VLM在给定文档上下文时能否生成正确答案，并兼容多种对齐损失函数（如对比损失、DPO和SFT），支持周期性重新挖掘偏好对。
AI.result: 实验在VQA-X和A-OKVQA数据集上，使用Qwen3.5-2B和Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct进行。结果表明，所提出的框架在各种对齐损失和池大小设置下，始终优于排序、随机和REPLUG风格的似然基线。这证明了答案级别的生成器反馈是偏好对齐的有效监督信号。
AI.conclusion: 答案级别的生成器反馈是一种有效的监督信号，可以用于多模态RAG中的偏好对齐，从而弥合语义与效用之间的鸿沟，提高生成器产生正确答案的能力。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）通过检索增强生成（RAG）获得外部证据的增强，从中受益。然而，标准的检索器和重排序器优化的是语义相似性而非答案效用，这导致了一个偏好鸿沟：看起来相关的文档可能无法帮助生成器产生正确答案。受此启发，我们提出了一个两阶段的生成器循环对齐框架，该框架无需人工文档级相关性标注即可弥合这一鸿沟。我们的框架包括两个阶段：在第一阶段，VLM从图像-查询对生成一个假设的文本段落，该段落用作密集文本搜索的检索查询，从而弥合图像到文本的模态鸿沟。在第二阶段，一个通过低秩适应（LoRA）调整的交叉编码重排序器，使用从冻结VLM中挖掘的答案监督偏好对进行微调：给定数据集答案标签，如果VLM在给定该文档作为上下文时产生正确答案，则该候选文档被标记为正，否则为负。这种生成器引导的信号兼容多种对齐损失函数，包括对比（三元组）损失、成对直接偏好优化（DPO）和监督微调（SFT），并支持周期性重新挖掘以随着重排序器的改进刷新偏好对。在VQA-X和A-OKVQA上使用Qwen3.5-2B和Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct进行的实验表明，我们提出的框架在各种对齐损失和池大小设置下，始终优于排序、随机和REPLUG风格的似然基线，这表明答案级别的生成器反馈是偏好对齐的有效监督信号。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个名为“生成器循环对齐”的两阶段框架，旨在解决多模态RAG中检索结果的语义相似性与生成器产生正确答案的效用之间的不匹配问题。第一阶段通过VLM生成假设文本作为检索查询，以弥合图像-文本模态差异。第二阶段则利用冻结VLM生成的答案监督偏好对来微调交叉编码重排序器。实验结果表明，该框架在VQA任务上显著优于现有基线，证明了答案级别生成器反馈作为偏好对齐监督信号的有效性。
AI.keywords: 多模态RAG, 语义-效用鸿沟, 生成器循环对齐, 视觉语言模型, 偏好对齐
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入“生成器循环对齐”框架，巧妙地解决了多模态RAG中语义相似性与答案效用之间的偏好鸿沟。其创新之处在于利用VLM自身生成答案的反馈作为监督信号，无需昂贵的人工标注，实现了端到端的对齐。这种方法为提升多模态RAG系统的实用性提供了一条有效途径，特别是在需要精确答案生成的场景中。该研究的重要性体现在它为多模态RAG系统的优化提供了一个新颖且高效的解决方案。

title: Do Dynamic Routers Need Memory? HeRo: History-Aware Routing for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: Dynamic layer routing reduces the inference cost of Large Language Models (LLMs) by learning to skip layers for individual tokens. Existing methods, however, treat each routing decision as a local operation conditioned solely on the current hidden state which is a formulation that overlooks the sequential, path-dependent nature of routing across depth: earlier decisions shape the representations seen by downstream routers, and the layer-usage objective couples all decisions jointly. We propose History-Aware Routing (HeRo), a dynamic routing framework that resolves this mismatch by introducing a router memory mechanism to maintain an explicit routing state across model depth. The memory is constructed via linear attention, incrementally aggregating preceding routing scores and their induced residual updates into a compact history representation. At each routed layer, the router conditions jointly on this accumulated state and the current hidden representation to select the executed branch. Instantiated for token-wise FFN routing, HeRo trains only lightweight routers and adapters on a frozen backbone, requiring no modification to pretrained parameters. Across Llama 3.1-8B, Llama 2-7B, and Llama 2-13B, HeRo consistently achieves the highest aggregate performance retention among ten baselines. On Llama 3.1-8B, it bypasses 26.87% of model parameters while achieving 100.24% of dense model performance across seven benchmarks, and retains 97.01% while bypassing 38.82% of model parameters under a tighter computation budget. Ablation studies confirm that removing routing history consistently degrades performance, most notably on multistep reasoning and code generation, validating that explicit routing memory enables more accurate and adaptive dynamic routing than solely conditioning on hidden state.

AI.title_translation: 动态路由器需要记忆吗？HeRo：用于高效LLM推理的历史感知路由
AI.tldr: 现有动态路由方法忽略了路由的序列依赖性，HeRo引入路由器记忆机制，通过历史感知路由显著提高了LLM推理效率和性能。
AI.motivation: 现有动态层路由方法将每个路由决策视为局部操作，仅基于当前隐藏状态，忽略了路由跨深度的序列性、路径依赖性，即早期决策会影响下游路由器的表示，且层使用目标将所有决策耦合在一起。
AI.method: 提出HeRo（History-Aware Routing），通过引入路由器记忆机制来解决不匹配问题，该机制在模型深度上维护显式的路由状态。记忆通过线性注意力构建，逐步将先前的路由分数及其引起的残差更新聚合为紧凑的历史表示。在每个路由层，路由器同时基于累积状态和当前隐藏表示来选择执行的分支。HeRo仅在冻结骨干上训练轻量级路由器和适配器，无需修改预训练参数。
AI.result: 在Llama 3.1-8B、Llama 2-7B和Llama 2-13B上，HeRo始终在十个基线中实现最高的综合性能保持。在Llama 3.1-8B上，它绕过了26.87%的模型参数，同时在七个基准测试中达到了密集模型性能的100.24%；在更严格的计算预算下，绕过38.82%的模型参数时仍保持97.01%的性能。消融研究证实，移除路由历史会持续降低性能，尤其是在多步推理和代码生成方面。
AI.conclusion: 显式路由记忆能够实现比单独依赖隐藏状态更准确和自适应的动态路由。
AI.translation: 动态层路由通过学习跳过单个token的层来降低大型语言模型（LLM）的推理成本。然而，现有方法将每个路由决策视为局部操作，仅以当前隐藏状态为条件，这种公式忽略了路由跨深度的序列性、路径依赖性：早期的决策塑造了下游路由器所看到的表示，并且层使用目标将所有决策联合耦合。我们提出了历史感知路由（HeRo），这是一个动态路由框架，通过引入路由器记忆机制来解决这种不匹配，以在模型深度上维护显式的路由状态。该记忆通过线性注意力构建，逐步将先前的路由分数及其引起的残差更新聚合为紧凑的历史表示。在每个路由层，路由器同时基于这种累积状态和当前隐藏表示来选择执行的分支。HeRo针对token级FFN路由实例化，仅在冻结骨干上训练轻量级路由器和适配器，无需修改预训练参数。在Llama 3.1-8B、Llama 2-7B和Llama 2-13B上，HeRo始终在十个基线中实现最高的综合性能保持。在Llama 3.1-8B上，它绕过了26.87%的模型参数，同时在七个基准测试中达到了密集模型性能的100.24%，并在更严格的计算预算下，绕过38.82%的模型参数时仍保持97.01%的性能。消融研究证实，移除路由历史会持续降低性能，尤其是在多步推理和代码生成方面，这验证了显式路由记忆能够实现比单独依赖隐藏状态更准确和自适应的动态路由。
AI.summary: 本文提出了HeRo（History-Aware Routing），一种用于高效LLM推理的动态路由框架。针对现有动态路由方法忽略路由决策序列依赖性的问题，HeRo引入了路由器记忆机制，通过线性注意力构建并维护跨模型深度的显式路由状态，将先前的路由信息聚合为紧凑的历史表示。路由器在决策时同时考虑累积历史状态和当前隐藏表示。实验结果表明，HeRo在多个Llama模型上显著提高了性能保持和参数绕过率，尤其在多步推理和代码生成任务上表现突出，验证了显式路由记忆对于更准确和自适应动态路由的重要性。
AI.keywords: 动态路由, LLM推理, 历史感知路由, 路由器记忆, 性能优化
AI.comments: HeRo的创新点在于其引入了显式的“路由器记忆”机制，解决了现有动态路由方法忽视路由决策序列依赖性的关键问题。通过线性注意力聚合历史路由信息，HeRo能够做出更全局、更优化的路由决策，显著提升了LLM推理效率和性能，同时无需修改预训练参数，具有良好的实用性。这项工作对于优化LLM的推理成本和性能具有重要意义。

title: An Elementary Proof of the $\widetilde O(n^{1/3})$ Bound for Separating Words
summary: For two distinct binary words of length $n$, the separating words problem asks for a small deterministic finite automaton that accepts exactly one of them. Chase proved a $\widetilde O(n^{1/3})$ upper bound using a complex-analytic estimate for sparse polynomials. We replace that estimate by a finite-difference argument and a second-order real recurrence cutoff. The resulting elementary proof gives an explicit bound of $O(n^{1/3}(\log n)^{7/3})$ states.

AI.title_translation: 分离词 $\widetilde O(n^{1/3})$ 界的一个初等证明
AI.tldr: 该论文通过初等方法简化了分离词问题 $\widetilde O(n^{1/3})$ 上界的证明。
AI.motivation: Chase 先前证明分离词问题时使用了基于稀疏多项式的复杂复分析估计，该论文旨在寻找一种更为简单和初等的证明方法。
AI.method: 用有限差分论证和二阶实数递归截断（second-order real recurrence cutoff）替代了原有的复分析估计。
AI.result: 得到一个显式界为 $O(n^{1/3}(\log n)^{7/3})$ 个状态的初等证明。
AI.conclusion: 通过有限差分和实数递归截断，给出了分离词问题 $\widetilde O(n^{1/3})$ 上界的初等证明。
AI.translation: 对于两个长度为 $n$ 的不同二进制词，分离词问题要求找到一个能且仅能接受其中一个的小型确定性有限自动机。Chase 利用稀疏多项式的复分析估计证明了 $\widetilde O(n^{1/3})$ 的上界。我们将该估计替换为有限差分论证和二阶实数递归截断。由此产生的初等证明给出了 $O(n^{1/3}(\log n)^{7/3})$ 状态的显式界。
AI.summary: 该论文针对长度为 $n$ 的两个不同二进制词的分离词问题，用初等的有限差分方法和实数递归截断替代了复杂的复分析估计，从而给出了 $\widetilde O(n^{1/3})$ 上界的一个更简单、显式的证明。
AI.keywords: 分离词问题, 确定性有限自动机, 稀疏多项式, 初等证明, 复杂度上界
AI.comments: 该论文通过精简的数学工具替代了复杂的复分析估计，显著简化了分离词问题的上界证明，并给出了一个具体的显式界。方法极具创新性和启发性。

title: Qiushi Engine on AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard
summary: This report analyzes Qiushi Engine v0.8 across all 40 test tasks in AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard, a benchmark that requires autonomous agents to carry a research question through experimental design, code implementation, actual execution, result analysis, and report delivery. Qiushi Engine is model-configurable; this evaluation selected DeepSeek deepseek-v4pro-preview as the model backend. The official AstaBench leaderboard records a score of 0.816 and an average benchmark cost of USD 15.209 per task, while the full-precision local recomputation is $81.59 \pm 1.87$. Four tasks satisfied every rubric item, yielding a full-task completion rate of 4/40 = 10% -- 7 percentage points above, and about 3.3 times, the approximately 3% best rate reported for AstaBench's official agents. Across 507 required rubric items, 416 were satisfied (82.1%). Official scoring archives and 40 Meta-Trace records show sustained production and verification of reports, code, and experimental artifacts; the principal gaps lie in repeated runs, external dependencies, specified metrics, and ablation studies. The report explains the benchmark, system workflow, aggregate results, representative cases, and limits of interpretation.

AI.title_translation: 求是引擎在 AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard 上的表现
AI.tldr: 求是引擎在AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard基准测试中取得优异成绩，全任务完成率达10%，显著超越官方最优智能体表现。
AI.motivation: 评估和分析求是引擎（Qiushi Engine v0.8）在需要自主智能体完成从实验设计、代码实现、实际执行、结果分析到报告交付的全流程复杂基准测试AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard上的性能表现。
AI.method: 使用DeepSeek deepseek-v4pro-preview作为模型后端，对AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard的全部40个测试任务进行了评估，并分析了其系统工作流、聚合结果和代表性案例。

AI.conclusion: 求是引擎在AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard基准测试中表现出色，全任务完成率达到10%，显著超越官方最优水平，展现了强大的端到端科研智能体能力。
AI.translation: 本报告分析了求是引擎 v0.8 在 AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard 的全部 40 个测试任务中的表现。该基准要求自主智能体完成从实验设计、代码实现、实际执行、结果分析到报告交付的科研任务。求是引擎支持模型配置，本评估选择了 DeepSeek deepseek-v4pro-preview 作为模型后端。官方 AstaBench 排行榜记录的得分为 0.816，平均每个任务的基准成本为 15.209 美元，而全精度本地重新计算结果为 81.59 ± 1.87。有 4 个任务满足了所有评分项，全任务完成率为 4/40 = 10% ——比 AstaBench 官方智能体报告的大约 3% 的最佳速率高出 7 个百分点，约为其 3.3 倍。在所需的 507 个评分项中，满足了 416 个（82.1%）。官方评分档案和 40 个元追踪记录显示了报告、代码和实验工件的持续生成与验证；主要差距在于重复运行、外部依赖、指定指标和消融实验。该报告阐述了基准测试、系统工作流、聚合结果、代表性案例以及解释的局限性。

title: QoS-Aware RACH Preamble Slicing via Quota-Projected Branching Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Quality-of-service (QoS)-aware random access requires adaptive allocation of a finite random access channel (RACH) preamble budget across heterogeneous traffic and access procedures. This paper proposes QP-BD3QN-RACH, a quota-projected branching deep reinforcement learning controller for mixed two-step (2RA) and four-step (4RA) contention-based random access. Four action branches correspond to the delay-sensitive and delay-tolerant 2RA/4RA preamble pools. A branching dueling Double DQN selects pool-specific multipliers, and deterministic quota projection converts them to nonnegative integer allocations that preserve the preamble budget. With five actions per branch, the controller represents 625 pre-projection branch-action tuples using 20 branch-action outputs. Evaluation covers five arrival loads, cross-method comparison under nominal seed 42, six-seed sensitivity of QP-BD3QN-RACH, and targeted ablations. Across the five-load grid, its mean direction-aligned differences relative to four comparators are positive: 5.74 to 8.21 percentage points for success/collision, 1.23 to 1.92 percentage points for fallback, 0.35 to 0.68 percentage points for blocking, and 0.128 to 0.456 decision intervals for successful-access delay. Load-wise results exhibit metric-dependent tradeoffs, particularly under intermediate and overload conditions.

AI.title_translation: 通过配额投影分支深度强化学习实现QoS感知的RACH前导码切片
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分支深度强化学习的RACH前导码切片控制器（QP-BD3QN-RACH），能够有效实现QoS感知的自适应前导码分配，并在多项性能指标上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: QoS感知的随机接入需要在异构流量和接入程序中自适应分配有限的随机接入信道（RACH）前导码预算。
AI.method: 提出了QP-BD3QN-RACH控制器，利用分支对偶双DQN（branching dueling Double DQN）选择池特定乘数，并通过确定性配额投影将其转换为非负整数分配，以保持前导码预算。
AI.result: 在五个负载网格的评估中，该方法相对于四个对比方法的方向对齐平均差均为正：成功/冲突率为5.74到8.21个百分点，回退率为1.23到1.92个百分点，阻塞率为0.35到0.68个百分点，成功接入延迟为0.128到0.456个决策间隔。
AI.conclusion: QP-BD3QN-RACH控制器成功实现了混合2RA和4RA随机接入中QoS感知的RACH前导码自适应分配，并在成功率、碰撞率及延迟等指标上表现出显著优势。
AI.translation: 质量服务（QoS）感知的随机接入需要在异构流量和接入程序之间自适应分配有限的随机接入信道（RACH）前导码预算。本文提出了QP-BD3QN-RACH，这是一种用于混合两步（2RA）和四步（4RA）基于竞争的随机接入的配额投影分支深度强化学习控制器。四个动作分支对应于延迟敏感和延迟容忍的2RA/4RA前导码池。分支对偶双DQN选择池特定的乘数，确定性配额投影将其转换为保持前导码预算的非负整数分配。每个分支有五个动作，该控制器使用20个分支动作输出表示625个预投影分支动作元组。评估涵盖五个到达负载、在标称种子42下的交叉方法比较、QP-BD3QN-RACH的六种子敏感性以及有针对性的消融实验。在五个负载网格中，其相对于四个比较方法的平均方向对齐差均为正：成功/冲突率为5.74到8.21个百分点，回退率为1.23到1.92个百分点，阻塞率为0.35到0.68个百分点，成功接入延迟为0.128到0.456个决策间隔。负载相关的结果表现出依赖于指标的权衡，特别是在中等和过载条件下。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为QP-BD3QN-RACH的配额投影分支深度强化学习控制器，用于混合两步和四步基于竞争的随机接入中的QoS感知RACH前导码切片，有效优化了前导码分配并提升了接入性能。
AI.keywords: QoS-aware RACH, Preamble Slicing, Branching Deep Reinforcement Learning, Quota Projection, Random Access
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的配额投影分支深度强化学习方法来解决QoS感知的RACH前导码切片问题，创新性地结合了分支DQN和确定性配额投影，在多项性能指标上优于对比方法。

title: SIM: Subspace Interaction-based Method for Token-Level Text Anomaly Detection
summary: Token-level text anomaly detection, as an emerging trend of text anomaly detection, moves beyond coarse-grained document-level detection by localizing anomalous tokens within text. By providing fine-grained abnormality prediction, token-level text anomaly detection plays a critical role in various real-world applications, such as spam filtering and fake news detection. However, existing methods still rely on the global distance calculation for scoring, during which the local anomaly signals are severely diluted by numerous redundant normal feature dimensions. Moreover, pre-trained language models used in these methods inevitably smooth out surface anomalies, further limiting their effectiveness in token-level anomaly detection. To address these limitations, we propose a Subspace Interaction-based Method (SIM for short) for token-level text anomaly detection. To prevent local signal dilution, SIM adopts a subspace interaction-based anomaly detector, which decouples high-dimensional token embeddings into multiple low-dimensional ones, amplifying localized anomaly signals hidden within specific dimensions. To counteract the over-smoothing effect, we design a hard pseudo-anomaly generation module to construct pseudo-anomalous tokens, simulating the subtle anomalies obscured by semantic smoothing. Also, a probabilistic boundary loss is developed to standardize anomaly scores into statistical distances, effectively enforcing anomalous instances to deviate significantly from the normal distribution center. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets verify the effectiveness of SIM and demonstrate its remarkable efficiency, robustness, and interpretability. The source code is available at: https://github.com/yankehan/SIM-TAD.

AI.title_translation: SIM：基于子空间交互的面向令牌级别的文本异常检测方法
AI.tldr: SIM通过子空间交互和伪异常生成来解决现有令牌级别文本异常检测方法中的信号稀释和过平滑问题，并在多个数据集上证明了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有令牌级别文本异常检测方法依赖于全局距离计算，导致局部异常信号因冗余特征维度而被稀释；同时，预训练语言模型会平滑表面异常，限制了检测效果。
AI.method: SIM采用基于子空间交互的异常检测器，将高维令牌嵌入解耦为多个低维嵌入，以放大特定维度中隐藏的局部异常信号。此外，它还设计了一个硬伪异常生成模块来模拟被语义平滑所掩盖的细微异常，并开发了一个概率边界损失来将异常分数标准化为统计距离。
AI.result: SIM在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验证明了其有效性、效率、鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: SIM通过子空间交互和伪异常生成等创新方法，有效解决了现有令牌级别文本异常检测方法的局限性，并在实验中取得了显著成效。
AI.translation: 令牌级别的文本异常检测是文本异常检测的一个新兴趋势，它超越了粗粒度的文档级别检测，在文本中定位异常的令牌。通过提供细粒度的异常预测，令牌级别的文本异常检测在垃圾邮件过滤和假新闻检测等各种实际应用中起着关键作用。然而，现有方法仍然依赖于全局距离计算来进行评分，在此过程中，局部异常信号会因大量冗余的正常特征维度而严重稀释。此外，这些方法中使用的预训练语言模型不可避免地会平滑表面异常，进一步限制了它们在令牌级别异常检测方面的有效性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种用于令牌级别文本异常检测的基于子空间交互的方法（简称SIM）。为了防止局部信号稀释，SIM采用基于子空间交互的异常检测器，它将高维令牌嵌入解耦为多个低维嵌入，从而放大了隐藏在特定维度中的局部异常信号。为了抵消过度平滑效应，我们设计了一个硬伪异常生成模块来构建伪异常令牌，模拟被语义平滑所掩盖的细微异常。此外，还开发了一个概率边界损失来将异常分数标准化为统计距离，有效地强制异常实例显著偏离正常分布中心。在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验证明了SIM的有效性，并展示了其卓越的效率、鲁棒性和可解释性。源代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/yankehan/SIM-TAD。
AI.summary: SIM（Subspace Interaction-based Method）是一种新提出的令牌级别文本异常检测方法，旨在解决现有技术中信号稀释和语义平滑的问题。它通过将令牌嵌入分解到子空间中来增强局部异常信号，并通过生成伪异常样本来对抗平滑效应。此外，该方法还利用概率边界损失来区分正常和异常数据。实验表明，SIM在效率、鲁棒性和可解释性方面表现出色。
AI.keywords: 令牌级别异常检测,子空间交互,伪异常生成,概率边界损失,文本异常检测
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的令牌级别文本异常检测方法SIM，通过子空间交互和伪异常生成来解决现有方法的局限性。其创新性在于将高维嵌入解耦以放大局部信号，并引入硬伪异常来对抗预训练模型的平滑效应。方法的可解释性和效率也是该研究的亮点。然而，对于伪异常生成模块的敏感性以及在不同类型异常上的泛化能力有待进一步研究。

title: Asymptotically good binary triorthogonal codes and higher-level transversal gates
summary: For each level of the Clifford hierarchy from the third level onward, we construct explicit asymptotically good binary CSS codes supporting diagonal transversal gates in that level. We achieve this using algebraic geometry codes over binary extension fields and performing an alphabet reduction that translates orthogonality conditions over the extension field to binary overlap conditions. In particular, we obtain the first asymptotically good family of binary triorthogonal codes. We also give a stronger construction with worse parameters for which no subsequent correction is required. Finally, adapting an error-correction-based distillation protocol, our binary $T$-gate families yield constant-overhead $T$-state block distillation under sufficiently weak input noise and ideal stabilizer operations.

AI.title_translation: 渐近优良的二元三正交码和更高级的横向门
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了首个渐近优良的二元三正交码，并构建了支持特定克利福德层级（从第三层开始）的对角横向门。
AI.motivation: 构建支持更高级别克利福德层级的横向门，特别是三正交码，以实现更高效的量子计算。
AI.method: 利用代数几何码和字母表缩减技术，将扩展域上的正交条件转化为二元重叠条件，从而构建二元CSS码。
AI.result: 首次获得渐近优良的二元三正交码，并提供了一种参数较差但无需后续校正的更强构造。此外，还提出了二元T门系列，可在弱噪声和理想稳定器操作下实现恒定开销的T态块蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功构建了渐近优良的二元三正交码和支持更高级别克利福德层级的横向门，为量子计算中的纠错和资源优化提供了新的途径。
AI.translation: 对于克利福德层级的第三级及更高级别，我们构建了显式的渐近优良的二元CSS码，支持该层级的对角横向门。我们使用二元扩展域上的代数几何码并通过字母表缩减来实现这一点，该缩减将扩展域上的正交条件转化为二元重叠条件。特别是，我们获得了首个渐近优良的二元三正交码系列。我们还提供了一种具有更差参数但无需后续校正的更强构造。最后，通过调整基于纠错的蒸馏协议，我们的二元T门系列在足够弱的输入噪声和理想的稳定器操作下，可以实现恒定开销的T态块蒸馏。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种利用代数几何码和字母表缩减技术构建渐近优良二元CSS码的方法，成功实现了支持克利福德层级（从第三级起）对角横向门的目标。研究者首次获得了渐近优良的二元三正交码，并提出了一种无需后续校正的更优构造。此外，通过改进蒸馏协议，他们还展示了二元T门系列在弱噪声和理想稳定器操作下实现恒定开销T态块蒸馏的潜力。
AI.keywords: 二元CSS码, 代数几何码, 三正交码, 横向门, T态蒸馏
AI.comments: 这项工作在量子纠错码领域取得了重要进展，特别是首次提出了渐近优良的二元三正交码，这对于构建更可靠、更高效的量子计算机至关重要。通过结合代数几何码和字母表缩减技术，研究者巧妙地解决了在二元域上实现复杂量子门的问题。然而，参数的权衡以及实际实现中的噪声模型仍是未来研究的重点。

title: Stabilizing Instruction Supervision for Instruct-TTS via Controllable Diversification and Drift Filtering
summary: Instruct-TTS systems expand structured style labels into natural-language training instructions through LLM rewriting, yet we find that over 40% of unconstrained rewrites contain semantic drift that corrupts supervision and weakens generalization. We formalize this problem as instruction supervision instability and propose a data-centric stabilization recipe that jointly improves coverage and fidelity through three mechanisms: controllable instruction diversification for systematic expansion, LLM-based drift filtering for quality control, and attribute-aligned supervision that grounds prosody control in acoustic perturbations. On the Chinese split of InstructTTSEval, our recipe raises instruction-following from 34.5% without fine-tuning and 51.0% with naive fine-tuning to 56.4%, while constrained rewriting reduces drift from 40.4% to 15.4%. Ablations confirm the three mechanisms are complementary, and the drift taxonomy may generalize to instruction-driven generation beyond TTS.

AI.title_translation: 通过可控多样化与漂移过滤稳定Instruct-TTS的指令监督
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个数据中心的数据稳定化方案，通过控制多样性、过滤漂移和属性对齐，解决了Instruct-TTS中的语义漂移和指令监督不稳定问题，显著提升了语音合成的指令遵循性能。
AI.motivation: Instruct-TTS系统通过大语言模型重写将结构化风格标签扩展为自然语言训练指令，但作者发现超过40%的不受约束重写包含会破坏监督并削弱泛化能力的语义漂移，因此需要解决这种指令监督的不稳定性。
AI.method: 提出了一种包含三个机制的数据中心稳定化方案：1. 用于系统性扩展的可控指令多样化；2. 用于质量控制的基于大语言模型的漂移过滤；3. 将韵律控制基础化为声学扰动的属性对齐监督。
AI.result: 在InstructTTSEval的中文切片上，该方案将指令遵循率从无微调的34.5%和朴素微调的51.0%提升至56.4%，同时将受约束重写的漂移率从40.4%降低到15.4%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的可控多样化、漂移过滤和属性对齐监督机制有效解决了Instruct-TTS中的指令监督不稳定问题，显著提高了系统对自然语言指令的遵循能力，并降低了语义漂移率。
AI.translation: Instruct-TTS系统通过LLM重写将结构化风格标签扩展为自然语言训练指令，然而我们发现超过40%不受约束的重写包含破坏监督并削弱泛化能力的语义漂移。我们将此问题正式定义为指令监督不稳定，并提出了一种数据中心的稳定化方案，该方案通过三种机制共同提高覆盖率和保真度：用于系统扩展的可控指令多样化、基于LLM用于质量控制的漂移过滤，以及将韵律控制基于声学扰动的属性对齐监督。在InstructTTSEval的中文切片上，我们的方案将指令遵循率从无微调的34.5%和朴素微调的51.0%提升至56.4%，同时将受约束重写的漂移率从40.4%降至15.4%。消融实验证实这三种机制是互补的，且该漂移分类法有望推广至TTS之外的指令驱动生成任务。
AI.summary: 本文针对Instruct-TTS中因LLM重写导致的语义漂移问题（指令监督不稳定），提出了一种包含可控指令多样化、基于LLM的漂移过滤和属性对齐监督的稳定化方案，实验证明该方案能显著提升模型的指令遵循能力并减少语义漂移。
AI.keywords: Instruct-TTS, 指令监督不稳定, 语义漂移, 数据中心稳定化方案
AI.comments: 该论文针对Instruct-TTS中由于大语言模型重写带来的语义漂移问题，提出了一种基于数据中心的稳定化方案，通过可控的多样性生成、漂移过滤和属性对齐的监督机制，显著提升了指令遵循能力，方法直观且有效。

title: Monkey See, Can Monkey Do? A Benchmark for Evaluating Robot Skill Learning by Observation
comments: 31 pages, 8 tables, 11 figures. In Proceedings of CoRL 2026
summary: Learning from Observation (LfO) is a fundamental robotic capability that replicates how humans and animals socially learn from each other. Beyond its biological parallels, this modality provides a practical solution for data scaling in sample-inefficient and data-starved domains like robotics. Recent work has demonstrated promising results in learning manipulation skills from human videos, yet progress in this area remains difficult to assess. Existing methods vary widely in assumptions, hardware choices, and environment setups making it difficult to draw meaningful comparisons and identify advances in the field. To address these challenges, we introduce RoboReel: a unified benchmark for evaluating models that learn policies from human videos. RoboReel consists of bundled real-world human demonstration videos, simulated robot trajectories, and evaluation environments on ten manipulation tasks. We develop four test suites to evaluate the models' performance on multiple axes, including the robustness to visual distractors and the ability to complete long-horizon tasks. Our benchmark covers learning-from-observation models from different categories, and studies the effectiveness of multiple representation choices in our benchmark evaluation that covers over seven state-of-the-art algorithms (including our VLA based variants) in the field of LfO. Finally, we present an analysis of the different types of algorithms showing that long-horizon tasks and tasks with low tolerances are still challenging for current models. Webpage: https://roboreel.github.io

AI.title_translation: 猴子看见，猴子能做吗？一个用于评估机器人观察学习技能的基准
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了RoboReel，一个统一的基准，用于评估从人类视频中学习机器人技能的模型。该基准包含真实世界的演示视频、模拟的机器人轨迹和十个操作任务的评估环境，并包含四个测试套件以评估模型的鲁棒性和完成长时任务的能力。研究发现，长时任务和低容忍度任务对当前模型仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估机器人观察学习（LfO）方法的研究存在很大差异，难以进行有意义的比较和识别该领域的进展。因此，需要一个统一的基准来解决这些挑战。
AI.method: 本研究提出了RoboReel基准，它包含真实世界的演示视频、模拟的机器人轨迹和十个操作任务的评估环境。此外，还开发了四个测试套件来评估模型的性能，包括对视觉干扰的鲁棒性和完成长时任务的能力。该基准涵盖了不同类别的LfO模型，并对七种最先进的算法进行了评估。
AI.result: 研究表明，长时任务和低容忍度任务对当前模型来说仍然具有挑战性。基准评估涵盖了七种最先进的算法，并分析了不同算法类型的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RoboReel基准的引入为评估和比较机器人观察学习模型提供了一个统一的平台。研究结果表明，尽管LfO领域取得了进展，但长时任务和低容忍度任务仍然是当前模型面临的挑战。
AI.translation: 学习观察（LfO）是一项基础的机器人能力，它复制了人类和动物如何通过社会互动进行学习。除了其生物学上的相似性，这种模式为机器人技术等样本效率低下和数据稀缺的领域提供了实际的数据扩展解决方案。最近的研究在从人类视频中学习操作技能方面取得了有希望的结果，但该领域的进展仍然难以评估。现有方法在假设、硬件选择和环境设置方面差异很大，使得进行有意义的比较和识别该领域的进展变得困难。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了RoboReel：一个用于评估从人类视频中学习策略的模型统一基准。RoboReel由捆绑的真实世界人类演示视频、模拟机器人轨迹和十个操作任务的评估环境组成。我们开发了四个测试套件，用于在多个轴上评估模型的性能，包括对视觉干扰的鲁棒性以及完成长时任务的能力。我们的基准涵盖了来自不同类别的学习观察模型，并在我们的基准评估中研究了多种表示选择的有效性，该评估涵盖了LfO领域的七种以上最先进算法（包括我们的基于VLA的变体）。最后，我们对不同类型的算法进行了分析，表明长时任务和低容忍度任务对当前模型仍然具有挑战性。网址：https://roboreel.github.io
AI.summary: 本研究提出了RoboReel，一个用于评估机器人观察学习（LfO）模型的统一基准。该基准包含真实世界演示视频、模拟轨迹和十个操作任务的评估环境，旨在解决现有LfO评估方法不一致的问题。RoboReel通过四个测试套件评估模型的鲁棒性和长时任务处理能力。研究评估了七种先进算法，发现长时和低容忍度任务对当前模型仍构成挑战。
AI.keywords: 机器人观察学习, 评估基准, RoboReel, 模仿学习, 操作任务
AI.comments: RoboReel基准的提出对于推动机器人观察学习领域的发展具有重要意义。它提供了一个标准化的评估框架，有助于研究人员更有效地比较不同算法的性能，并识别现有方法的局限性。然而，该基准的有效性仍需在更广泛的实验和应用场景中得到验证。此外，未来可以考虑纳入更多样化的任务和更复杂的环境，以进一步挑战和推动LfO技术的发展。

title: A Better Spur Should Start From Each Objective
summary: Real-world Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (MORL) often suffers from sparse rewards, reward conflicts, and late-stage reward tug-of-war, causing traditional linear scalarization to experience severe metric oscillations. To address optimization conflicts among multiple objectives in real-world deployment scenarios, we propose Multi-Marginal Preference Optimization (MMPO), a fine-grained framework that intervenes at the data, gradient, and constraint levels rather than relying on coarse-grained global scalarization. Specifically, MMPO performs exposure debiasing to mitigate sparse and biased rewards, applies priority-aware orthogonal projection to decouple conflicting gradients, and introduces self-prompted gradient constraints to prevent dominant objectives from overwhelming weaker ones. Experiments on real-world e-commerce datasets show that MMPO improves training stability and consistently achieves better performance across conflicting metrics. Moreover, it generalizes robustly to broader tasks such as ToolRL and code generation, demonstrating its effectiveness as a practical paradigm for multi-objective alignment.

title: Finite difference methods for three kinds of reaction-diffusion equations with free boundaries
summary: This work considers to numerically solve three kinds of reaction-diffusion equations with free boundaries. First, the popular front-fixing method is used to transform the considered free boundary problems into fixed boundary problems. Then, by employing the finite difference method, numerical schemes with $\mathrm{M}$-matrices as their coefficient matrices are developed for these transformed fixed-boundary problems. Next, for the developed numerical schemes, we establish numerical theory involving positivity preservation, monotonicity preservation, and stability. It is noteworthy that, unlike some existing works that impose tight restrictions on the time step-size to discuss the numerical theory, the proposed numerical schemes require only a mild restriction. Finally, numerical examples are provided to test the developed numerical schemes and to confirm the theoretical results.

title: DRIFT: Removing Diffusion Watermarks by Deflecting the Generative Trajectory
summary: Diffusion watermarking embeds verifiable signals into the generative process and commonly verifies them by recovering trajectory-dependent evidence, making the marks robust to conventional pixel-space distortions. Existing removal attacks either regenerate along deterministic trajectories, which often preserve the watermark-bearing latent structure, or optimize every image separately. We identify the reliance on a recoverable generative trajectory as a common attack surface among the schemes we study. Based on this observation, we propose DRIFT, a black-box attack that combines partial forward diffusion with stochastic reverse resampling. Forward re-noising limits source information available to a fixed-depth recovery pipeline, while stochastic reversal supplies alternative noise-driven paths whose removal benefit we isolate through matched sampler comparisons. Adaptive DRIFT searches a selected ladder for each image's first verifier-rejected rung and refines fidelity while retaining only updates rejected by the same verifier. At fixed depth, we derive information-theoretic and Wasserstein source-dependence bounds; under realized-ladder monotonicity, the first rejected rung is least distorted among rejected rungs on that ladder, and verifier-gated refinement preserves rejection. Across nine watermarks spanning three paradigms, DRIFT achieves 98-100% attack success and the best image quality among the compared attacks, without secret keys, verifier internals, or per-image gradient optimization.

title: TacClip: a clip-on sensor measures dynamic contact forces without covering the fingerpads
summary: TacClip is a minimally encumbering wearable device for recording fingertip deformation caused by contact forces and vibrations. It can be combined with vision- or glove-based hand tracking systems that leave the fingertips uncovered and provides a measure of dynamic contact interactions, while leaving the finger pads exposed so that the user retains natural sensitivity to texture, friction, temperature, and fine surface features. The signal is produced by a Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) embedded on a small plastic clip mounted over the fingernail. Optionally, for use with vision-based tracking, additional FBGs on polyimide strips can complement camera-based pose estimation. In finger pressing tests, TacClip estimates the force magnitude with typical errors below $0.5~\mathrm{N}$ over a $0$--$8~\mathrm{N}$ range. In tests of cloth handling and tape edge finding, we show that it captures the vibrations and dynamic events generated during exploratory sliding. With no electronics, TacClip can also be used submerged in water, while preserving bare finger contact.

title: PhysFlow: Physics-Aware Optical Flow for Motion Controllable Video Generation
summary: Video generation models have recently attracted substantial attention for their ability to generate visually compelling videos, yet ensuring physically consistent and plausible dynamics still remains a fundamental challenge, driving a growing line of research on physical realism in video generation. To address this challenge, motivated by the fact that physical regularities are primarily encoded in motion patterns, we propose PhysFlow, a novel two-stage framework for improving the physical plausibility of generated videos by decomposing video generation into motion-aware optical flow generation followed by motion-conditioned appearance synthesis. Specifically, PhysFlow consists of a physics-aware optical-flow video generator called PA-Flow and a flow-guided video generator called FlowRender. During the first stage, PA-Flow employs a physics-aware attention module to model how motion attributes and material properties influence global motion and local deformation, respectively, and generates an optical flow video as an explicit representation of motion. In the second stage, FlowRender leverages the decoupled motion representation as guidance to synthesize realistic textures and appearances, ultimately producing the final physically plausible video. To further support model training with explicit physical supervision, we construct PhysVideo, a physics-based video dataset generated with a physics engine and 3D-GS rendering, containing 10K foreground objects and 50K realistic video sequences with annotations of motion and material properties. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed PhysFlow generates videos with superior physical plausibility while maintaining high visual fidelity compared with existing methods.

title: Vision: Data-Centric Anchoring for Robust and Interpretable Agentic AI
summary: Agentic AI systems built on large language models fail in two persistent ways that scaling does not fix: they break under distribution shift, and they cannot explain the decisions they make. We argue these are co-symptoms of one structural deficiency in the data lifecycle that governs how agents are trained, evaluated, and deployed. Observational interaction logs record what an agent did, not what it would have done otherwise. They encode spurious correlations without controlled variation, so they lack the counterfactual structure needed to separate causal signal from coincidence or to validate an explanation. No model-centric method can recover invariances the data never contained. We present Data-Centric Anchoring: robustness and interpretability should be engineered into the data environment, not extracted from models after training. Our central contribution is the Data-Centric Agentic Loop, a four-stage framework of Curate, Augment, Constrain, and Attribute. The ordering is structural, not stylistic. Curation precedes augmentation because generative models amplify whatever bias they are trained on. Augmentation precedes constraint because invariance objectives are vacuous without variation across environments to be invariant to. Attribution closes the loop, converting observed failures into targeted data interventions for the next iteration. Each stage manufactures the preconditions of the next, which makes the loop self-correcting rather than merely sequential. We ground the framework in a failure-driven taxonomy that links four core failure modes to the data lifecycle: spurious feature reliance, distribution-shift fragility, uncertainty miscalibration, and explanation unfaithfulness. We close with the limits of this approach and the open problems that stand between it and practical deployment at scale.

title: Drive by Hindsight and Foresight: Tool-Grounded Synergistic Reasoning over Hierarchical Memory for Autonomous Driving
summary: VLMs have shown promise for autonomous driving, yet still suffer from hallucination, weak spatio-temporal perception, and limited generalization. Recent methods improve reasoning and decision-making through CoT explanations, retrieval-augmented generation or the static injection of tool outputs. Although these mechanisms enrich the context, the model neither proactively perceives scene information nor accumulates experience after answering. To overcome these limitations, we present, to our knowledge, the first synergistic framework that tightly couples hierarchical memory with proactive tool invocation in a closed reasoning loop. Our contributions are threefold. (i) Hierarchical Driving Memory: a scene-level short-term memory maintains the dynamic scene state, and an evolving long-term memory retrieves reusable experience and tool strategies. (ii) Memory-Tool Synergistic Reasoning Framework: guided by the scene state and retrieved experience, the model adaptively invokes tools to refine its reasoning at inference time and consolidates reusable experience into a long-term memory pool offline. (iii) Data Generation and Two-stage Training Pipeline: verified memory-tool trajectories built by multi-step teacher rollout are used to train with SFT and GRPO. Our 7B model reaches an overall reasoning score of 80.03 and MCQ accuracy of 79.09% on DriveLMM-o1, surpassing the strongest baseline by 7.74 MCQ points and generalizes strongly across benchmarks. Notably, ablation and analysis studies validate the effectiveness of each component and further reveal the complementary roles of hierarchical memory. Short-term memory strengthens spatio-temporal understanding, improving STSBench accuracy by 24.2 points, while offline long-term memory consolidation yields an additional 3.57-point MCQ gain with all parameters frozen, demonstrating continual self-evolution through accumulated driving experience.

title: Stabilizing Traffic Flow Via Autonomous Vehicles: A Less Conservative Approach
summary: This paper explores stabilizing traffic flow using a minimum number of autonomous vehicles (AVs) under control constraints. In contrast to most studies, we consider a heterogeneous parameter setup scenario for human-driven vehicles (HVs) to reflect real-world differences in driving behavior. While current literature uses an H-Infinity based sufficient condition to ensure the string stability of traffic flow, this often yields a conservative lower bound on the AV penetration rate to stabilize traffic flow. To reduce such conservativeness and obtain a less conservative lower bound, we ensure the string stability of traffic flow by directly imposing the possession of no growing eigenmodes. We also systematically find a minimum number of required AVs and solve for the optimal control parameters via nonlinear optimization. We finally assess the intended conservativeness reduction via numerical simulations. Quantitatively, applying our algorithm to the homogeneous HV baseline in the literature (the result built upon an H-Infinity based sufficient condition) reduces (improves) the AV penetration rate by 17.14% while ensuring the string stability of traffic flow. We observe a trade-off between the stabilization/performance degradation and the number of utilized identical AVs. Quantitatively, our last numerical simulation corroborates that the AV penetration rate can be reduced by 61.54% at the expense of 27.66% higher position difference deviation from the equilibrium and a 92.47% degradation in the real stability radius (RSR)---a metric to measure the stability robustness under the perturbation/uncertainty---associated with the aggregated linearized dynamics while ensuring the string stability of traffic flow. This trade-off helps engineers/operators make better traffic control decisions.

title: Bridging Language and Physics: Automated Design of Continuum Robots with Large Language Models
comments: The first three authors contributed equally to this work
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as a promising tool for automating robot design from high-level specifications, yet they remain ineffective for robots operating under complex physical interactions. This limitation stems from the gap between language-based reasoning and the physical consequences of embodiment, often resulting in designs with low physical validity. In this work, we propose a multi-layered framework, AID-SR, that establishes a closed loop by translating simulator-observed physical states into structured feedback for the LLM designer. Combined with semantic critique, human feedback, and iterative refinement, the framework promotes the generation of physically feasible and functionally meaningful robot designs. We evaluate our approach on tendon-driven continuum robots across a benchmark of 14 tasks spanning reaching, grasping, locomotion, and manipulation. The proposed framework achieves 96.2% rate for passing the simulation feasibility check and by applying a common reinforcement learning training, 26.7% robots can successfully fulfill the corresponding task. We then fabricate three designed robots of AID-SR that successfully complete the task in real-world. These extensive experiments across simulation and real-world environments demonstrate and break the wall of utilizing the LLMs for automated design of continuum robots. The source code and experimental resources are publicly available at https://github.com/UNITES-Lab/AID-SR.

title: SoftRerank: Hierarchical Soft Fusion with Candidate-Label Reranking for Long-Tailed Micro-Action Recognition
comments: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26). Ranked 1st in the 3rd Micro-Action Analysis Grand Challenge at ACM MM 2026
summary: Micro-actions are subtle, low-intensity non-verbal behaviors that provide cues to fine-grained human states, including emotions and intentions. Recognizing them remains difficult because they are brief, contain weak visual changes, and often exhibit similar motion patterns across categories. This paper addresses these challenges with a fine-grained micro-action recognition method that combines full fine-tuning of InternVideo2.5, hierarchical soft fusion, and a lightweight candidate-label reranker. For the long-tailed label distribution in MA-52, we use class-balanced sampling and inverse-frequency reweighting to reduce the effect of frequent classes during training. We fine-tune InternVideo2.5 end to end and attach coarse and group-conditional fine-grained classification heads to the shared video representation, improving the consistency between coarse and fine predictions. For ambiguous samples, the candidate-label reranker uses hard samples and video-label matching to focus on easily confused fine-grained actions. Experiments validate the proposed method, which achieves a 79.99% F1-mean on MA-52 and ranks first in the 3rd Micro-Action Analysis Grand Challenge at ACM Multimedia 2026.
